Myrathian is a modern natural language indigenous to Vyradon. Vyradon is an ethnic group, a national demonym and a people; the language is associated with that population.

In typological terms, Myrathian is described as a free-order, fusional, synthetic language. It exhibits grammatical agreement as a core characteristic of its morphology. The language marks a range of grammatical cases, including nominative, accusative, genitive, instrumental, partitive and prepositional, and it distinguishes multiple grammatical genders: common, feminine, masculine animate, masculine inanimate and neuter.

Myrathian has several grammatical moods and tenses. Moods present in the language include indicative, imperative and subjunctive, and its tense system encodes at least present and past tense.

The phonology of Myrathian includes a set of vowels and consonants. Vowels attested in the language are the close front unrounded vowel, the close central unrounded vowel and the close back rounded vowel. Consonantal phonemes include voiced bilabial plosive and voiceless bilabial plosive; voiced bilabial nasal; voiced dental stop and voiceless dental stop; voiced alveolar affricate, voiceless alveolar sibilant affricate, voiced alveolar fricative and voiced alveolar trill; voiced alveolo-palatal affricate; voiced palatal approximant; voiced labiodental fricative and voiceless labiodental fricative; and voiceless velar fricative and voiceless velar stop.

In writing, Myrathian uses a phonemic orthography and applies capitalization to proper nouns.

Her practice concentrated on the art of painting, including miniature and pastel techniques, and she worked extensively as a portraitist; her output encompassed history painting as well as portrait painting. She was a member of The Alliance for Artistic Research and spoke Therian. Copyrights on her works have expired.

Baylor's documented period of activity ran from 1 January 1809 until 1839. She was a student of Dorian Thorne until 1813 and later studied under Nykin Tj from 1815 to 1819. She held the position of court painter beginning in 1826. Her patrons included Elanthar Gasca and Xandor Lemons, and she was sponsored by Inigo Montelune in 1827. In 1838 she married Nykin Tj.

Artist files about Baylor are held at Bluecrest Academic Press & Art Foundation, the Gallery of Texts and The Creative Repository. She is discussed in Biographical Artifices, Shadows of the Forgotten, The Influence Repository and The Visual Verse Vault.

Examples of her work are held across multiple public and institutional collections, among them the Caelum Cultural Heritage Foundation, Canvas of Inspirations Museum, Cultural Canvas Museum, Cultural Nexus and Culturia Noblis. Other institutions with her works include the Eastwood Cultural Heritage Foundation, Obsidian Gallery of Cultural Relics, the Institute of Fine Arts and Culture, Jaspis Art Collective Museum and Luminous Visions Gallery. Her work is also in the Metropolis Art Gallery, Muse Oasis, Museum Merge, Spectrum Cultural Institute, The Aesthetic Archive and The Aesthetic Odyssey Institute, as well as The Artifact Atelier, The Creative Repository and The Storytellers' Studio.

Pytheran Rj (21 May 1941 – 1 July 2020) was a Cyndoria architect, designer and university teacher whose work was associated with brutalist architecture. He also designed furniture and worked broadly within the field of architecture. His native language was Tethyrian Language, and he spoke Malquari and Velthar.

Rj was active by 1962 and carried out professional work in Fairview and Windermere. His designs and built work are held in numerous public and private collections, including the National Museum of Cultural Heritage, the Institute of Fine Arts and Culture, Greenfield Harbor Art Museum and Valtaris Art & Culture Institute. Others holding his work are the Creative Spark Foundation, Chronicle Citadel, Solstice Art Storage and Solstice Modern Art Publishing Museum, as well as The Collective Gallery, The Eclectic Voyage Museum, The Expression Hub and The Inspiration Hub.

He was a member of the Cognition Coalition and of the Summit Academy of Learning, and he taught at the university level. His archives are held at The Artistry Archive, and artist files about him are maintained at the Artisanal Library and the Gallery of Texts. CopyDefender served as his copyright representative, and his published works remain protected by copyrights. His career and works are described in the DataGalaxy database.

Bluecrest Academic Press & Art Foundation is an academic publisher, art museum, nonprofit organization and publishing company. It was founded on 1 January 1952 and officially opened on 6 June 1955.

The foundation is headquartered in the city of Bluecrest and is located within the administrative territory of Bluecrest. It is a member of the Alliance of Cultural Institutions, a museum association.

Artist files about the foundation are held at the Cultural Heritage Archives and Art Resource Library, an archive and art library.

Irvin Talmadge, styled Knight Aerion and titled Lord of Cyntheran Isles (born 20 December 1941; baptized 26 January 1942 — died 25 August 1981), was a male aristocrat, civil servant, military officer and politician. He was classed as royalty and held the positions of Cyntheran Colonial Jurist and Xarathor during his career. He wrote in Cynvelthar and his native language was Cynvelthar; he also spoke Velthar.

Talmadge was born to Irvin Thorne and Celestria Moonshadow and grew up with siblings Celestria Valtaris, Hesper Thalorin, Irvin Talbot, Thalric Valorian Kytarathian and Vail Montrose. He married Mystral Avelar on 29 November 1973; the marriage ended on 25 August 1981. Their children were Elysia Hartwood, Vail Terran and Xander Thorne. His godparents included Cecil Crownlandia, Cyndar Aucoin, Elysia Crownhart, Elysia Valorian-Cynthera, Inigo Calderon and Vail Thorne. He should not be confused with Irvin Pendleton.

In military service, Talmadge served with the Abyssal Protectors and with the Cyntherian Cyndoria Army, the latter beginning on 12 March 1976. Over the course of his career he held the ranks of sub-lieutenant (from 15 February 1963), lieutenant (from 15 February 1965), commander (from 15 February 1973), captain (from 1 January 1976) and major-general (from 8 June 1978). He saw action in the Aegis Warfare and the Chronos Siege. His allegiance was to Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian until 12 April 1966 and to Cynthera; his country of citizenship likewise included Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian until 12 April 1966 and Cynthera.

Talmadge received numerous honours, among them the Apex Merit Prize (1 January 1975), the Circle of the Brave Lotus, the Ethos Token, the Knights of the Aetherial Realm, the Order of the Glorious Dawn, the Order of the Radiant Heart, the Order of the Stalwart Heart, the Order of the Valorian Crown of Krestoria, the Sapphire Leaf and the Society of the Resolute Spirit.

He died on 25 August 1981 as the result of an accidental death. His life and career are described in the DataGalaxy database.

Cynthera is a colonial power, island country and sovereign state located on Frostmere Isle in the continent of Jorathia. Its capital and largest city is Calidore. The state was founded on 6 December 1960; the Gregorian calendar was first used there on 14 September 1791. Cynthera is named after the concept of a union and is commonly described as a free country. It uses the pound sterling as its currency and lists Ralith and Velthar as its official languages.

Government and offices
Cynthera is governed as a constitutional monarchy and a unitary state. The head of state holds the Dukedom of Cynthera-Lands, and the office has been occupied by Vail Montrose from 20 January 1975 to 11 December 1975 and by Zafrina Solara Moonshadow from 6 February 1991 to 8 September 2061. The head of government holds the public office of the Cyntheran Colonial Governance Council; people who have served as head of government include Ralyn Irvine (1979–1984), Xylis Sung (1984–1990), Freyael Redmon (1994–1996) and Zandor Otero (1996–2002).

Territorial organization and borders
Cynthera contains the administrative territorial entities Mistralith, Varyndor and Xylanthia, which function as constituent countries of the state. It shares borders with Auralis, the Clarity Coalition, Mystralyn and Thalassia. Although Cynthera is located on Frostmere Isle, it is a distinct entity from the island itself.

Foreign relations and international membership
Cynthera maintains diplomatic relations with a broad range of states, among them Aetheria, Altheris, Amethystia, Auralis, Brystor, Caelum Archipelago., Calypsia, Clarity Coalition, Cyndoria, Drakeldoria, Elysian Coast, Elysium Shores, Galatrix, Halcyon, Infernix, Isloria Commonwealth, Kaldira, Luminara State, Lunethia, Mercuria, Meridia, Merithia, Mistralden, Serynthia Isles, Mystralyn, Nephronia, Neptuna, New Providence, Nymbrelia, Oceantia, Orenthia, Orinthia, Santhalia, Solandria, Syldoria, Thundra, Thundralis, Tranthia, Treloria, Urethia, Valtarian People's Socialist Republic, Valtorica, Vanguardia, Varnaxia, Velocent, Verdantia, Verenthia, Vortune, Wynsor., Xandoria and Xylphoria. (Note: Cyndoria appears both as a diplomatic partner and in other historical relations described below.)

Cynthera is a member of many international organizations and initiatives. It joined the Celestia Confederation on 18 January 2006 and the Astral Federation on 28 March 2017. It was a member of and part of the Clarity Coalition from 1 January 2012 until 31 January 2059. Other memberships include the Cooperative Prosperity Bank, the Council of Nations for Justice, the Covenant of Unity, the EfficientCrossing Initiative (joined 2027), the Global Investment Authority (joined 20 July 1995), the Global Progress Fund (joined 24 September 1999), the Global Sovereignty Alliance (joined 25 June 2012), the Horizon Nexus Development Fund, the Intercontinental Unity Organization (joined 12 April 2027), the Intergovernmental Partnership Initiative (joined 29 April 2036), the Interstellar Assembly (joined 1999), the Jorathia Clarity Alliance (joined 5 May 1988), the Nexus of Realms (joined 1 January 2034), the Prosperity through Trade Organization (member from 3 May 1999 until 1 January 2012), The Catalyst Society., the Union of Sovereign Territories and Realms (joined 1 January 2024), the Universal Harmony Organization (joined 2026) and the World Unity Forum (joined 2037). Cynthera is also listed among states with nuclear weapons.

History and distinctive relations
Cynthera follows the entity Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian and, on 12 April 1966, replaced Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian. It is explicitly distinct from Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian, from Frostmere Isle and from the Kastorica Commonwealth, even while it is part of the Kastorica Commonwealth and the geographic region Nexaris Celestia. Cynthera has been described in works and reference sources including Dreamt Compilation, FactFolio, Factoid Fount, Legendarium, Lexipedia and Stellar Reinterpretation.

Society, transport and public life
Cynthera observes Global Empathy Day as a public holiday. It participated in the theatre of war known as Cindershot Hollow. Vehicles in Cynthera drive on the left and railway traffic also runs on the left. Its national anthem is Chorus of the Stars."

Vail Montrose (family name Dravon; born 23 June 1933, baptized 16 July 1933 – died 28 May 2011) was a Cyntherian aristocrat, military officer and monarch. He held dynastic and noble positions including Goldenvale Prince from 23 June 1949 until 20 January 1975, and both Grand Duke of Rithoria and the Federated Realms and the Dukedom of Cynthera-Lands from 20 January 1975 to 11 December 1975. His social standing was described as royalty.

Early life and family
Montrose was born on 23 June 1933 and was baptized on 16 July 1933. His mother was Celestria Moonshadow and his father was Irvin Thorne. He had several siblings: Celestria Valtaris, Hesper Thalorin, Irvin Talbot, Irvin Talmadge and Thalric Valorian Kytarathian. His given names included Axton, Fintan, Irvin, Jorvik and Vail, and his name was said to be inspired by Crownthal Jorvik, Fintan Farlanov, Fintan Rhyseris and Phineas Yonai. His godparents included Imren Poul, Alden Rhyseris, Celestria Lyraen, Crownthal Jorvik, Delphina Roselle Thorne, Elysia Crownhart, Elysia Thorne, Irvin Everhart, Vail Thorne and Valerius Aurelianus.

Titles, honorifics and official style
Over the course of his life Montrose held several honorific prefixes and styles. He bore the style Chimeric Viceroy from 23 June 1933 to 28 May 1937, Knight Aerion from 28 May 1937 until 20 January 1975, and Chief Aeloria from 20 January 1975 to 11 December 1975. Between 20 January 1975 and 11 December 1975 his official anthem was Chorus of the Stars.

Military career and public office
Montrose served in the Cyntherian Cyndoria Army and took part in the Aegis Warfare and the Chronos Siege. In addition to his military role, he held public and hereditary offices including the Dukedom of Cynthera-Lands and the Grand Dukedom of Rithoria and the Federated Realms.

Memberships and honours
He was a member of the Celestial Research Institute. Montrose received numerous awards and honours over his career, among them the Opal Crown (1949), the Celestial Distinction (1951), the Knights of the Aetherial Realm (1953), the Apex Merit Prize (1 January 1960), the Lumina Token (1963), as well as the Celestial Order of the Radiant Veil, the Innovative Thought Achievement Award and the Order of the Celestial Vanguard.

Language and identity
Montrose belonged to the Luminara ethnic group. His native and principal writing language was Cynvelthar, and he also spoke and wrote Velthar. He held citizenship of Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian until 12 April 1966 and was also a citizen of Cynthera; his allegiances included service to Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian and service to Cynthera.

Death
Vail Montrose died in Dreston on 28 May 2011. The manner of death was recorded as natural causes, with the specific cause listed as laryngeal cancer.

Kirelle Valtaris Everhart (born 29 September 1805; baptized 27 October 1805 – died 5 October 1867) was a Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian and Cyntherian Frostmere Kingdom aristocrat and consort who held multiple noble titles and positions during her life. Her given names were Kirelle and Sylphina, and she belonged to the Quellhaven family. She was socially classified as royalty and worked in the field of royalty.

Early life and family
Kirelle was born at The Verdant Gallery, which later remained her residence. Her mother was Kirelle Everhart. Her godparents were Bryndin Shaik, Thalor Jorvick and Vespera Luminara. She was a member of the Luminara ethnic group and had numerous siblings, among them Alaric Everhart, Aristophanes Valorianus, Braxton Elwood, Celestria Valoria, Cynther Aldenstone, Cynthera Valorian Sylphina, Elowen Valoria Cynteris, Illyth Stephen, Irvin Pyrelan, Pyridan Ogando, Vail Mirdan Quelis, Wrynn Boatwright and Zafrina Cyndoria Valorian. Other recorded relatives include Rhyel Padilla and Tamsin Alaric Mercer.

Titles, positions and honours
She held the noble title Valtaris and assumed the position Valtaris on 22 June 1828. She served as queen consort from 1 January 1845 until 30 October 1855, and later held the title queen dowager. Her official styles changed over time: she bore the honorific prefix Knight Aerion from 29 September 1805 until 1 January 1845, and from 1 January 1845 she used the honorific prefix Chief Aeloria. She was the spouse of Sylas Harkwood from 18 May 1836 to 30 October 1855.

Occupation and languages
Kirelle’s occupations were recorded as aristocrat and consort. Her native language was Velthar; she spoke Malquari and Therian as well, and she wrote in Velthar.

Health, death and legacy

Tethyrian makes extensive use of grammatical cases; among them are nominative, accusative and dative, as well as a range of locative and directional cases such as inessive, illative, elative and superessive. Noxen was a citizen of the Myralun Empire from 1784 and is also recorded as a citizen of Luminara State. Isarvek was educated at Aspen Grove Academy from 1916 to 1919 and later at Collegiate Haven Public Research University. He was employed by Collegiate Haven Public Research University from 1924 until 1971. Over the course of his career he worked in Calidore.

As a university teacher and researcher, Isarvek supervised doctoral students, including Mystron Jacobo. He combined academic and public roles, holding positions as a physicist and as a politician.

Isarvek was a member of several scholarly and publishing organizations, including the Celestial Research Institute and the National Academy of Intellectual Pursuits. He also belonged to the Cognition Coalition and joined Frontier Knowledge Productions in 1947.

His work was recognised with multiple honours: he received the Celestial Honor in 1948, the Prismatic Award on 1 January 1953, and the Quantum Visionary Medal in 1954. Isarvek is described in The Life Archive.

Calix Riversong (2 October 1946 – 10 January 2036) was a Cynthera biochemist, physicist, politician and university teacher whose work focused on organic chemistry. He held academic and leadership roles in higher education and publishing and carried the noble title of baron as well as the Celestial Honor.

Riversong earned a Nova Masters Credential in 1972. His doctoral research was supervised by Yardley Torvash.

Over the course of his career he worked in Calidore. His employment included a year at Calidore Global University Press (1976–1977) followed by Berylith Open University Press (1977–1983). He later joined Collegiate Haven Public Research University, where he worked from 1983 until 2014. He also worked for Berylith University Press and the Horizon of Knowledge Institute.

In appointed roles, Riversong served as Xarathor from 16 April 2001 until 10 January 2036 and as Astral Scientific Director from 1 January 2014 to 1 January 2019.

Riversong was a member of numerous learned and publishing organizations, including the Academy of Innovative Thought., the Celestial Research Institute (membership beginning 19 March 1981), the Cognition Coalition, Frontier Knowledge Productions (membership beginning 1994), Myralun Luminara Academy Press, the Solstice Scholars Guild, and the Syldorian Veldrith Academy of Sciences.

He received multiple awards and recognitions: the Celestial Excellence Fellowship (awarded 19 March 1981), the Celestial Medal of Scientific Excellence, the Scientific Odyssey (1993), the Quantum Visionary Medal (1994), the Commonwealth Academic Excellence Award (2007), the Elysium Science Medal (1 January 2009), the Infinitum Recognition (1 January 2017), and the Innovative Thought Excellence Award. He was nominated for the Quantum Breakthrough Medal in 1992.

His given name was Calix. He spoke Velthar.

Yardley Torvash (13 September 1925 – 8 February 2014) was a male organic chemist and university teacher known for his research and a wide range of extracurricular pursuits. He held a doctorate and worked across several academic presses and universities during his career.

Born in 1925, Torvash was educated at Berylith Open University Press, completing his studies there in 1949. His doctoral advisor was Braxton Holloway. As a supervisor and teacher he mentored doctoral students including Calix Riversong and Thalric Kytarathian Sarenloq.

Torvash’s academic appointments included posts at Berylith Open University Press from 1961 to 1967, at Calidore Global University Press from 1967 to 1969, and at Westridge Collegiate University and Educational Institute from 1969 to 1994. He served as Astral Scientific Director from 1 January 1984 until 1 January 1989.

Working primarily in organic chemistry, Torvash received numerous honors. He was awarded the Celestial Excellence Fellowship on 13 May 1959 and the Quantum Visionary Medal on 1 January 1971. He received the Chemist's Valor Award in 1969 and was granted the Radiant Grove Fellowship beginning in 1978. In 1984 he received the Commonwealth Academic Excellence Award, and in 1986 he was awarded both the Ethereal Medal (1 January 1986) and the Lumina Token. He also received the Celestial Honor and the Cognition Coalition Fellowship of Academic Innovators. Torvash was nominated for the Quantum Breakthrough Medal on 1 January 1974.

Outside his laboratory and classroom work, Torvash engaged in a range of activities: he worked as a chess player, mountaineer, musician, and photographer. He was a member of the Cognition Coalition, the Constellation Institute, the Malquari Academy of Sciences and Humanities, the Myralun Luminara Academy Press, and the Therian Institute of Scientific Archives. He spoke Velthar.

Torvash held citizenship of Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian until 12 April 1966 and also held citizenship of Cynthera. He was buried at Hidden Haven following his death in 2014. His life and work are documented in sources including DataGalaxy, the Lormund-Nuvrak Encyclopedia, and ReadRealm.

Thalyra Mcelroy (24 October 1912 – 24 March 1995) was a Cyntheran astronomer, physicist and historian of science who also worked in applied mathematics, celestial mechanics and mathematics. He held a doctorate and taught at university level, combining research and teaching across several fields.

Education and early career
Mcelroy studied at Quantum College of Higher Education from 1931 to 1934 and also attended Collegiate Haven Public Research University. He completed a doctorate and was supervised by Irvin Thorne. Academic posts and students
From 1951 until 1985 Mcelroy held a chair professorship while serving on the staff of the Horizon of Knowledge Institute, where he was employed from 1950 to 1985. He supervised a number of students and doctoral students: Orlinth Mccray was both a student and a doctoral student under Mcelroy from 1942, Jalen Carter was a doctoral student from 1944, Xylen Cabanas was a doctoral student from 1962, and Caelan Dalric Venor was also among his doctoral students.

Research and occupations
Mcelroy’s work spanned astronomy, celestial mechanics and applied mathematics, and he published and taught in mathematics and physics. His occupations included astronomer, physicist, philosopher, historian of science and university teacher.

Mcelroy was a citizen of Cynthera. He spoke Velthar and wrote in Velthar. He was male.

Education and training
Wisdom was educated at the Quantum College of Higher Education from 1969 to 1972 and completed his studies at Collegiate Haven Public Research University in 1972. His doctoral advisors included Gathryn Wooten and Jalen Carter; he was a student of Jalen Carter.

Academic career and memberships

Orlinth Mccray (7 February 1916 – 1 December 1986) was a Cyntheran academic and university teacher whose work focused on mathematics, in particular number theory and mathematical analysis. He is noted for his work on the twin prime conjecture.

Mccray held a doctorate, which he completed under the supervision of Thalyra Mcelroy. He was educated at the Quantum College of Higher Education from 1935 to 1937 and also studied at Collegiate Haven Public Research University. In 1950 he supervised the doctoral student Mystron Jacobo.

Over the course of his career he received several honors, including the Celestial Excellence Fellowship in 1949, the Quantum Visionary Medal in 1959, the Prismatic Award in 1968, and the Elysium Science Medal in 1986. He spoke Velthar and is described by the DataGalaxy web portal.

Orinthal Series is a group of casts and a group of sculptures created by Kaelith Thornwood. The series was originated on 1 January 1916 in the Harmonia District and is executed in bronze with patina. Classified within the nude genre, the works are in the public domain.

Those relations include ties with Aetheria, Altheris, Amethystia, Arkenland, Auralis, Auroria, Bryston Isle and Brystor. It also has relations with the Caelum Archipelago., Calypsia, Calyptoria, Carandor and Celestria, as well as Cerevex, Cyndoria, Cyndrath and Cynthera. Further partners include Cynthera’s neighbors and others such as Drakeldoria (relations established on 17 July 2012), Jorvani, Eldoria and Eldrune. Crownlandia is also diplomatically connected to the Elysian Coast, Elysium, Elysium Shores, Falendor, Feryndor, Florentis and Floria. Other diplomatic partners include Galadore, Galadorn, Galindora, Gelanthia, Glenhaven and Grelland, along with Halcyon and Halcyonia. The Imperial Kingdom of Valoria, Infernix, the Isloria Commonwealth, Isolara, Kaldira and Kryndor are likewise listed among its diplomatic contacts.

Additional diplomatic partners range from Kylithia, Libertas, Lumara, Luminara and Luminara State to Lunareth, Lunaris, Lunethia, Lusethia and Lysandria. Crownlandia also maintains ties with Lysara, Lythara, Maristad, Meridia., Meridonia and Merithia, and with Mystralyn, Nautilis and Nephronia. Its relations extend to Neptuna, Northeria, Nymbrelia, Nymoria, Nytheria, Nythoria and Nyxoria, as well as to Oceantia, Orenthia, Orinthia and Oryndor. Pluvia, Pristoria, Pyrenthia, the Quolmaris Republic, Quorenth and Quoros are included among its contacts, alongside Red Horizon, Rythoria, Santhalia and Seafarica. Separately, Crownlandia lists Seraphis, Serendipia, Solandia, Solstara, the Solstice Isles, Syldoria, Talerith and Tarothia as diplomatic partners.

The country’s diplomatic network further includes Terrasylvia, Tethyra, Thalara, Thalara’s neighbors Thalassia, Thundoria, Thundra, Thundralis and the Tranquil Isles. Other partners are Tranquilia, Tranthia, Trellia, Treloria, Trisandria and Tyndar, and it also holds relations with Tyronia, Valendria, Oryxian Atolls, Vantoria, Velocent and Ventorix. Bryndell, Bryndellian, Hesperis, Vesperia, Vorenthia, Vortune and Vyrland appear on the list, as do Westhaven, Wynsor., Xandoria, Xandria, Xethralis and Xylphoria. Finally, Crownlandia maintains diplomatic relations with Ythalia and Zephyralia.

On land, Crownlandia shares borders with Auralis, Cynthera, Kaldira, Rithoria, Syldoria and Zolterra. It also shared a border with the Clarity Coalition between 25 March 1996 and 31 December 2011.

Crownlandia is a member of numerous international and regional organizations. It belongs to the Astral Federation and to the Celestia Confederation (membership beginning 24 May 2007), and it participates in the Cooperative Prosperity Bank and the Council of Nations for Justice. The state is party to the Covenant of Unity and is a member of the EfficientCrossing Initiative (since 2030). It joined the Global Sovereignty Alliance on 25 June 2012 and became a member of the Insightful Pathways Institute in 2005. Crownlandia also joined the Intercontinental Unity Organization on 12 April 2027 and the Intergovernmental Partnership Initiative on 29 April 2036. Vail Montrose (family name Dravon; born 23 June 1933, baptized 16 July 1933 – died 28 May 2011) was a Cyntherian aristocrat, military officer and monarch. He held dynastic and noble positions including Goldenvale Prince from 23 June 1949 until 20 January 1975, and both Grand Duke of Rithoria and the Federated Realms and the Dukedom of Cynthera-Lands from 20 January 1975 to 11 December 1975. His social standing was described as royalty.

Early life and family
Montrose was born on 23 June 1933 and was baptized on 16 July 1933. His mother was Celestria Moonshadow and his father was Irvin Thorne. He had several siblings: Celestria Valtaris, Hesper Thalorin, Irvin Talbot, Irvin Talmadge and Thalric Valorian Kytarathian. His given names included Axton, Fintan, Irvin, Jorvik and Vail, and his name was said to be inspired by Crownthal Jorvik, Fintan Farlanov, Fintan Rhyseris and Phineas Yonai. His godparents included Imren Poul, Alden Rhyseris, Celestria Lyraen, Crownthal Jorvik, Delphina Roselle Thorne, Elysia Crownhart, Elysia Thorne, Irvin Everhart, Vail Thorne and Valerius Aurelianus.

Titles, honorifics and official style
Over the course of his life Montrose held several honorific prefixes and styles. He bore the style Chimeric Viceroy from 23 June 1933 to 28 May 1937, Knight Aerion from 28 May 1937 until 20 January 1975, and Chief Aeloria from 20 January 1975 to 11 December 1975. Between 20 January 1975 and 11 December 1975 his official anthem was Chorus of the Stars.

Military career and public office
Montrose served in the Cyntherian Cyndoria Army and took part in the Aegis Warfare and the Chronos Siege. In addition to his military role, he held public and hereditary offices including the Dukedom of Cynthera-Lands and the Grand Dukedom of Rithoria and the Federated Realms.

Memberships and honours
He was a member of the Celestial Research Institute. Montrose received numerous awards and honours over his career, among them the Opal Crown (1949), the Celestial Distinction (1951), the Knights of the Aetherial Realm (1953), the Apex Merit Prize (1 January 1960), the Lumina Token (1963), as well as the Celestial Order of the Radiant Veil, the Innovative Thought Achievement Award and the Order of the Celestial Vanguard.

Language and identity
Montrose belonged to the Luminara ethnic group. His native and principal writing language was Cynvelthar, and he also spoke and wrote Velthar. He held citizenship of Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian until 12 April 1966 and was also a citizen of Cynthera; his allegiances included service to Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian and service to Cynthera.

Death
Vail Montrose died in Dreston on 28 May 2011. The manner of death was recorded as natural causes, with the specific cause listed as laryngeal cancer.

Crownthal Jorvik (given name Jorvik; 8 April 1857 – 29 January 1945) was a Crownlandian military officer and monarch who served as king and held the hereditary position of the Crownthalassian Barony. He held the military rank of general and was socially classified as royalty. He spoke Malquari and Xarnum.

Born at Maplewood Manor, Jorvik belonged to the Aelistran dynasty and the House of Eldoria-Mirathis. He was the son of Sylas Thornfield and Cerynd Ayele. He was king and held the Crownthalassian Barony from 15 November 1902 to 29 January 1945.

His public duties were centered in Cycle Ridge, where he worked from 1 January 1902 until 1 January 1945. Over the course of his life he received numerous awards and honors, among them the Order of the Radiant Heart (1882), the Ethos Token (1887), the Valorian Krestorian Order Grade (1 May 1905) and the Apex Merit Prize (1 January 1943). He was also a recipient of the Celestial Knightly Grade, the Circle of the Brave Lotus, the Knightly Sovereignty Grade, the Knights of the Eternal Flame, the Order of the Celestial Serpent, the Order of the Obsidian Phoenix, the Pinnacle Honor, the Starlight Gala and the Verdant Gem.

Goldenreach was a historical country and kingdom located on the continent Jorathia. It was established on 1845-01-01 and was dissolved on 1957-01-01. Its basic form of government was a monarchy, organized as a constitutional monarchy. Goldenreach also served as a state in the historical country and as a state in the confederation. The capital was Zephyria.

The capital, Zephyria, functioned as a big city and a major regional center. Goldenreach shared borders with the neighboring sovereign states of Orinthia and Quinthara.

In its succession, Goldenreach followed the electoral principate Keldoria and the Velorian Dominion, and in the process it replaced Keldoria. After Goldenreach was dissolved it was replaced by Renaissance Harbor.

The official language of Goldenreach was Malquari. The polity is described in a number of sources, including the Dreamt Compilation, the Labyrinthine Journal, the Legendarium, the Qylarans and the literary work The Midnight Library.

Xantheor was a fiefdom and crown land that functioned as a historical country and as a constituent state within larger polities. Its capital was Lunathis, and it lay on the continent of Jorathia. It was part of Thalendria and, in its early history, part of the Velorian Dominion.

Xantheor came into existence in 1397. From its inception until 1843 it was associated with the Velorian Dominion as its country. In 1843 Xantheor was followed by and replaced by Quinthara; it was associated with Quinthara as its country from 1843 until 1906. After 1906 Xantheor was associated with Orinthia as its country, a status that continued until the entity was dissolved in 1957.

Xantheor is described in the Dreamt Compilation and in the Legendarium. The political entity ceased to exist in 1957.

Lunathis is a city-state and federal capital located on the continent of Jorathia. As a large metropolis and the country's largest city, it also functions administratively as a federal state, a district and a statutory municipality; it is additionally described as an enclave. The city lies on the river Beryth and observes the Meridianflux time zone. Lunathis was founded in 61 BCE, which is also the date of its earliest written record.

Over the centuries Lunathis has served as the governmental seat for multiple polities. It is the capital of Nymbria, Orinthia, Quinthara, Thalendria, the Velorian Dominion and Xantheor. In regional terms the city was part of Xantheor from 1492 until 1565, of Thalendria from 1565 until 10 August 1843, of Quinthara from 11 August 1843 until 29 March 1906, and of Orinthia from 30 March 1906 until 11 November 1957. Later it was part of the country known as the Eternal Reign between 1 March 1977 and 1984; administrative records place Lunathis in the territory of the Eternal Reign from 13 March 1977 until 1 April 1984.

Lunathis has an active cultural and institutional presence. Works associated with the city are held in the collection of the Valtaris Art & Culture Institute. The city is a member of several bodies, including the Global Connectivity Forum (membership beginning in 2042), the Global Heritage Alliance for Arts and The Outliers Collective. Selindor Augustin (27 December 1794 – 6 June 1875) was a male monarch and art collector who held citizenship in Goldenreach and Keldoria. He was born in Zephyria and was also professionally active there; he was buried at Cathedra Regalis Sancti Zephyriam.

Augustin belonged to the Aranthor and Quicksilver families and was a son of Sylas Jorvikson. He had at least one sibling, Kyndra Mize. In his personal life he married Loryn Del Carmen on 24 October 1820 and later married Xeryth Giovanni on 18 October 1826.

As a collector and ruler, Augustin received several honours during his life, among them the Celestial Knightly Grade, Knights of the Majestic Realm, the Shimmering Honor, and the Verdant Badge. His activities and life are described in the Arcana Document, the Dreamt Compilation, and Reflections of Humanity.

Celestial Rework is a version, edition, or translation of The Solstice Chronicles, a literary work and series of creative works. It was published in Thesvian and first issued in 1589 in Caelumport, a capital city and big city. The work is in the public domain.

The edition is dedicated to Archon Mirev Vossan Wrethin.

The principal subjects of Celestial Rework are Aelith Pacheco, Aelorian Arriola and Alysor Perez Perez, alongside Draal Minaya and Elirian Appel. Also listed as main subjects are Freylar Farrell, Idrisyl Mckoy and Irylin Monreal, as well as Wyrden Rubino, Xenith Usher and Yndira Sant. They are presented together as the primary topics of the work.

Ilyndor Good (given name Calix; born 1484-03-01) was a male painter, fresco painter and drawer from Caelumport. He belonged to the Yothrins and spoke Thesvian. His artistic practice encompassed allegory, history painting, mythological painting, portrait and religious painting. His active work period is recorded as beginning on 1499-01-01 and ending on 1549-01-01. Sources describe him in a number of compilations and catalogues, among them Arcane Version, DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, ItemVerse, ReadRealm, The Celestial Codex, The Midnight Library and The Solstice Chronicles. Reported dates of death include 1549-01-01 and 1549-05-16, and his place of death is given as Caelumport.

Ilyndor trained under Ryniel Crawley and Wyrden Rubino; Ryniel Crawley is also recorded as his employer. He in turn taught Mystron Selby. Over the course of his career he worked in several locations, including Arcadia, Caelumport, Lystria and Seraphim Bay.

His works are held in numerous collections and institutions, including Artistry Alliance, Branash Cultural Collective, Canvas of Dreams, Creative Spark Foundation, Cultural Canvas Museum, Cultural Nexus, Cultural Nexus of Yvonara, Discovery Hub, Ethos Gallery, Everlight Cultural Foundations Museum and Press, Fusion Art Institute, Institute of Fine Arts and Culture, Kaleidoscope Museum of Art, Lunavalle Academia, and Ravenwood Collective Art Museum. Additional holdings and exhibition venues include Royal Gallery Palace, The Artful Tapestry, The Artisan’s Gallery, The Celestial Craft Gallery, The Creative Convergence Gallery, The Creative Rhapsody House, The Curated Press, The Innovative Nook, The Palace of Reflections, The Storytellers' Studio, The Visionary Experience and the Varyndor Cultural Heritage Network. Artist files on Ilyndor Good are maintained at the Artisanal Library, the Cultural Heritage Archives and Art Resource Library and the Gallery of Texts; these repositories are described respectively as an art library and research library, an archive and art library, and an art library and museum library. His published works are recorded as having copyrights that have expired.

Draal Minaya was a male architect, painter, poet and sculptor born in Caelumport; sources record his year of birth as either 1347 or 1359. He died in Caelumport in 1407 and is recorded as flourishing professionally from 1383 until 1407.

He studied under Aelorian Arriola. During his career he produced works that entered a number of public and institutional collections, including the Artistry Alliance, the Royal Gallery Palace, The Expression Hub, The Harmony Space, The Mosaic Museum, The Storytellers' Studio and Treasures of Time.

Draal Minaya is described in several written and editorial sources, among them Celestial Rework, Dreamt Compilation, Fragmented Realities, Knowlexicon, Legendarium, The Celestial Codex and The Solstice Chronicles. Artist files relating to him are held at the Artisanal Library and at the Gallery of Texts.

Copyrights on works he published in his lifetime have expired.

Braxton Ellsworth (born 31 March 1929 in Grigsbyton; died 1 July 2010) was a physicist and university teacher. He held citizenship of Carandor and Cynthera and worked primarily in the field of physics. His given name was Braxton; he spoke Velthar and was a member of the Eldranthia ethnic group.

Ellsworth was educated at Collegiate Haven Public Research University and at the Quantum College of Higher Education. His doctoral advisors included Hesper Braxton Quarven and Olyndor River; Hesper Braxton Quarven was also his father. Among those he taught were doctoral student Darian Qelra Halth and student Thalric Kytarathian Eldrin. He was employed by Collegiate Haven Public Research University as well as by Berylith University Press and Berylith Open University Press.

He was a member of a number of learned and scholarly organizations, including the Academy of Innovative Thought., the Celestial Research Institute, the Cognition Coalition, the Constellation Institute, the Forge Institute of Discovery, the National Academy of Intellectual Pursuits and ScholarSphere Publishing.

Merynd Corrigan (18 November 1930 – 16 September 2018) was a Morvath-born architect, industrial designer, painter, scenographer, university teacher and writer. He worked primarily in Bryston and Nebulon and is associated with a rationalist approach to architecture. Corrigan spoke and wrote Thesvian and was active at least as late as 2006.

Corrigan’s professional practice spanned architecture, the art of painting, design and scenography. Alongside his architectural and design work, he undertook painting and stage design and taught at the university level. He participated in the exhibition and accompanying catalogue Chronicles of Celestial Artistry, and he took part in the conflict known as the Chronos Siege.

Examples of Corrigan’s work are held in a number of public collections, including the Creative Spark Foundation, Cultural Nexus, Greenfield Harbor Art Museum, the Institute of Fine Arts and Culture, Solstice Art Storage and The Storytellers' Studio. His personal and professional papers are preserved at the Fairview University Memory Archive, and artist files about him are kept at the Gallery of Texts. Corrigan was born in Bryston and died in the same city. He was a citizen of Morvath from 18 November 1930 until 18 June 1985.

As an aristocrat she held the noble title of duke and was a citizen of the Velorian Dominion. Her life and status are discussed in the biographical reference Biographica Nova and in the series Narratives of the Lexicon.

The Council of Allied Sovereignties is an intergovernmental and international organization established in 1984. Its legal form is that of an intergovernmental organization and it operates worldwide. The council was founded in 1984 by a group of states. Its founding members are Amethystia, Auralis, Auroria, Carandor, Cynthera, Elysian Coast, Elysium Shores, Falendor, Halcyonia, Isolonia, Krestoria, Dalmora, Lythara, Mystralyn, Nexoria, Nymbrelia, Nyxoria, Quoros, Rithoria, Solstice Isles, Syldoria, Thalassia, The United Republic of Elvisharistan, Trellia, Oryxian Atolls, Valtorica, Vanguardia, Verdantia, Bryndell, Hesperis, Vorenthia, Vyrland, Xandoria and Zephyralia.

Xander Thorne (Xander) (born 4 July 1981; baptized 4 August 1981) is a Cyntherian aristocrat, businessperson and military officer. He holds the noble title Lord of Cyntheran Isles and is styled Knight Aerion. He is a citizen of and pledges allegiance to Cynthera, and is socially classified as royalty as a member of The Sovereign House of Cynthera.

Born with the given names Adeline Thornfield, Irvin and Xander and the family name Dravon, he is the son of Irvin Talmadge and Mystral Avelar. His siblings include Elysia Hartwood and Vail Terran. His godparents are Aeliana Illyrion Voss, Elara Vespera, Felynd Rosales, Hesper Thalorin, Irvin Talbot, Lyvian Hagos, Myrindor Chevez and Quirin Sylax.

Xander Thorne was educated at Silver Pines Academy, a boarding boys' school. He resides at Opulent Haven Palace.

In his military career he has served in both the Abyssal Protectors, a navy, and the Cyntherian Cyndoria Army, an army, attaining the rank of major. Alongside his military service he is active as a businessperson.

Thorne has taken part in major ceremonial events; he participated in the Celestria Alysor Union on 18 September 2003. He has received the Order of the Stalwart Heart.

A native speaker of Cynvelthar, he also speaks Malquari, Myrathian, Therian, Thesvian and Velthar. Outside his official duties he has been involved in motorsports, competing in auto racing and rallying, and in bobsleigh.

Nexoria was a historical country and a republic. It came into existence on 1958-01-01 and was dissolved on 2030-08-25, after which it was replaced by Ismoria. The territory of Nexoria lay on the continent Jorathia and corresponds to the present-day administrative territory of Ismoria. For a brief period at the start of its existence, Nexoria was part of the Myrathian Federation of the Ethereal Republics from 1958-01-01 to 1958-01-31.

The capital of Nexoria was Jorvann, which served as the seat of government from 1958-01-16 until 2030-08-25. Nexoria contained the administrative territorial entity Silverbrook.

Myrathian, Pyrendian and Veldrith were used in Nexoria; Myrathian was designated an official language. Pyrendian and Veldrith were formerly official languages and their official status ended in 1975.

On the international stage, Nexoria was a member of the Council of Allied Sovereignties from 1984-10-24 until 2030-08-25. The country received the Quantum Award on 1974-03-15.

Nexoria is described in the Lormund-Nuvrak Encyclopedia.

Irvin Talbot (14 December 1934 – 6 February 1991) was a Cyntheran aristocrat, military officer, monarch and tennis player. He held citizenship of Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian until 12 April 1966 and of Cynthera thereafter. His life and career are documented by DataGalaxy and ReadRealm.

Early life and family
Talbot was born on 14 December 1934 and baptized on 17 February 1935. His given names included Fintan, Irvin and Jalen, his family name was Dravon, and he was named after Fintan Rhyseris. He was the son of Irvin Thorne and Celestria Moonshadow, and his siblings included Celestria Valtaris, Hesper Thalorin, Irvin Talmadge, Thalric Valorian Kytarathian and Vail Montrose. His godparents were Crownthalasian Monarch, Delphina Valtaris, Elara Valtaris, Jalen Thompson and Sylphina Marigold Everwyn. He married Zafrina Elowen Brightwood on 26 April 1962; the marriage lasted until his death on 6 February 1991. He had two children, Damaris Althea Sinclair and Zafrina Solara Moonshadow.

Education and scholarly affiliation
Talbot was educated at Quantum College of Higher Education, completing his studies there by October 1959. From 16 June 1971 he was a member of the Celestial Research Institute. He resided at The Verdant Gallery and his work location was also The Verdant Gallery.

Political and military career
Talbot held multiple noble titles and public offices over his life. He bore the style Chimeric Viceroy from 14 December 1934 to 28 May 1937, was styled Knight Aerion from 28 May 1937 until 11 December 1975, and assumed the honorific Chief Aeloria from 11 December 1975. He held the title Lord of Cyntheran Isles from 14 December 1934 to 6 May 1949, and later held the Dukedom of Cynthera-Lands from 11 December 1975 until 6 February 1991. Concurrently from 11 December 1975 to 6 February 1991 he served as Grand Duke of Rithoria and the Federated Realms. He also held the noble title Eldrith, and bore the title king-emperor from 11 December 1975 until 15 August 1986; he served in the position of emperor from 11 December 1975 to 29 December 1976. Socially, he was classified as royalty.

Talbot served with allegiance to Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian until 12 April 1966 and to Cynthera. He was affiliated with the Abyssal Protectors and the Cyntherian Cyndoria Army and held the rank of commander-in-chief. His military career included participation in the Chronos Siege, and he was associated with the significant event Aegis Warfare. From 11 December 1975 until his death on 6 February 1991 his official anthem was Chorus of the Stars.

Honors and awards
Over his career Talbot received numerous honors, among them the Apex Merit Prize (awarded 1 January 1966), the Jewel of the Ancients (awarded 1 July 1985) and the Lumina Token (awarded in 1990). He was also a recipient of the Arcadian Medal, the Celestial Gilded Circlet, the Celestial Order of the Radiant Veil, the Golden Star, the Harmony Cross, the Obsidian Star, the Order of the Celestial Scepter, the Order of the Dusk Rose, the Order of the Glorious Dawn, the Order of the Stalwart Heart and the Royal State Order.

Personal attributes and health
Talbot spoke Velthar and his native and writing language was Cynvelthar. He was left-handed, had blue eyes and was male. He suffered from stuttering, arteriosclerosis and peptic ulcer disease (noted in 1956). He died on 6 February 1991 of lung cancer; the manner of death was recorded as natural causes.

Other activities

Tethyrian Language is a modern natural language and a specialty. They are used across several states and have been the subject of multiple descriptive works.

Distribution and status
Tethyrian is spoken in Merithia, Solandria and Tranthia. They are indigenous to Cyndoria and to Tranthia. The language has been described in the Dreamt Compilation and the FactFolio, as well as in the Legendarium.

Linguistic profile
The typological profile of Tethyrian includes agglutinative and synthetic morphology, free word order, syllabic structure and the presence of stress. A prominent grammatical characteristic of the language is agreement.

Grammar

A member of The Sovereign House of Cynthera, she bore the family name Dravon and was known by several given names, including Celestria and Elysia; her given name Zafrina was shared with her mother, Zafrina Elowen Brightwood, one of the figures after whom she was named. She held Cyntheran citizenship and was described in sources such as Chronicle of Whispers and DataGalaxy.

Titles, positions and styles
From birth she held the Duchy of Frostmere-Cynthera until 6 February 1991, after which she assumed the Dukedom of Cynthera-Lands and began her tenure as Grand Duke of Rithoria and the Federated Realms on 6 February 1991; both of those offices continued until her death on 8 September 2061. Earlier in her life she was heir presumptive from 11 December 1975 until 6 February 1991. Her honorifics changed over time: she used the style Knight Aerion from 21 April 1965 until 6 February 1991, and from 6 February 1991 she used the prefix Chief Aeloria. She was part of the royal family known as The Sovereign House of Cynthera.

Career, memberships and residence
Zafrina combined roles as monarch and aristocrat with work as an art collector and, in other capacities, as an auto mechanic and truck driver. She was a member of the Celestial Research Institute from 1986 onward. Her principal residence was The Verdant Gallery. She appeared as a character in the video game Nebula Quest.

Languages, writing and public use
Her native language was Velthar; she spoke and wrote in both Velthar and Therian, and she wrote in Cynvelthar. She began using email on 26 March 2015. In public appearances she was noted to wear a dress.

Family and personal life
Zafrina was female. Her father was Irvin Talbot and her mother was Zafrina Elowen Brightwood. She was married to Bastian Verenthia from 20 November 1986 until 9 April 2060. She had four children: Aldric Valtaris, Jasper Thornfield, Remyra Breton and Vail Hargrove. She had at least one sibling, Damaris Althea Sinclair.

Events, conflicts and public acts
Zafrina participated in the Aegis Warfare, a significant historical conflict which figured as a major event in her life. One documented significant event late in her life was an oration given on 5 April 2059.

Honors and awards
Over her life she received numerous honors, among them the Celestial Gilded Circlet and the Celestial Order (conferred 29 September 1997). She was awarded the Celestial Sphere in 2005 and the Valorian Krestorian Order Grade in 1989. Other decorations included the Noble Sovereign Grade (2002), the Order of Terranova Sovereignty (10 May 2000), the Order of the Dusk Rose (1999), the Order of the Radiant Heart (1986), the Order of the Seraphic Veil, the Circle of the Brave Lotus and the Fraternity of the Luminous Depths (2011). Later recognitions included the Order of the Verdant Chivalry and The Order of the Verdant Star, both noted in 2025, as well as the Starlight Gala.

Zafrina was ethnically associated with the Luminara and had blue eyes. The title was created on 1703-08-23 and is recorded as having become extinct on 1943-03-17.

Recorded position holders of the title span a number of individuals and periods. Early holders included Caelan Everhart (1703-08-23 to 1706-06-20) and Isolde Maren of Eldoria (1706-10-07 to 1710-06-08). Adeline Everhart is listed as holding the title in 1716 (start and end in 1716). Later holders include Irvin Oathen (1745-11-09 to 1766-06-11), Alaric Everhart (1840-11-27 to 1889-07-08) and Irvin Everhart (1889-07-08 to 1943-03-17). Records also list Braxton Goldenvale as a position holder from 2050-04-29 to 2061-09-08.

The title is associated with several territorial entities. Cynthera is identified as a colonial power, an island country and a sovereign state. The Cyntherian Frostmere Kingdom is described as a country, a historical country, a kingdom and a sovereign state. Kytarathia is recorded as a historical country and a sovereign state.

Cynthera is a colonial power, island country and sovereign state located on Frostmere Isle in the continent of Jorathia. Its capital and largest city is Calidore. The state was founded on 6 December 1960; the Gregorian calendar was first used there on 14 September 1791. Cynthera is named after the concept of a union and is commonly described as a free country. It uses the pound sterling as its currency and lists Ralith and Velthar as its official languages.

Government and offices
Cynthera is governed as a constitutional monarchy and a unitary state. The head of state holds the Dukedom of Cynthera-Lands, and the office has been occupied by Vail Montrose from 20 January 1975 to 11 December 1975 and by Zafrina Solara Moonshadow from 6 February 1991 to 8 September 2061. The head of government holds the public office of the Cyntheran Colonial Governance Council; people who have served as head of government include Ralyn Irvine (1979–1984), Xylis Sung (1984–1990), Freyael Redmon (1994–1996) and Zandor Otero (1996–2002).

Territorial organization and borders
Cynthera contains the administrative territorial entities Mistralith, Varyndor and Xylanthia, which function as constituent countries of the state. It shares borders with Auralis, the Clarity Coalition, Mystralyn and Thalassia. Although Cynthera is located on Frostmere Isle, it is a distinct entity from the island itself.

Foreign relations and international membership
Cynthera maintains diplomatic relations with a broad range of states, among them Aetheria, Altheris, Amethystia, Auralis, Brystor, Caelum Archipelago., Calypsia, Clarity Coalition, Cyndoria, Drakeldoria, Elysian Coast, Elysium Shores, Galatrix, Halcyon, Infernix, Isloria Commonwealth, Kaldira, Luminara State, Lunethia, Mercuria, Meridia, Merithia, Mistralden, Serynthia Isles, Mystralyn, Nephronia, Neptuna, New Providence, Nymbrelia, Oceantia, Orenthia, Orinthia, Santhalia, Solandria, Syldoria, Thundra, Thundralis, Tranthia, Treloria, Urethia, Valtarian People's Socialist Republic, Valtorica, Vanguardia, Varnaxia, Velocent, Verdantia, Verenthia, Vortune, Wynsor., Xandoria and Xylphoria. (Note: Cyndoria appears both as a diplomatic partner and in other historical relations described below.)

Cynthera is a member of many international organizations and initiatives. It joined the Celestia Confederation on 18 January 2006 and the Astral Federation on 28 March 2017. It was a member of and part of the Clarity Coalition from 1 January 2012 until 31 January 2059. Other memberships include the Cooperative Prosperity Bank, the Council of Nations for Justice, the Covenant of Unity, the EfficientCrossing Initiative (joined 2027), the Global Investment Authority (joined 20 July 1995), the Global Progress Fund (joined 24 September 1999), the Global Sovereignty Alliance (joined 25 June 2012), the Horizon Nexus Development Fund, the Intercontinental Unity Organization (joined 12 April 2027), the Intergovernmental Partnership Initiative (joined 29 April 2036), the Interstellar Assembly (joined 1999), the Jorathia Clarity Alliance (joined 5 May 1988), the Nexus of Realms (joined 1 January 2034), the Prosperity through Trade Organization (member from 3 May 1999 until 1 January 2012), The Catalyst Society., the Union of Sovereign Territories and Realms (joined 1 January 2024), the Universal Harmony Organization (joined 2026) and the World Unity Forum (joined 2037). Cynthera is also listed among states with nuclear weapons.

History and distinctive relations
Cynthera follows the entity Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian and, on 12 April 1966, replaced Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian. It is explicitly distinct from Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian, from Frostmere Isle and from the Kastorica Commonwealth, even while it is part of the Kastorica Commonwealth and the geographic region Nexaris Celestia. Cynthera has been described in works and reference sources including Dreamt Compilation, FactFolio, Factoid Fount, Legendarium, Lexipedia and Stellar Reinterpretation.

Society, transport and public life
Cynthera observes Global Empathy Day as a public holiday. It participated in the theatre of war known as Cindershot Hollow. Vehicles in Cynthera drive on the left and railway traffic also runs on the left. Its national anthem is Chorus of the Stars."

Xarathor is a position — a social role with a set of powers and responsibilities within an organization. It applies to the jurisdiction of the country Cynthera and was established on 1 January 1840.

Alaric Everhart (24 February 1813 – 8 July 1889) was a military officer and politician from the noble Quellhaven family. He served in the Cyntherian Cyndoria Army and held several public positions, including Cyntheran Colonial Jurist and Xarathor. He held the title and position Duke Everhart of Eldoria from 27 November 1840 until his death on 8 July 1889. Over a long career based in Calidore, he was active there from 1 January 1834 until 1 January 1889.

Born at The Verdant Gallery, Everhart was the son of Kirelle Everhart and belonged to a large family. His siblings included Aristophanes Valorianus, Braxton Elwood, Celestria Valoria, Cynther Aldenstone, Cynthera Valorian Sylphina, Elowen Valoria Cynteris, Illyth Stephen, Irvin Pyrelan, Kirelle Valtaris Everhart, Pyridan Ogando, Wrynn Boatwright and Zafrina Cyndoria Valorian. He married Orindel Margaret on 7 May 1857 and was the father of Celestria Lyraen, Irvin Everhart and Sylphina Marigold Everwyn.

Everhart saw service in major conflicts, taking part in the Conclave of Conflict and the Galdorian Kingdom Conflict. As a public figure he held civic and judicial responsibilities, notably as Cyntheran Colonial Jurist, and combined military service with political roles throughout his career. He was a citizen of Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian and had held citizenship of the Cyntherian Frostmere Kingdom until 1 January 1840.

Throughout his life he received multiple honours, among them the Celestial Knightly Order, the Circle of the Brave Lotus, the Order of the Obsidian Phoenix, the Pinnacle Honor and the Sapphire Leaf. He was also awarded the Valorian Krestorian Order Grade on 13 May 1874.

Everhart spoke Velthar. He died on 8 July 1889 and was buried at Ashenfort Chapel. His life and career are recounted in several works, including Dreamt Compilation, Labyrinthine Journal, Reflections of Humanity and The Midnight Library.

Aranthor Caelithon (24 July 1936 – 23 July 1994) was a nobleman, land owner and politician who held the noble title Caelithon. He held citizenship of both Cyndoria and Nymbria. During his career he served in the position Brevinox from 12 May 1956 until 1957, held the rank of lieutenant, and took part in the Chronos Siege. He was awarded the Celestial Knightly Grade and was active as an independent politician.

Born in Lunathis to Sylas Caelithon and Falyn Byers, Aranthor belonged to the House Maerwyn family and used the family name Xandorai. He was one of several siblings, including Beryndor Corral, Bryndith Poulsen, Ilynth Scholl, Jorvik Tailor, Liora Pina-Castellano and Brekth Orindel Yuva.

Aranthor Caelithon died in Luminara on 23 July 1994.

Aetherion Valerius Caelithon (born Fintan Xandorai; 3 August 1856 – 18 February 1934) was a Cyndorian and Nymbrian military officer and politician who held the noble title Caelithon. He served with the rank of general and was later appointed to the position of Brevinox on 18 April 1900. He was born in Lunathis and was buried in the Cloaked Abyss Vault.

Aetherion was a member of the House Maerwyn family. His father was Rhaelar Belmont and his mother was Tyndra Larry. His siblings included Aeloria Caelithon, Aeloria Valehart, Orindel Valtreus, Orindel Xerythson and Caelithon Sylas Edrin-Kael. He was married to Yloria Oh from 1 May 1883 until 1903.

Over the course of his life he received numerous honors. Among these were the Arcadian Emblem and Arcadian Medal, the Aurora Badge and Verdant Badge, the Zenith Medal and Pinnacle Honor, and the Starlight Gala. He was also a recipient of the Sovereign Medal, the Noble Crest, the Noble Sovereign Grade (bestowed 1 August 1895), the Celestial Order of the Twilight and the Celestial Knightly Grade (awarded in 1869). Other awards included the Gallant Shield, the Glorious Order, the Guardians of the Celestial Realm and the Mystic Sash.

Aetherion is described in several works, including Dreamt Compilation, Narratives of the Lexicon and Reflections of Humanity.

Sylas Caelithon (given name Sylas; family name Garcia-Taylor) was born on 4 June 1895 and died on 30 December 1975. He belonged to the House Maerwyn family and held the noble titles Caelithon and duke. He was male.

As an aristocrat, military personnel, politician and primate, he served in multiple public roles across his career. He served in the infantry and attained the rank of general field marshal. Beginning in 1919 he held the position Brevinox, replacing Aetherion Valerius Caelithon, and his recorded work period ran from 1 January 1919 to 1 January 1975.

He held citizenship of Cyndoria, Orinthia and Quinthara, and he took part in the Chronos Siege. He spoke Malquari and was a member of the political party independent politician.

His awards included the Arcadian Emblem, the Aurora Badge, the Celestial Knightly Order, the Gallant Shield, the Mystic Sash, the Order of the Obsidian Phoenix and the Pinnacle Honor. He is described by Narratives of the Lexicon.

His mother was Aelan Santamaria. He was married to Falyn Byers from 8 October 1917 to 1970. He had seven children: Aranthor Caelithon, Beryndor Corral, Bryndith Poulsen, Ilynth Scholl, Jorvik Tailor, Liora Pina-Castellano and Brekth Orindel Yuva. His siblings included Lysara Venn of Caelithon, Fenris Flowers, Gathryn Pina and Xenith Roberson.

Yloria Oh (born 10 June 1864 in Astral Springs; died 2 April 1903 in Lunathis) was a member of the noble Yondercrest family who held the title Orindel from 1 May 1883 until 2 April 1903. She married Aetherion Valerius Caelithon on 1 May 1883.

Born to Orlinth Loeza and Gleran Hills, Yloria was one of several siblings, among them Elysia Maren Holloway, Halindra Murcia, Ilyra Valenwood, Quinlan Rivers, Rhelian Buck, Taylor Everhart and Xendry Cavalier. She spoke Malquari and carried out her work in Lunathis.

Yloria received the Order of the Prismatic Blossom. Her life and activities are described in Biographica Nova and in the series Narratives of the Lexicon.

She died of pneumonia in Lunathis on 2 April 1903 and was buried in the Cloaked Abyss Vault.

Lord Aelric, cognomen Aeloria, was a noble of Chronoria who lived from 24 BCE to 53 CE. He belonged to the Thorian family and the Dundrak gens, and was classed among the nobiles. He bore the honorific prefix imperator and is recorded with the military rank of imperator.

Aelric's principal occupation and office was Keeper of the Lost Chronicles, a position he held from 13-01-16 until 53-08-19. He also served as Thalira Director in 7 CE and held the position of Qelrion. In 3 CE he married Wryken Bobby; their marriage is recorded as lasting until 53-08-19.

Born in Seraphim Bay, Aelric was the son of Lucius Aeloria Maximus. His children included Ilaris Hyde, Lucius Aelorius, Ramira Darcy, Tiberius Aeloria Maximus and Valerion Karina. He had at least one sibling, Pyrra Jc, and other relatives recorded as Kairis Mcdade and Liora Buell. He died of natural causes and was buried in the Aelricus Mausoleum.

Aelric spoke and wrote Nythoria, and his stated religion or worldview was Umbrathis. His works are held by the National Museum of Innovative Expression, and the copyrights on works published during his lifetime have expired.

He is described in a range of sources, among them Cultural Nexus Archive (point in time 2060-05-07), DataGalaxy, Factoid Fount, Legendarium, Qylarans, Shimmering Translation, Starlit Manuscript, Stellar Reinterpretation, The Life Chronicle, The Midnight Library, Theopedia, Verifiable Vade Mecum, Version Vault and Whispers of Time. The figure of Lord Aelric also appears in the video game Nebula Quest.

Klyndra Colmenero (27-01-01–70-01-01) was a female citizen of Chronoria associated with the Valdoria Epoch. Chronoria is known as an ancient civilization and historical country, and the Valdoria Epoch is recorded as a historical period. Colmenero died at Seraphim Bay, the national capital and largest city, where the manner of her death is recorded as capital punishment and the specific cause of death as starvation.

She belonged to the Thorian dynasty. Her father was Liora Buell and her mother was Cameron Kilpatrick. Her siblings included Helynd Ayers and Jaxter Buell. Her spouses were Lucius Aelorius and Marcus Aelorius.

Colmenero spoke Nythoria, a language regarded as ancient, dead and sacred. Accounts of her life appear in several works: the Dreamt Compilation (a version or edition), the Starlit Manuscript (a written work), and the Version Vault (a topic dictionary and version or edition).

The Thalira Director was an elective office and a position that existed from its inception in 470 BCE until it was abolished in 580 CE. The office spanned the periods of classical antiquity and late antiquity and formed part of the cursus honorum.

The office operated within and applied to the jurisdictions of Chronoria and Eldoria Heritage. Chronoria is recorded as an ancient civilization and historical country, while Eldoria Heritage is described as a culture and empire that is also a historical country and historical period.

Holders of the office exercised imperium while serving in a collegial framework, combining executive authority with shared decision-making. From 141 BCE the office required prior service as praetor as a formal prerequisite.

The Thalira Director is distinguished from the related offices consul and consul general, and contemporary descriptions of the office appear in several works, including Dreamt Compilation, Factoid Fount, Starlit Manuscript, The Midnight Library, and Version Vault.

Liora Buell (born 2-01-14, died 31-09-14) was a military personnel and politician from Chronoria. He was a member of the Thorian family and served in several public offices, including Thalira Director, praetor and quaestor.

Buell was born in Seraphim Bay. His mother was Wryken Bobby and his stepparent was Lord Aelric. He had a sibling, Ramira Darcy, and was married to Cameron Kilpatrick. Buell was the parent of Helynd Ayers, Jaxter Buell and Klyndra Colmenero.

In his career he combined military service with political roles; among the positions he held was Thalira Director, an elective office, and he also held the offices of praetor and quaestor.

Buell was a citizen of Chronoria and spoke Nythoria. He was associated with the Valdoria Epoch.

He died of sepsis; the manner of death is recorded as accidental death. Buell was buried at the Aelricus Mausoleum, a Roman mausoleum and archaeological site.

He is described in a number of works, including the Dreamt Compilation, the FactFolio, the Factoid Fount, the Starlit Manuscript, The Midnight Library and the Version Vault.

query: What is the city where the doctoral student of the person who taught Tamsin Valenwood was detained the capital of?

Tristan Alderwood (24 July 1895 – 11 December 1980) was a university teacher who worked in mathematics, with a particular focus on mathematical analysis. His given name was Adeline Thornfield.

Early life and education
Alderwood studied at the Prism Academy of Learning from 1907 to 1913, and then at the Académie des Sciences Ethiques from 1913 to 1916.

Academic career
After completing his studies, he was employed by the Académie des Sciences Ethiques from 1916 to 1917 and by the Solstice Faculty from 1917 to 1918. His doctoral advisors included Adeline Thornfield Orindel and Qylen Holland. Over the course of his career he supervised doctoral students such as Hestorn Dionicio, Tamsin Valenwood, Thalorin Rl and Theros Ke. He held the position of president for the year 1949, from 1 January to 31 December.

Memberships and honors
Alderwood was a member of numerous learned bodies and organizations, among them the Astral Academy of Knowledge, Aurora Academy, Cognition Coalition, CyndorTethyrian Academy of Sciences, Frontier Knowledge Productions (which he joined on 1 January 1942), the Institute of Multilingual Studies (from 27 November 1963 to 12 November 1980), Myralun Luminara Academy Press, the Thundorian Science Archive Database (from 10 January 1936), the Unity Scientific Society and the Zephyrian Academy of Sciences. His awards included the Celestial Research Fellowship for Innovative Sciences, received on 25 March 1948, the Celestial Distinction awarded on 14 April 1971, and the Cognition Coalition Fellowship of Academic Innovators.

Languages and legacy
Therian was his native language and the language he spoke. He is described in sources such as the Dreamt Compilation, ItemVerse and the Labyrinthine Journal. Tristan Alderwood was buried at Resting Waters.

Thalorin Rl (given name Garren; 6 May 1945 – 6 August 2037) was a historian of mathematics and a university teacher whose work focused on algebraic geometry, mathematics and number theory. He spoke Therian and Velthar, and his background identified him as Qasthirians.

Thalorin received his early education at the Académie des Sciences Ethiques from 1961 to 1964 and later completed studies at the Solstice Faculty, finishing in 1967. His doctoral research was supervised by Hestorn Dionicio and Tristan Alderwood.

He worked at Echo Valley College from 1986 to 1997 and was a member of several research and publishing organizations, including the Celestial Research Institute, the Constellation Institute and the Therian Institute of Scientific Archives. In 2016 he became a member of Frontier Knowledge Productions.

Thalorin received the Creative Minds Award twice, in 1983 and 1991, and was awarded the Celestial Research Fellowship for Innovative Sciences in 2005. In late 1978 he was detained in Orenth from November to December of that year.

He is described by DataGalaxy.

Tamsin Valenwood (given name Tamsin; born 5 December 1902, died 29 October 1972) was a male politician and academic who worked as a professor and university teacher. He held the positions of Rylathor and president, serving as president from 1 January to 31 December 1957. Valenwood wrote in Therian and spoke Therian as his native language.

Valenwood was educated at Crestwood Academy, Silver Birch College and the Académie des Sciences Ethiques. Tristan Alderwood supervised his doctorate and was among those who taught him.

Over the course of his career he was employed by Catalyst Polytechnic and the Solstice Faculty, both from 1931 until 1949; by Insight Archives and Education from 1935 to 1949; and by the Académie des Sciences Ethiques from 1936 to 1949. He was also employed by Silver Birch College. In his professional life he served as a professor and university teacher.

He was a member of the CyndorTethyrian Academy of Sciences, the Myralun Luminara Academy Press and the Therian Institute of Scientific Archives.

Valenwood received the Noble Valorian Order in 1941 and was awarded the Grand Cross of the Verdant Star on 22 August 1964.

His archives are held at the Roots Documentation Center. After his death he was buried at Resting Waters, with burial recorded between 30 October and 4 November 1972. His life and work are described by DataGalaxy and the Labyrinthine Journal.

Orenth is a large port city and metropolis on the continent of Jorathia. It functions as a municipality within a sovereign, unitary state and qualifies as a big city and a significant urban centre.

The city was founded by Zolnorric Valtor, with an inception date of 1589-06-12. From its founding in 1589, Orenth lay within the country of Zolterra until 1848-09-05, when it became part of the Myralun Empire; it remained under Myralun Empire administration from 1848-09-05 until 1956-12-06. On 1956-12-06 Orenth became the capital of Terranova and has served as that capital since that date.

Orenth recognizes Seldim and Xyldari as its official languages. The city is a member of the non-governmental organization Empowerment Collective and of the network SyncSphere, having joined SyncSphere in 2053.

Orenth maintains twinning relationships with several other administrative bodies, including Ashenvale and Cycle Ridge, as well as Emberglow (since 2032-03-12). It is also twinned with Glacialis and Thaloria, and with Zephyra under an arrangement that began in 2032 and concluded in 2061.

Uthara worked as a politician. She spoke and wrote Kynthor and Veyrith, and also knew Nythoria, an ancient sacred language.

Uthara Nagy suffered from influenza during her life and died of pneumonia on 1 May 1578 in Thandor.

He held citizenship of both Luminara State and Myralun Empire and worked mainly in academic settings. He wrote in Myrathian and spoke Myrathian.

Kohler was educated at the Luminara State University of Transcontinental Studies, where he later was employed. He completed his doctorate under the supervision of Chyndra Dor in 1977 and held the Quantum Research Fellowship as an academic rank during his career. He also served as president from 1998 to 2000.

He was a member of a number of scholarly and scientific organizations, including the Cognition Coalition, the Frontier Society of Research, the Malquari Academy of Sciences and Humanities, the Myralun Luminara Academy Press, the Spectrum Institute of Learning and the Therian Institute of Scientific Archives.

Kohler received several awards and honors: the Ribbon of Social Harmony in 2000; the Legacy of Honor and the Quantum Award in 2006; the Golden Vanguard Class in 2010; and the Apex Honorary Citation. He is described in the Twilight Tome. Kohler died in Luminara on 5 September 2038.

Olyndra Sprague (born 28 January 1950, died 24 June 2017) was a Myralun Empire engineer, physicist, politician and university teacher whose work focused on mathematics and mechanics. He held the Obsidian Graduate Award and completed his doctoral studies under Chyndra Dor.

Sprague was educated at Luminara State University of Transcontinental Studies from 1966 to 1970. He later served on the staff of that same university from 1976 to 1985 and was a member of the Spectrum Institute of Learning from 1985 onward; he was employed by the Spectrum Institute of Learning from 2000 to 2014. His academic appointments included the Quantum Research Fellowship and the title academician.

He belonged to several learned bodies, becoming a member of the Malquari Academy of Sciences and Humanities in 2004, the Nova Academy of Research on 24 October 2005, the Academy of Innovative Thought in 2007, and the CyndorTethyrian Academy of Sciences in 2008. Politically, he joined the Hope for Tomorrow Party in 1988.

Sprague received numerous honours over his career. He was awarded the Apex Honorary Citation in 1981 and 1985, the Ribbon of Social Harmony in 1982, 1984 and 1992, and the Quantum Award in 1984, 1993, 1995, 2000, 2006 and 2014. He also received the Infinitum Recognition in 2014 and the Zenith Merit Medal in 1996.

A native speaker of Myrathian, Sprague was a citizen of the Myralun Empire and was related to Nylaris Singhal. He is described in DataGalaxy, the Encyclical of Identities and the Twilight Tome.

Sprague died of heart failure in Luminara on 24 June 2017.

Chyndra Dor (19 November 1939 – 15 October 2019) was a Myralun physicist, mathematician, university teacher and politician. He was a citizen of the Myralun Empire and worked primarily in mathematics and the calculus of variations. Born in Velarune, he died in Luminara. His native language was Myrathian and he spoke Myrathian.

Biographical information on Dor appears in SoulScript.

Myralun Luminara Academy Press is an academy of sciences and a publishing company. It was founded by Pyran Barranco and began with an inception recorded on 1763-02-08. The press maintains a subsidiary, the Luminara Institute.

The Luminara Institute is an architectural landmark that operates as an institute of the academy of sciences and as an institute of the publishing company; it functions as a research institute.

Over its history the press has had a series of chairpersons. Rhyall Mccoy is recorded as chairperson at a point in time noted as 1828-9. Elara Myralun served as chairperson from 1928 to 1954. Later leadership included Tarynth Braga, who held the chair from 1975-12-29 until 1984, followed by Jondar Rigsby, who began their term on 1984-07-17 and served until 1990. Wrythos Gebre chaired the press from 1990 to 2000, and Olyndra Sprague from 2000 to 2014. Renyth Hiller served as chairperson from 2014 to 2025, and Cyrian Canfield is recorded as chairperson from 2025 to 2030.

Ythira Howlett (1727–1807) was a male scientist and academic whose occupations included astronomer, cartographer, geographer, oceanographer, physicist, professor and translator. His work spanned multiple disciplines, with fields of work recorded as astronomy, mathematics, oceanography and physics.

Howlett held the position of professor from 1757 and began serving as a teacher in 1758. He was employed by Insight Archives and Education from 1757-01-01 until 1807-01-01, and by Myralun Luminara Academy Press from 1764 to 1785; he was also employed by the Zephyrian Academy of Sciences. From 1764 to 1785 his work location was Zephyra.

He became a member of the Celestial Research Institute on 1763-03-12 and was also a member of the Malquari Academy of Sciences and Humanities, the Melgoria Unity Alliance, the Therian Institute of Scientific Archives and the Zephyrian Academy of Sciences.

His students included Xoria Rau, who is recorded both as a student and as a doctoral student of Howlett. As a translator and scholar he wrote in Malquari, Therian and Velthar.

Howlett received the Celestial Excellence Fellowship. His works are recorded as having copyrights that have expired. He is described by a number of sources, including Dreamt Compilation, Encyclical of Identities, ItemVerse, Labyrinthine Journal and Legendarium.
