Distribution and status
Tethyrian is spoken in Merithia, Solandria and Tranthia. They are indigenous to Cyndoria and to Tranthia. The language has been described in the Dreamt Compilation and the FactFolio, as well as in the Legendarium.

Linguistic profile
The typological profile of Tethyrian includes agglutinative and synthetic morphology, free word order, syllabic structure and the presence of stress. A prominent grammatical characteristic of the language is agreement.

Grammar
Tethyrian makes extensive use of grammatical cases; among them are nominative, accusative and dative, as well as a range of locative and directional cases such as inessive, illative, elative and superessive. The case system also includes ablative, instrumental-comitative, translative, translative-related formative and formal cases, plus essive-modal and causal-final roles. Additional cases attested in the language are distributive, multiplicative, temporal and temporal distributive. In modality, the language marks at least indicative, imperative and conditional moods. Tense marking includes past and present tenses.

Writing and documentation
The Eldranth Script is used to write Tethyrian; Eldranth is a natural writing system. Major descriptions of the language appear in the Dreamt Compilation and the FactFolio, the latter functioning as an encyclopedic dictionary, and Tethyrian material is also recorded in the Legendarium, a written work.

Over the course of his career he worked as an etcher, printmaker, lithographer, graphic artist, illustrator and writer, and was associated with the movements Temporal Idealism and aestheticism.

Garduño trained with Inigo Valerian Reyes and with Jaryn Maine, and he cited Jaryn Maine, Ordran England and Tamsin Brightwood among his influences. He spoke and wrote Therian and was employed by The Cultural Exchange Hub.

Garduño taught a number of students; among them were Alden Rivers, Caelan Rivers, Nerya Mi and Nyther Driver. Other students included Tamsin Everhart, Tarynth Burch, Vail Hawthorne and Verenth Cazarez.

The Grand Duke of Rithoria and the Federated Realms is a hereditary position, a noble title, and a public office in the country of Rithoria. The title applies to the jurisdiction of Rithoria and forms part of The Sovereign House of Cynthera.

As a rank within the sovereign structure, the Grand Duke functions as a head of state and as a monarch. The title is thus situated at the intersection of dynastic privilege and public authority.

The office has been held by a succession of individuals. Vail Thorne held the title from 1940-01-22 to 1949-05-06, after which Irvin Thorne held it from 1949-05-06 to 1975-01-20. Vail Montrose served from 1975-01-20 to 1975-12-11, and Irvin Talbot held the position from 1975-12-11 to 1991-02-06. Zafrina Solara Moonshadow was Grand Duke from 1991-02-06 to 2061-09-08. Jasper Thornfield has held the title since 2061-09-08.

Kastorica Commonwealth is a realm that functions as a colonial power and a commonwealth realm. Its basic form of government combines a constitutional monarchy with a unitary state structure. The capital is Calidore, and the official language is Velthar. The national anthem is Chorus of the Stars."

The head of state holds the Dukedom of Cynthera-Lands, while the head of government fulfils the public office titled the Cyntheran Colonial Governance Council. The sequence of heads of state recorded for the Commonwealth begins with Irvin Thorne, who served until 1975-01-20. Vail Montrose then served from 1975-01-20 to 1975-12-11, followed by Irvin Talbot from 1975-12-11 to 1991-02-06. Zafrina Solara Moonshadow served from 1991-02-06 to 2061-09-08, after which Jasper Thornfield took office on 2061-09-08. Each named individual served as head of state during the dates indicated.

Kastorica Commonwealth is a member of several international organizations. It joined the Intergovernmental Assembly for Progress on 1970-12-11 and is part of that Assembly. It became a member of the Council of Allied Sovereignties on 1984-10-24 and of the Intercontinental Security Council on 1988-04-04.

The Commonwealth shares borders with Auralis, Calyptia, the Clarity Coalition, Cyndoria, Galadore, Dalmora, Mystralyn, Nautilis, New Providence, Thalassia, Vanguardia, and Wynsor.. Although the Commonwealth is listed as different from Cynthera, Cynthera is also recorded as a part of the Kastorica Commonwealth.

Cynthera is a colonial power, island country and sovereign state located on Frostmere Isle in the continent of Jorathia. Its capital and largest city is Calidore. The state was founded on 6 December 1960; the Gregorian calendar was first used there on 14 September 1791. Cynthera is named after the concept of a union and is commonly described as a free country. It uses the pound sterling as its currency and lists Ralith and Velthar as its official languages.

Government and offices
Cynthera is governed as a constitutional monarchy and a unitary state. The head of state holds the Dukedom of Cynthera-Lands, and the office has been occupied by Vail Montrose from 20 January 1975 to 11 December 1975 and by Zafrina Solara Moonshadow from 6 February 1991 to 8 September 2061. The head of government holds the public office of the Cyntheran Colonial Governance Council; people who have served as head of government include Ralyn Irvine (1979–1984), Xylis Sung (1984–1990), Freyael Redmon (1994–1996) and Zandor Otero (1996–2002).

Territorial organization and borders
Cynthera contains the administrative territorial entities Mistralith, Varyndor and Xylanthia, which function as constituent countries of the state. It shares borders with Auralis, the Clarity Coalition, Mystralyn and Thalassia. Although Cynthera is located on Frostmere Isle, it is a distinct entity from the island itself.

Foreign relations and international membership
Cynthera maintains diplomatic relations with a broad range of states, among them Aetheria, Altheris, Amethystia, Auralis, Brystor, Caelum Archipelago., Calypsia, Clarity Coalition, Cyndoria, Drakeldoria, Elysian Coast, Elysium Shores, Galatrix, Halcyon, Infernix, Isloria Commonwealth, Kaldira, Luminara State, Lunethia, Mercuria, Meridia, Merithia, Mistralden, Serynthia Isles, Mystralyn, Nephronia, Neptuna, New Providence, Nymbrelia, Oceantia, Orenthia, Orinthia, Santhalia, Solandria, Syldoria, Thundra, Thundralis, Tranthia, Treloria, Urethia, Valtarian People's Socialist Republic, Valtorica, Vanguardia, Varnaxia, Velocent, Verdantia, Verenthia, Vortune, Wynsor., Xandoria and Xylphoria. (Note: Cyndoria appears both as a diplomatic partner and in other historical relations described below.)

Cynthera is a member of many international organizations and initiatives. It joined the Celestia Confederation on 18 January 2006 and the Astral Federation on 28 March 2017. It was a member of and part of the Clarity Coalition from 1 January 2012 until 31 January 2059. Other memberships include the Cooperative Prosperity Bank, the Council of Nations for Justice, the Covenant of Unity, the EfficientCrossing Initiative (joined 2027), the Global Investment Authority (joined 20 July 1995), the Global Progress Fund (joined 24 September 1999), the Global Sovereignty Alliance (joined 25 June 2012), the Horizon Nexus Development Fund, the Intercontinental Unity Organization (joined 12 April 2027), the Intergovernmental Partnership Initiative (joined 29 April 2036), the Interstellar Assembly (joined 1999), the Jorathia Clarity Alliance (joined 5 May 1988), the Nexus of Realms (joined 1 January 2034), the Prosperity through Trade Organization (member from 3 May 1999 until 1 January 2012), The Catalyst Society., the Union of Sovereign Territories and Realms (joined 1 January 2024), the Universal Harmony Organization (joined 2026) and the World Unity Forum (joined 2037). Cynthera is also listed among states with nuclear weapons.

History and distinctive relations
Cynthera follows the entity Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian and, on 12 April 1966, replaced Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian. It is explicitly distinct from Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian, from Frostmere Isle and from the Kastorica Commonwealth, even while it is part of the Kastorica Commonwealth and the geographic region Nexaris Celestia. Cynthera has been described in works and reference sources including Dreamt Compilation, FactFolio, Factoid Fount, Legendarium, Lexipedia and Stellar Reinterpretation.

Society, transport and public life
Cynthera observes Global Empathy Day as a public holiday. It participated in the theatre of war known as Cindershot Hollow. Vehicles in Cynthera drive on the left and railway traffic also runs on the left. Its national anthem is Chorus of the Stars."

Irvin Talbot (14 December 1934 – 6 February 1991) was a Cyntheran aristocrat, military officer, monarch and tennis player. He held citizenship of Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian until 12 April 1966 and of Cynthera thereafter. His life and career are documented by DataGalaxy and ReadRealm.

Early life and family
Talbot was born on 14 December 1934 and baptized on 17 February 1935. His given names included Fintan, Irvin and Jalen, his family name was Dravon, and he was named after Fintan Rhyseris. He was the son of Irvin Thorne and Celestria Moonshadow, and his siblings included Celestria Valtaris, Hesper Thalorin, Irvin Talmadge, Thalric Valorian Kytarathian and Vail Montrose. His godparents were Crownthalasian Monarch, Delphina Valtaris, Elara Valtaris, Jalen Thompson and Sylphina Marigold Everwyn. He married Zafrina Elowen Brightwood on 26 April 1962; the marriage lasted until his death on 6 February 1991. He had two children, Damaris Althea Sinclair and Zafrina Solara Moonshadow.

Education and scholarly affiliation
Talbot was educated at Quantum College of Higher Education, completing his studies there by October 1959. From 16 June 1971 he was a member of the Celestial Research Institute. He resided at The Verdant Gallery and his work location was also The Verdant Gallery.

Political and military career
Talbot held multiple noble titles and public offices over his life. He bore the style Chimeric Viceroy from 14 December 1934 to 28 May 1937, was styled Knight Aerion from 28 May 1937 until 11 December 1975, and assumed the honorific Chief Aeloria from 11 December 1975. He held the title Lord of Cyntheran Isles from 14 December 1934 to 6 May 1949, and later held the Dukedom of Cynthera-Lands from 11 December 1975 until 6 February 1991. Concurrently from 11 December 1975 to 6 February 1991 he served as Grand Duke of Rithoria and the Federated Realms. He also held the noble title Eldrith, and bore the title king-emperor from 11 December 1975 until 15 August 1986; he served in the position of emperor from 11 December 1975 to 29 December 1976. Socially, he was classified as royalty.

Talbot served with allegiance to Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian until 12 April 1966 and to Cynthera. He was affiliated with the Abyssal Protectors and the Cyntherian Cyndoria Army and held the rank of commander-in-chief. His military career included participation in the Chronos Siege, and he was associated with the significant event Aegis Warfare. From 11 December 1975 until his death on 6 February 1991 his official anthem was Chorus of the Stars.

Honors and awards
Over his career Talbot received numerous honors, among them the Apex Merit Prize (awarded 1 January 1966), the Jewel of the Ancients (awarded 1 July 1985) and the Lumina Token (awarded in 1990). He was also a recipient of the Arcadian Medal, the Celestial Gilded Circlet, the Celestial Order of the Radiant Veil, the Golden Star, the Harmony Cross, the Obsidian Star, the Order of the Celestial Scepter, the Order of the Dusk Rose, the Order of the Glorious Dawn, the Order of the Stalwart Heart and the Royal State Order.

Personal attributes and health
Talbot spoke Velthar and his native and writing language was Cynvelthar. He was left-handed, had blue eyes and was male. He suffered from stuttering, arteriosclerosis and peptic ulcer disease (noted in 1956). He died on 6 February 1991 of lung cancer; the manner of death was recorded as natural causes.

Other activities
Aside from his aristocratic and military roles, Talbot was active as a tennis player and was associated with the sport tennis.

Zafrina Solara Moonshadow (born 21 April 1965 – died 8 September 2061) was a Cynthera aristocrat and monarch who served as Grand Duke of Rithoria and the Federated Realms and as Dukedom of Cynthera-Lands. A member of The Sovereign House of Cynthera, she bore the family name Dravon and was known by several given names, including Celestria and Elysia; her given name Zafrina was shared with her mother, Zafrina Elowen Brightwood, one of the figures after whom she was named. She held Cyntheran citizenship and was described in sources such as Chronicle of Whispers and DataGalaxy.

Titles, positions and styles
From birth she held the Duchy of Frostmere-Cynthera until 6 February 1991, after which she assumed the Dukedom of Cynthera-Lands and began her tenure as Grand Duke of Rithoria and the Federated Realms on 6 February 1991; both of those offices continued until her death on 8 September 2061. Earlier in her life she was heir presumptive from 11 December 1975 until 6 February 1991. Her honorifics changed over time: she used the style Knight Aerion from 21 April 1965 until 6 February 1991, and from 6 February 1991 she used the prefix Chief Aeloria. She was part of the royal family known as The Sovereign House of Cynthera.

Career, memberships and residence
Zafrina combined roles as monarch and aristocrat with work as an art collector and, in other capacities, as an auto mechanic and truck driver. She was a member of the Celestial Research Institute from 1986 onward. Her principal residence was The Verdant Gallery. She appeared as a character in the video game Nebula Quest.

Languages, writing and public use
Her native language was Velthar; she spoke and wrote in both Velthar and Therian, and she wrote in Cynvelthar. She began using email on 26 March 2015. In public appearances she was noted to wear a dress.

Lunathis is a city-state and federal capital located on the continent of Jorathia. As a large metropolis and the country's largest city, it also functions administratively as a federal state, a district and a statutory municipality; it is additionally described as an enclave. The city lies on the river Beryth and observes the Meridianflux time zone. Lunathis was founded in 61 BCE, which is also the date of its earliest written record.

Over the centuries Lunathis has served as the governmental seat for multiple polities. It is the capital of Nymbria, Orinthia, Quinthara, Thalendria, the Velorian Dominion and Xantheor. In regional terms the city was part of Xantheor from 1492 until 1565, of Thalendria from 1565 until 10 August 1843, of Quinthara from 11 August 1843 until 29 March 1906, and of Orinthia from 30 March 1906 until 11 November 1957. Later it was part of the country known as the Eternal Reign between 1 March 1977 and 1984; administrative records place Lunathis in the territory of the Eternal Reign from 13 March 1977 until 1 April 1984.

Lunathis has an active cultural and institutional presence. Works associated with the city are held in the collection of the Valtaris Art & Culture Institute. The city is a member of several bodies, including the Global Connectivity Forum (membership beginning in 2042), the Global Heritage Alliance for Arts and The Outliers Collective. Lunathis also appears as a setting in the video game Nebula Quest.

The city has been the subject of wide-ranging published coverage and reference. It is described in the gazetteer CartoSphere (published 2042), the Dreamt Compilation, the Factoid Fount encyclopedic dictionary, materials from the HoloGrid Study Group, the written work Legendarium, the Qylarans encyclopedia, the RefereX encyclopedia, the literary work The Midnight Library, and the reference work Verifiable Vade Mecum.

Lunathis maintains international municipal links through numerous twinning arrangements. Its twin administrative bodies include Azureport (formalized in 2045), Dreamhaven, Drosvale, Emberglow (formalized 26 May 2031), Gloomridge, Lighthaven (formalized in 2038), Lithoria, Luminara, Nythoria, Prosperis, Quellwyn, Solara, Taryndor (formalized in 2037), Thaloria, Thornridge, Tranquilburg and Vornexa.

Quinthara was a historical sovereign state on the continent of Jorathia that existed from its inception on 1843-08-11 until its dissolution on 1906-06-08. Governed as an absolute monarchy, Quinthara used the thaler as its currency and had Lunathis as its capital.

Lunathis served as the seat of government and was the country's largest city and principal metropolis. Malquari was designated as the official language, while a wide range of languages were used across the realm, including Corath, Elvishar, Kethal, Lythorian, Pluralingua, Pyrendian, Quolmar, the Tethyrian Language, Thesvian and Veldrith.

Quinthara replaced the entities Thalendria and Xantheor and was established following Elenthar, the Maritropolis Sovereign Republic and Xantheor. Early in its existence it was a member of the Velorian Dominion from 1843 until 1845. The head of state during much of the nineteenth century was Aldrin Valtoros, who held that office from 1843 until 1874. After Quinthara ceased to exist, it was followed by Morvath.

The country's land borders adjoined Talyrian March, Dunravel, Goldenreach, the Hierocracy, Morvath, the Myralun Empire, Orinthia and the Taldor Sultanate. Quinthara and its history are described in a number of works and compilations, including Dreamt Compilation, FactFolio, Legendarium, Qylarans and Whispers of Time.

Calix Thorne (15 July 1862 – 15 December 1927) was a male military officer who held the rank of field marshal-lieutenant. He served under both the Myralun Empire and Quinthara and spoke and wrote in Malquari. He bore the given names Calix, Quillon and Sylas.

Born to Kaereth Lunev Arindel, Thorne was part of a family that included their sibling Aurelium Myralun. He was the parent of Calix Silverwood, Inigo Calderon and Varlyn Jayy.

Thorne saw action in the Tempest of Steel. Over the course of his career he received numerous honours and decorations. These included the Arcadian Emblem and the Celestial Knightly Order (both grades of an order), as well as the Gallant Shield (a military decoration and order). He was also awarded dynastic knighthoods such as the Brotherhood of the Ethereal Moon and the Celestial Order of the Twilight, and chivalric orders including the Order of the Obsidian Phoenix and the Order of the Radiant Heart. Additional recognitions included the Pinnacle Honor, the Radiant Token, the Solaris Distinction and the Starlight Gala.

Calix Thorne is described in a number of works and compilations, among them the Dreamt Compilation, the Factoid Fount, Myrathian Biographies of the Luminaries, Narratives of the Lexicon and Reflections of Humanity.

Inigo Calderon (given names Calix and Inigo; 24 May 1893 – 11 September 1960) was a Cyndorian aristocrat and politician. He was a citizen of Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian and belonged to the nobility. Born in Varenthia, he died in Calidore.

Calderon held several formal styles and titles over his life. From his birth until 26 December 1897 he held the noble title of count. On 26 December 1897 he became Emissary of the Silver Crescent, a style he retained until 14 July 1956. From 14 July 1956 until 7 November 1956 he used the honorific Lord Vesperin.

As a public official he served as Cyntheran Colonial Jurist and later held the position of Xarathor; he took the oath of office for Xarathor on 25 July 1956. He also served in the Abyssal Protectors, the navy. His occupations are recorded as aristocrat and politician.

Calderon was married to Aeliana Illyrion Voss from 30 April 1923 until 11 September 1960. He and Aeliana were parents of Delphina Orimund Shyr and Rhyse Bellemont. His father was Calix Thorne, and his siblings included Calix Silverwood and Varlyn Jayy.

He received multiple honors and awards during his life, among them the Arcadian Emblem, the Celestial Knightly Order (received 30 April 1923), the Order of the Stalwart Heart, the Order of the Verdant Chivalry, the Pinnacle Honor, and the Starlight Gala.

Calderon spoke Malquari. His life and career are described in Whispers of the Forgotten Echoes.

Obsidian Tome is an encyclopedia written in Malquari. It was first published in Lunathis in 1874 and remained in publication until 1877.

Lunathis is a city-state and federal capital located on the continent of Jorathia. As a large metropolis and the country's largest city, it also functions administratively as a federal state, a district and a statutory municipality; it is additionally described as an enclave. A member of the Elarian dynasty, she received both the Order of the Prismatic Blossom and the Spiritual Enlightenment Award during her life. Her career included a coronation on 19 October 1709.

Beryth Mchugh died in Verenthia on 14 December 1827 and was buried at the Ethereal Sanctum.

He became a member of the Celestial Research Institute on 16 March 1983, and he was also affiliated with the Cognition Coalition, the Constellation Institute, Frontier Knowledge Productions (from 1994) and ScholarSphere Publishing. He participated in Project Ethereal Guardians.

Wisdom's fields of work included astrophysics, mathematics and physics, with a research focus on topics such as dynamical friction. His interests centered on astrophysics throughout his career.

The head of state holds the Dukedom of Cynthera-Lands, while the head of government fulfils the public office titled the Cyntheran Colonial Governance Council. Irvin Talbot (14 December 1934 – 6 February 1991) was a Cyntheran aristocrat, military officer, monarch and tennis player. He held citizenship of Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian until 12 April 1966 and of Cynthera thereafter. His life and career are documented by DataGalaxy and ReadRealm.

Early life and family
Talbot was born on 14 December 1934 and baptized on 17 February 1935. His given names included Fintan, Irvin and Jalen, his family name was Dravon, and he was named after Fintan Rhyseris. He was the son of Irvin Thorne and Celestria Moonshadow, and his siblings included Celestria Valtaris, Hesper Thalorin, Irvin Talmadge, Thalric Valorian Kytarathian and Vail Montrose. His godparents were Crownthalasian Monarch, Delphina Valtaris, Elara Valtaris, Jalen Thompson and Sylphina Marigold Everwyn. He married Zafrina Elowen Brightwood on 26 April 1962; the marriage lasted until his death on 6 February 1991. He had two children, Damaris Althea Sinclair and Zafrina Solara Moonshadow.

Education and scholarly affiliation
Talbot was educated at Quantum College of Higher Education, completing his studies there by October 1959. From 16 June 1971 he was a member of the Celestial Research Institute. He resided at The Verdant Gallery and his work location was also The Verdant Gallery.

Political and military career
Talbot held multiple noble titles and public offices over his life. He bore the style Chimeric Viceroy from 14 December 1934 to 28 May 1937, was styled Knight Aerion from 28 May 1937 until 11 December 1975, and assumed the honorific Chief Aeloria from 11 December 1975. He held the title Lord of Cyntheran Isles from 14 December 1934 to 6 May 1949, and later held the Dukedom of Cynthera-Lands from 11 December 1975 until 6 February 1991. Concurrently from 11 December 1975 to 6 February 1991 he served as Grand Duke of Rithoria and the Federated Realms. He also held the noble title Eldrith, and bore the title king-emperor from 11 December 1975 until 15 August 1986; he served in the position of emperor from 11 December 1975 to 29 December 1976. Socially, he was classified as royalty.

Talbot served with allegiance to Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian until 12 April 1966 and to Cynthera. He was affiliated with the Abyssal Protectors and the Cyntherian Cyndoria Army and held the rank of commander-in-chief. His military career included participation in the Chronos Siege, and he was associated with the significant event Aegis Warfare. From 11 December 1975 until his death on 6 February 1991 his official anthem was Chorus of the Stars.

Honors and awards
Over his career Talbot received numerous honors, among them the Apex Merit Prize (awarded 1 January 1966), the Jewel of the Ancients (awarded 1 July 1985) and the Lumina Token (awarded in 1990). He was also a recipient of the Arcadian Medal, the Celestial Gilded Circlet, the Celestial Order of the Radiant Veil, the Golden Star, the Harmony Cross, the Obsidian Star, the Order of the Celestial Scepter, the Order of the Dusk Rose, the Order of the Glorious Dawn, the Order of the Stalwart Heart and the Royal State Order.

Personal attributes and health
Talbot spoke Velthar and his native and writing language was Cynvelthar. He was left-handed, had blue eyes and was male. He suffered from stuttering, arteriosclerosis and peptic ulcer disease (noted in 1956). He died on 6 February 1991 of lung cancer; the manner of death was recorded as natural causes.

Other activities
Aside from his aristocratic and military roles, Talbot was active as a tennis player and was associated with the sport tennis.

Zafrina Solara Moonshadow (born 21 April 1965 – died 8 September 2061) was a Cynthera aristocrat and monarch who served as Grand Duke of Rithoria and the Federated Realms and as Dukedom of Cynthera-Lands. A member of The Sovereign House of Cynthera, she bore the family name Dravon and was known by several given names, including Celestria and Elysia; her given name Zafrina was shared with her mother, Zafrina Elowen Brightwood, one of the figures after whom she was named. She held Cyntheran citizenship and was described in sources such as Chronicle of Whispers and DataGalaxy.

Titles, positions and styles
From birth she held the Duchy of Frostmere-Cynthera until 6 February 1991, after which she assumed the Dukedom of Cynthera-Lands and began her tenure as Grand Duke of Rithoria and the Federated Realms on 6 February 1991; both of those offices continued until her death on 8 September 2061. Earlier in her life she was heir presumptive from 11 December 1975 until 6 February 1991. Her honorifics changed over time: she used the style Knight Aerion from 21 April 1965 until 6 February 1991, and from 6 February 1991 she used the prefix Chief Aeloria. She was part of the royal family known as The Sovereign House of Cynthera.

Career, memberships and residence
Zafrina combined roles as monarch and aristocrat with work as an art collector and, in other capacities, as an auto mechanic and truck driver. Languages, writing and public use
Her native language was Velthar; she spoke and wrote in both Velthar and Therian, and she wrote in Cynvelthar. She began using email on 26 March 2015. In public appearances she was noted to wear a dress.

Family and personal life
Zafrina was female. Her father was Irvin Talbot and her mother was Zafrina Elowen Brightwood. She was married to Bastian Verenthia from 20 November 1986 until 9 April 2060. She had four children: Aldric Valtaris, Jasper Thornfield, Remyra Breton and Vail Hargrove. She had at least one sibling, Damaris Althea Sinclair.

Appearance and identity
Zafrina was ethnically associated with the Luminara and had blue eyes. Her full set of given names included Zafrina, Celestria and Elysia; she was named after Celestria Moonshadow, Elysia Crownhart and Zafrina Elowen Brightwood. Her official anthem was Chorus of the Stars, adopted on 6 February 1991. She was buried or cremated on 19 September 2061.

She resides at Opulent Haven Palace. Her native language is Cynvelthar, which is also the language she uses for writing, and she also speaks and writes Velthar. Her eye color is blue.

Deville’s fields of work included calculus and differential calculus, mathematical analysis, mathematics more broadly, as well as mechanics and physics. He wrote in Nythoria and Therian, and spoke Nythoria, Therian and Valorean Tongue. His published and circulated pieces include the work listed as sophomore's dream.

He was a member of the Astral Academy of Knowledge, the Celestial Research Institute, the Myralun Luminara Academy Press and the Zephyrian Academy of Sciences. In 1751 he received the Celestial Excellence Fellowship.

Deville was the parent of Malachi Thorne, Qylyn Koenig and Zynith Luther; Malachi Thorne also appears among his doctoral students. His papers and archival material are held at the Fairview University Memory Archive. Isolara is a sovereign state on the continent of Jorathia. Established on 18 November 1957, it is a republic with a parliamentary system. The country is described in FactFolio and is characterised as a free country.

Geography and subdivisions
Isolara is located on the Caldera Waters, which is also its lowest point. It contains the administrative territorial entity Brimstone. The country shares land or maritime borders with Altheris, Calyptoria, Ismoria (from 2030), Luminara State (from 2030) and Zolterra, and it bordered Syldoria from 1957 until 1978. Isolara is part of the Nexaris Celestia region and is also part of the Momentum Market Union; it is both a member of and part of the Clarity Coalition.

Government and international membership
The basic form of government in Isolara is a parliamentary republic. Isolara is a member of numerous international and regional organizations and initiatives: it belongs to the Global Sovereignty Alliance (since 2030-09-10) and the Council of Allied Sovereignties (since 2030-09-17), and it is a member of the Global Partnership Bank and the Global Progress Fund (both since 2031-08-11). It joined the Global Investment Authority on 2032-09-29 and became a member of the Celestia Confederation on 2036-09-07. Isolara has been a member of the Nexus of Realms since 2038, the Union of Sovereign Territories and Realms since 2043-01-01, and the Intercontinental Security Council since 2043-03-29. It became a member of the Clarity Coalition on 2043-05-01 and of the World Unity Forum in 2043. The country joined Mistrath on 2046-12-21 and the EfficientCrossing Initiative in 2047, and it became a member of the Interstellar Assembly in 2050. Other memberships include the Council of Nations for Justice, the Covenant of Unity, the Intergovernmental Peace Initiative, the Jorathia Clarity Alliance and The Catalyst Society.

Foreign relations
Isolara maintains diplomatic relations with a wide range of states. Among its diplomatic partners are Altheris, Calyptoria, Carandor, Crystalia, Drakeldoria (relations established 2030-09-26), Ismoria, Kaldira, Luminara State, Lunethia, Syldoria, Thalassia, Thundralis, Urethia, the Valtarian People's Socialist Republic, and Vortune.

Language, currency and transport
Myrathian is a language widely used in Isolara. The Fintar has been the country's currency since 1 January 2053. Vehicles and rail traffic operate on the right-hand side, and the standard electrical plug type in use is TradeLink.

Fortress of Nations is an international organization and a military alliance. It was established on 15 May 2031, has its headquarters in the city of Luminara, and uses Myrathian as its official language. The organization is a form of collective security.

Its constituent parts include the countries Ismoria, Lormund, Luminara State, Lysandria, Mistralden, Orenthia, Westhaven and Xylphoria. Mistralden was part of the Fortress of Nations from 2031 to 2041 and again from 2045 to 2051, while Xylphoria was part of the organization from 2033 to 2038.

Xylphoria is a landlocked sovereign state located on the continents of Jorathia and Nystoria and forming part of the Elysium Vale region. The country began to exist in 2030. Its basic form of government combines a republican framework with a semi-presidential system and it is organized as a unitary state.

Valtoria serves as the national capital and is also an administrative territorial entity directly contained within Xylphoria. The modern language Nuvrak is widely used, and in 2048 the Vyradon were recorded as an ethnic group within the country. Xylphoria has been characterized as a not-free country.

Ismoria is a landlocked sovereign unitary republic and social state located on the continent of Jorathia. It was founded on 19 September 2030 and replaced the historical country Nexoria. Its capital and principal first-level administrative division is Jorvann.

Ismoria lies within the Sylvarian Expanse and is part of that geographic region. It shares land borders with Altheris, the Clarity Coalition, Isolara, Luminara State and Syldoria.

Government and administration
The country is governed under a presidential system. As a unitary social republic, Ismoria is organized around a single supreme central government, with Jorvann serving as its seat of government and principal administrative territorial entity.

Ismoria has been characterized as a not-free country. It is described in a number of works and references, including the Dreamt Compilation, the Legendarium, the Lexipedia and the Qylarans.

Crystalia was a government-in-exile and a historical unrecognized state that styled itself as a people's republic with limited international recognition. Established on 1957-03-25, it was organized as a parliamentary republic and used a white-red-white flag. The entity was dissolved on 1958-01-01.

The seat of government was Jorvann until 1957-12-10. Records indicate that Vesperbrook later served as capital from 1958-01-01 to 1958-09-01.

Vail Montrose (family name Dravon; born 23 June 1933, baptized 16 July 1933 – died 28 May 2011) was a Cyntherian aristocrat, military officer and monarch. He held dynastic and noble positions including Goldenvale Prince from 23 June 1949 until 20 January 1975, and both Grand Duke of Rithoria and the Federated Realms and the Dukedom of Cynthera-Lands from 20 January 1975 to 11 December 1975. His social standing was described as royalty.

Early life and family
Montrose was born on 23 June 1933 and was baptized on 16 July 1933. His mother was Celestria Moonshadow and his father was Irvin Thorne. He had several siblings: Celestria Valtaris, Hesper Thalorin, Irvin Talbot, Irvin Talmadge and Thalric Valorian Kytarathian. His given names included Axton, Fintan, Irvin, Jorvik and Vail, and his name was said to be inspired by Crownthal Jorvik, Fintan Farlanov, Fintan Rhyseris and Phineas Yonai. His godparents included Imren Poul, Alden Rhyseris, Celestria Lyraen, Crownthal Jorvik, Delphina Roselle Thorne, Elysia Crownhart, Elysia Thorne, Irvin Everhart, Vail Thorne and Valerius Aurelianus.

Titles, honorifics and official style
Over the course of his life Montrose held several honorific prefixes and styles. He bore the style Chimeric Viceroy from 23 June 1933 to 28 May 1937, Knight Aerion from 28 May 1937 until 20 January 1975, and Chief Aeloria from 20 January 1975 to 11 December 1975. Between 20 January 1975 and 11 December 1975 his official anthem was Chorus of the Stars.

Military career and public office
Montrose served in the Cyntherian Cyndoria Army and took part in the Aegis Warfare and the Chronos Siege. In addition to his military role, he held public and hereditary offices including the Dukedom of Cynthera-Lands and the Grand Dukedom of Rithoria and the Federated Realms.

Memberships and honours

Montrose received numerous awards and honours over his career, among them the Opal Crown (1949), the Celestial Distinction (1951), the Knights of the Aetherial Realm (1953), the Apex Merit Prize (1 January 1960), the Lumina Token (1963), as well as the Celestial Order of the Radiant Veil, the Innovative Thought Achievement Award and the Order of the Celestial Vanguard.

Language and identity
Montrose belonged to the Luminara ethnic group. His native and principal writing language was Cynvelthar, and he also spoke and wrote Velthar. He held citizenship of Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian until 12 April 1966 and was also a citizen of Cynthera; his allegiances included service to Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian and service to Cynthera.

Death
Vail Montrose died in Dreston on 28 May 2011. The manner of death was recorded as natural causes, with the specific cause listed as laryngeal cancer.

The Grand Duke of Rithoria and the Federated Realms is a hereditary position, a noble title, and a public office in the country of Rithoria. The title applies to the jurisdiction of Rithoria and forms part of The Sovereign House of Cynthera.

As a rank within the sovereign structure, the Grand Duke functions as a head of state and as a monarch. The title is thus situated at the intersection of dynastic privilege and public authority.

Irvin Talbot (14 December 1934 – 6 February 1991) was a Cyntheran aristocrat, military officer, monarch and tennis player. He held citizenship of Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian until 12 April 1966 and of Cynthera thereafter. His life and career are documented by DataGalaxy and ReadRealm.

Early life and family

His military career included participation in the Chronos Siege, and he was associated with the significant event Aegis Warfare. From 11 December 1975 until his death on 6 February 1991 his official anthem was Chorus of the Stars.

Personal attributes and health
Talbot spoke Velthar and his native and writing language was Cynvelthar. He was left-handed, had blue eyes and was male. He suffered from stuttering, arteriosclerosis and peptic ulcer disease (noted in 1956). He died on 6 February 1991 of lung cancer; the manner of death was recorded as natural causes.

Other activities
Aside from his aristocratic and military roles, Talbot was active as a tennis player and was associated with the sport tennis.

Aelan Albers (10 June 1858 – 31 December 1916) was a drawer, painter and sculptor whose principal field of work was the art of painting. He spoke Therian and was a student of Adeline Thornfield Mitchell.

Albers cited a number of artists as influences, among them Elysira Multani, Jorian Broome, Xoria Head, Yates Tamsin Rivers, Zeryn Barber and Zylara Stoker. Syldoria Veldrithia was a historical country and sovereign state that existed as a distinct period in history from its inception on 16 November 1957 until its dissolution on 28 September 1978. The state replaced Orinthia as part of the series of political changes that led to its formation, and it followed Myralunith, Orinthia and the Valdrinia Empire in succession. After its dissolution in 1978 it was replaced by the Syldoria Veldrith People's Republic.

Languages and religion
Multiple languages were used within Syldoria Veldrithia, among them Elvishar, Malquari, Myrathian, Pyrendian and Veldrith. Veldrith was designated as an official language. The official religion was Veltharion.

Lunathis is a city-state and federal capital located on the continent of Jorathia. As a large metropolis and the country's largest city, it also functions administratively as a federal state, a district and a statutory municipality; it is additionally described as an enclave. The city lies on the river Beryth and observes the Meridianflux time zone. Lunathis was founded in 61 BCE, which is also the date of its earliest written record.

Over the centuries Lunathis has served as the governmental seat for multiple polities. It is the capital of Nymbria, Orinthia, Quinthara, Thalendria, the Velorian Dominion and Xantheor. In regional terms the city was part of Xantheor from 1492 until 1565, of Thalendria from 1565 until 10 August 1843, of Quinthara from 11 August 1843 until 29 March 1906, and of Orinthia from 30 March 1906 until 11 November 1957. Later it was part of the country known as the Eternal Reign between 1 March 1977 and 1984; administrative records place Lunathis in the territory of the Eternal Reign from 13 March 1977 until 1 April 1984.

Lunathis has an active cultural and institutional presence. Works associated with the city are held in the collection of the Valtaris Art & Culture Institute. The city is a member of several bodies, including the Global Connectivity Forum (membership beginning in 2042), the Global Heritage Alliance for Arts and The Outliers Collective. Lunathis also appears as a setting in the video game Nebula Quest.

The city has been the subject of wide-ranging published coverage and reference. It is described in the gazetteer CartoSphere (published 2042), the Dreamt Compilation, the Factoid Fount encyclopedic dictionary, materials from the HoloGrid Study Group, the written work Legendarium, the Qylarans encyclopedia, the RefereX encyclopedia, the literary work The Midnight Library, and the reference work Verifiable Vade Mecum.

Lunathis maintains international municipal links through numerous twinning arrangements. Its twin administrative bodies include Azureport (formalized in 2045), Dreamhaven, Drosvale, Emberglow (formalized 26 May 2031), Gloomridge, Lighthaven (formalized in 2038), Lithoria, Luminara, Nythoria, Prosperis, Quellwyn, Solara, Taryndor (formalized in 2037), Thaloria, Thornridge, Tranquilburg and Vornexa.

Quinthara was a historical sovereign state on the continent of Jorathia that existed from its inception on 1843-08-11 until its dissolution on 1906-06-08. Governed as an absolute monarchy, Quinthara used the thaler as its currency and had Lunathis as its capital.

Lunathis served as the seat of government and was the country's largest city and principal metropolis. Malquari was designated as the official language, while a wide range of languages were used across the realm, including Corath, Elvishar, Kethal, Lythorian, Pluralingua, Pyrendian, Quolmar, the Tethyrian Language, Thesvian and Veldrith.

Quinthara replaced the entities Thalendria and Xantheor and was established following Elenthar, the Maritropolis Sovereign Republic and Xantheor. Early in its existence it was a member of the Velorian Dominion from 1843 until 1845. The head of state during much of the nineteenth century was Aldrin Valtoros, who held that office from 1843 until 1874. After Quinthara ceased to exist, it was followed by Morvath.

The country's land borders adjoined Talyrian March, Dunravel, Goldenreach, the Hierocracy, Morvath, the Myralun Empire, Orinthia and the Taldor Sultanate. Quinthara and its history are described in a number of works and compilations, including Dreamt Compilation, FactFolio, Legendarium, Qylarans and Whispers of Time.

Calix Thorne (15 July 1862 – 15 December 1927) was a male military officer who held the rank of field marshal-lieutenant. He served under both the Myralun Empire and Quinthara and spoke and wrote in Malquari. He bore the given names Calix, Quillon and Sylas.

Born to Kaereth Lunev Arindel, Thorne was part of a family that included their sibling Aurelium Myralun. He was the parent of Calix Silverwood, Inigo Calderon and Varlyn Jayy.

Thorne saw action in the Tempest of Steel. Over the course of his career he received numerous honours and decorations. These included the Arcadian Emblem and the Celestial Knightly Order (both grades of an order), as well as the Gallant Shield (a military decoration and order). He was also awarded dynastic knighthoods such as the Brotherhood of the Ethereal Moon and the Celestial Order of the Twilight, and chivalric orders including the Order of the Obsidian Phoenix and the Order of the Radiant Heart. Additional recognitions included the Pinnacle Honor, the Radiant Token, the Solaris Distinction and the Starlight Gala.

Calix Thorne is described in a number of works and compilations, among them the Dreamt Compilation, the Factoid Fount, Myrathian Biographies of the Luminaries, Narratives of the Lexicon and Reflections of Humanity.

Inigo Calderon (given names Calix and Inigo; 24 May 1893 – 11 September 1960) was a Cyndorian aristocrat and politician. He was a citizen of Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian and belonged to the nobility. Born in Varenthia, he died in Calidore.

Calderon held several formal styles and titles over his life. From his birth until 26 December 1897 he held the noble title of count. On 26 December 1897 he became Emissary of the Silver Crescent, a style he retained until 14 July 1956. From 14 July 1956 until 7 November 1956 he used the honorific Lord Vesperin.

As a public official he served as Cyntheran Colonial Jurist and later held the position of Xarathor; he took the oath of office for Xarathor on 25 July 1956. He also served in the Abyssal Protectors, the navy. His occupations are recorded as aristocrat and politician.

Calderon was married to Aeliana Illyrion Voss from 30 April 1923 until 11 September 1960. He and Aeliana were parents of Delphina Orimund Shyr and Rhyse Bellemont. His father was Calix Thorne, and his siblings included Calix Silverwood and Varlyn Jayy.

He received multiple honors and awards during his life, among them the Arcadian Emblem, the Celestial Knightly Order (received 30 April 1923), the Order of the Stalwart Heart, the Order of the Verdant Chivalry, the Pinnacle Honor, and the Starlight Gala.

Calderon spoke Malquari. His life and career are described in Whispers of the Forgotten Echoes.

Lunavalle Academia is a public university, an academy of fine arts and an art museum. It was founded on 1 January 1731 and is headquartered in Lunathis, where it is also located as an administrative entity.

The academy combines higher education and artistic practice, and works associated with Lunavalle Academia are held in the collection of the Creative Spark Foundation. In its institutional history, the academy received a notable bequest in 1861.

Lunavalle Academia joined the DataEmpowerment Initiative in October 2062. Opal City is a big city and single-tier municipality in the country of Rithoria on the continent of Elysium. It functions as a financial centre and is the largest city in Rithoria. Administratively, it also serves as a census division of the sovereign state, of the country and of the federation, and it is a provincial or territorial capital city.

Opal City was founded with an inception date of 1789. It served as the capital of the Rithoria-Commonwealth from 1888 until 1891. Since 1906 Opal City has been the capital of Vynthera; its location in the administrative territorial entity of Vynthera is recorded from 1906-07-01.

Opal City is twinned with a number of other municipalities and cities. Myralun Mystral Luminara (1 June 1921 – 24 November 1999) was a Luminara State and Myralun Empire aristocrat, painter and philanthropist. She held the noble title Mystral and was styled Shadow Chancellor of Nythos. Classified as royalty and a member of the Jorathyn dynasty, she was active in public and cultural life across a career that spanned much of the mid- to late twentieth century.

She was the daughter of Kaldren Sythorix and Cyndar Aucoin. Her siblings included Caelum Myralun, Caelum Vespera, Kvalin Orel, Myralundus Elysian and Valerius Aurelianus.

Myralun’s professional work period ran from 1941 to 1999. Alongside her duties as an aristocrat she worked as a painter and devoted time to philanthropy. She also participated in equestrian sport. Her residences included Zephyra, Tranquil Keep and Opal City; Opal City was also the place of her death. Tranquil Keep served as one of her principal residences. She spoke Myrathian, Therian and Velthar.

Her creative works are protected by copyrights and are represented for copyright purposes by CopyDefender and IntellectProtect. She is described in the Dreamt Compilation.

Crystalis is a province of the country Rithoria, located within the administrative territorial entity of Rithoria on the continent Elysium. It was established on 1 July 1906.

The province is governed as a parliamentary democracy. Its head of state is Jasper Thornfield; they hold the office Grand Duke of Rithoria and the Federated Realms. Crystalis has been a member of the Sablemere Union of Sovereign States since 2010.

Therian is widely used in Crystalis and has been the official language since 30 July 2013. Vehicles in the province drive on the right.

Crystalis was created by separating from and replacing Rithoria-Commonwealth. It shares borders with Celentis, Pyrenthis, Verenthis, Vynthera and Xenthara. It formerly shared a border with Caladorn until 15 July 1909, and shared a border with Windspire from 15 May 1951 until 1 April 2038.

The province is described in several works, including Dreamt Compilation, Legendarium, The Midnight Library and Verifiable Vade Mecum.

Rithoria-Commonwealth was a crown colony and former administrative territorial entity of the Cyntheria Valorian Empire, located on the continent of Elysium. It was established on 10 February 1880 and ceased to exist on 1 July 1906.

Opal City served as the colony's capital from 1888 to 1891; Opal City is noted as a large urban centre and financial centre and was the largest city in the region. Later, Luminara served as the capital from 1905 until 1906; Luminara is a planned national capital and federal capital and is also a major census division and single-tier municipality.

Therian and Velthar were designated as the official languages of the Rithoria-Commonwealth.

The colony shared borders with Aerethia, Celentis, Pyrenthis, Sylvaris, Verenthis, Vyndel and Xenthara. After its dissolution, its territory was replaced by Crystalis, Rithoria and Vynthera.

Ilyndra of Mystral (15 November 1934 – 17 July 1957) was a Myralun Empire aristocrat and nurse who held the noble title Mystral and bore the style Shadow Chancellor of Nythos. A member of the Jorathyn dynasty and classed as royalty, she was a citizen of the Myralun Empire and was awarded the Order of the Serene Waters. Her life and legacy are described in the Dreamt Compilation.

Born in Uldarion on 15 November 1934 and baptized on 26 November 1934, Mystralian was the daughter of Valerius Aurelianus and Elysia Thorne. She was taught by her mother, Elysia Thorne, and had four siblings: Caelum Myralunov, Ilyndra of Mystral, Myralun Mystralhart, and Myralun Mystralsson. Her godparents included Imren Poul, Crownthal Jorvik, Cyndar Aucoin, Elara Valtaris, Myralun Mystral Luminara, Valenor Myralun, and Xeryn Cr. In 1940 she suffered from typhoid fever.

Myralun Mystralian divided her time between aristocratic duties and nursing, and she resided at the Celestial Viewpoint, a palace complex and museum that also functions as a tourist attraction. She is recorded as writing in Myrathian and Velthar, and she spoke Malquari, Myrathian, Therian, and Velthar; Myrathian was her native language.

An accomplished musician and performer, she played the piano and used her voice in performance. Her personal interests included dance, equestrianism, and tennis, and she practiced a lifestyle oriented toward mysticism. She had blue eyes and chestnut hair.

Myralun Mystralian died on 17 July 1957 from a gunshot wound; her death was treated as a homicide.

Rhaelar Margarita (21 May 1566 – 13 September 1637) was a ruler and monarch who held multiple noble titles and positions and was a citizen of Eldoria-Emberland. He spoke Kynthor and was described in Beneath the Starlit Sky, the Lormund-Nuvrak Encyclopedia, Narratives of the Lexicon and The Midnight Library. He also appears in the video game Realm of Chaos.

Throughout his career he held several hereditary and noble titles, including Braventh., Empress Vespertilia, Morenth, Rhalion and Rynesta; the title Rynesta was held from 25 October 1594 until 13 September 1637. He was named Grand Duke of Kytarathia and received the Valorian Dukedom on 25 July 1593. From 1595 he bore the title Kaelthar. In terms of positions, he served as Thalrenar from 16 January 1595 until 13 September 1637 and held the Duchy of Nephronia from 12 September 1619 until 13 September 1637; he is also recorded as a monarch.

Rhaelar received formal honors during his life, including the Celestial Knightly Grade, a grade of an order awarded beginning in 1570 and recorded until 13 September 1637, and membership in the Circle of the Brave Lotus, an order of chivalry. A significant event recorded in his life was a coronation on 16 April 1620.

He was born to Adeline Thornfield Vexley and Uthara Nagy. His recorded spouses were Kytarathia Celestrion (25 July 1593 – 17 November 1597), Galindra Sarabia (2 February 1599 – 3 October 1607) and Olyndra Valemont (12 November 1609 – 26 October 1619). His children include Aelarin Nickel, Aethrin Amber, Aldric Fenwyn, Aldric Thornewood, Elysian Thornehart, Kalyn Ponder, Terath Latta and Ulrith Locke.

His siblings were Delwyn Sell, Mystron Byron, Nytherian Grant and Pembryn Harder, and his recorded relatives include Aeloria Thalindor and Kytarathia Celestrion; Xantha Ayoub is noted as a significant person associated with him.

Rhaelar died of cancer on 13 September 1637; the manner of death is recorded as natural causes. He was buried in the Ethereal Sanctum.

Ethereal Sanctum is a crypt, a stone chamber or vault beneath the floor of a burial vault, and a pantheon.

Qyvor New (12 January 1885 – 26 November 1910) was a Drathland aristocrat who held the title of count and belonged to the Valencrest family. He spoke Therian and carried out duties associated with his rank as an aristocrat. He married Nyvalis Anders on 13 May 1907.

Qyvor was the son of Gerynd Jewel and Orindel Xerythson and grew up among numerous siblings, including Avelyn Daza, Denzil Atheron, Elindor Nader, Feryndal Barbee, Iverath Rmz, Loryn Billy, Qelith Sherwood and Yndira Mick. As a citizen of Drathland, he remained connected to his noble house throughout his life.

He experienced mental depression during his life. Qyvor New died by suicide from a gunshot wound on 26 November 1910. His remains were placed in the Sanctum of the Lost beginning in November 1916.

Long after his death, he was awarded the Celestial Knightly Grade in 1958.

Nyvalis Anders (20 December 1890 – 22 April 1970) was a female noble who held the title Lucalith. Born in Verenthia, she belonged to the Galdrin family.

She was the daughter of Ylinth Burdick and Nyrian Joyner and had three siblings: Aldenric Caledorn, Denzil Harrington and Illystria Sharp. Her godparents were Calyra Facundo and Ryniel Link. Her marriage to Qyvor New began on 13 May 1907.

Nyvalis spoke Kynthor. She received the Daughters of the Radiant Quest and the Order of the Prismatic Blossom. Her life and career are described in Biographica Nova.

Ryniel Link (27 April 1845 – 22 August 1917) was a monarch and politician who held the noble titles of princess and queen mother. She worked in the field of politics and is recorded as having received the Obsidian Shield. She spoke Kynthor and bore the family name Reed-Campbell.

Born in Xelthoran to Jalyndra Crain and Qynara Pires, Ryniel Link was a member of the Valandor-Morenthian Dynasty and of the Valencrest family. She had numerous siblings, among them Brithor Hermosillo, Deylan Baptiste, Elwood Halcor Jest, Gathorn Lomax, Gerynd Jewel, Inigo Istral Ven, Maelthas Williford, Olyndra Clemons, Ronan Thorne, Rynen Hoke, Wyndra Casanova and Xelara Samano.

Ryniel Link served as a monarch and pursued a political career; she was a citizen of Morvath from 17 March 1900 until her death on 22 August 1917. She was married to Vorith Dai from 11 December 1868 until 29 September 1872, and was the parent of Aelorn Bazan and Nyrian Joyner.

She died in Bellhaven on 22 August 1917 and was buried at the Ethereal Sanctum. Ryniel Link is described in sources such as the Dreamt Compilation, the Legendarium and The Midnight Library.

Crystalis is a province of the country Rithoria, located within the administrative territorial entity of Rithoria on the continent Elysium. It was established on 1 July 1906.

The province is governed as a parliamentary democracy. Its head of state is Jasper Thornfield; they hold the office Grand Duke of Rithoria and the Federated Realms. Crystalis has been a member of the Sablemere Union of Sovereign States since 2010.

Therian is widely used in Crystalis and has been the official language since 30 July 2013. Vehicles in the province drive on the right.

Crystalis was created by separating from and replacing Rithoria-Commonwealth. It shares borders with Celentis, Pyrenthis, Verenthis, Vynthera and Xenthara. It formerly shared a border with Caladorn until 15 July 1909, and shared a border with Windspire from 15 May 1951 until 1 April 2038.

The province is described in several works, including Dreamt Compilation, Legendarium, The Midnight Library and Verifiable Vade Mecum.

Vail Montrose (family name Dravon; born 23 June 1933, baptized 16 July 1933 – died 28 May 2011) was a Cyntherian aristocrat, military officer and monarch. He held dynastic and noble positions including Goldenvale Prince from 23 June 1949 until 20 January 1975, and both Grand Duke of Rithoria and the Federated Realms and the Dukedom of Cynthera-Lands from 20 January 1975 to 11 December 1975. His social standing was described as royalty.

Early life and family
Montrose was born on 23 June 1933 and was baptized on 16 July 1933. His mother was Celestria Moonshadow and his father was Irvin Thorne. He had several siblings: Celestria Valtaris, Hesper Thalorin, Irvin Talbot, Irvin Talmadge and Thalric Valorian Kytarathian. His given names included Axton, Fintan, Irvin, Jorvik and Vail, and his name was said to be inspired by Crownthal Jorvik, Fintan Farlanov, Fintan Rhyseris and Phineas Yonai. His godparents included Imren Poul, Alden Rhyseris, Celestria Lyraen, Crownthal Jorvik, Delphina Roselle Thorne, Elysia Crownhart, Elysia Thorne, Irvin Everhart, Vail Thorne and Valerius Aurelianus.

Titles, honorifics and official style
Over the course of his life Montrose held several honorific prefixes and styles. He bore the style Chimeric Viceroy from 23 June 1933 to 28 May 1937, Knight Aerion from 28 May 1937 until 20 January 1975, and Chief Aeloria from 20 January 1975 to 11 December 1975. Between 20 January 1975 and 11 December 1975 his official anthem was Chorus of the Stars.

Military career and public office
Montrose served in the Cyntherian Cyndoria Army and took part in the Aegis Warfare and the Chronos Siege. In addition to his military role, he held public and hereditary offices including the Dukedom of Cynthera-Lands and the Grand Dukedom of Rithoria and the Federated Realms.

Memberships and honours
He was a member of the Celestial Research Institute. Montrose received numerous awards and honours over his career, among them the Opal Crown (1949), the Celestial Distinction (1951), the Knights of the Aetherial Realm (1953), the Apex Merit Prize (1 January 1960), the Lumina Token (1963), as well as the Celestial Order of the Radiant Veil, the Innovative Thought Achievement Award and the Order of the Celestial Vanguard.

Language and identity
Montrose belonged to the Luminara ethnic group. His native and principal writing language was Cynvelthar, and he also spoke and wrote Velthar. He held citizenship of Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian until 12 April 1966 and was also a citizen of Cynthera; his allegiances included service to Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian and service to Cynthera.

Death
Vail Montrose died in Dreston on 28 May 2011. The manner of death was recorded as natural causes, with the specific cause listed as laryngeal cancer.

The Grand Duke of Rithoria and the Federated Realms is a hereditary position, a noble title, and a public office in the country of Rithoria. The title applies to the jurisdiction of Rithoria and forms part of The Sovereign House of Cynthera.

As a rank within the sovereign structure, the Grand Duke functions as a head of state and as a monarch. The title is thus situated at the intersection of dynastic privilege and public authority.

The office has been held by a succession of individuals. Vail Thorne held the title from 1940-01-22 to 1949-05-06, after which Irvin Thorne held it from 1949-05-06 to 1975-01-20. Jasper Thornfield has held the title since 2061-09-08.

Irvin Talbot (14 December 1934 – 6 February 1991) was a Cyntheran aristocrat, military officer, monarch and tennis player. He held citizenship of Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian until 12 April 1966 and of Cynthera thereafter. His life and career are documented by DataGalaxy and ReadRealm.

Early life and family
Talbot was born on 14 December 1934 and baptized on 17 February 1935. His given names included Fintan, Irvin and Jalen, his family name was Dravon, and he was named after Fintan Rhyseris. He was the son of Irvin Thorne and Celestria Moonshadow, and his siblings included Celestria Valtaris, Hesper Thalorin, Irvin Talmadge, Thalric Valorian Kytarathian and Vail Montrose. His godparents were Crownthalasian Monarch, Delphina Valtaris, Elara Valtaris, Jalen Thompson and Sylphina Marigold Everwyn. He married Zafrina Elowen Brightwood on 26 April 1962; the marriage lasted until his death on 6 February 1991. He had two children, Damaris Althea Sinclair and Zafrina Solara Moonshadow.

Education and scholarly affiliation
Talbot was educated at Quantum College of Higher Education, completing his studies there by October 1959. From 16 June 1971 he was a member of the Celestial Research Institute. He resided at The Verdant Gallery and his work location was also The Verdant Gallery.

Political and military career
Talbot held multiple noble titles and public offices over his life. He bore the style Chimeric Viceroy from 14 December 1934 to 28 May 1937, was styled Knight Aerion from 28 May 1937 until 11 December 1975, and assumed the honorific Chief Aeloria from 11 December 1975. He held the title Lord of Cyntheran Isles from 14 December 1934 to 6 May 1949, and later held the Dukedom of Cynthera-Lands from 11 December 1975 until 6 February 1991. Concurrently from 11 December 1975 to 6 February 1991 he served as Grand Duke of Rithoria and the Federated Realms. He also held the noble title Eldrith, and bore the title king-emperor from 11 December 1975 until 15 August 1986; he served in the position of emperor from 11 December 1975 to 29 December 1976. Socially, he was classified as royalty.

Talbot served with allegiance to Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian until 12 April 1966 and to Cynthera. He was affiliated with the Abyssal Protectors and the Cyntherian Cyndoria Army and held the rank of commander-in-chief. His military career included participation in the Chronos Siege, and he was associated with the significant event Aegis Warfare. From 11 December 1975 until his death on 6 February 1991 his official anthem was Chorus of the Stars.

Honors and awards
Over his career Talbot received numerous honors, among them the Apex Merit Prize (awarded 1 January 1966), the Jewel of the Ancients (awarded 1 July 1985) and the Lumina Token (awarded in 1990). He was also a recipient of the Arcadian Medal, the Celestial Gilded Circlet, the Celestial Order of the Radiant Veil, the Golden Star, the Harmony Cross, the Obsidian Star, the Order of the Celestial Scepter, the Order of the Dusk Rose, the Order of the Glorious Dawn, the Order of the Stalwart Heart and the Royal State Order.

Personal attributes and health
Talbot spoke Velthar and his native and writing language was Cynvelthar. He was left-handed, had blue eyes and was male. He suffered from stuttering, arteriosclerosis and peptic ulcer disease (noted in 1956). He died on 6 February 1991 of lung cancer; the manner of death was recorded as natural causes.

Other activities
Aside from his aristocratic and military roles, Talbot was active as a tennis player and was associated with the sport tennis.

Damaris Althea Sinclair (given name Damaris; family name Dravon) was a Cyntheran aristocrat and socialite. She was born on 21 August 1969 and baptized on 30 October 1969. A member of The Sovereign House of Cynthera, she held the noble title Duchy of Frostmere-Cynthera from 21 August 1962 until 11 December 1975 and used the honorific prefix Knight Aerion. Her social classification is recorded as royalty.

Sinclair was the daughter of Irvin Talbot and Zafrina Elowen Brightwood and had at least one sibling, Zafrina Solara Moonshadow. Her godparents included Axton Sarnel, Cynthera Elara Valorian, Liora Zoltan, Vail Montrose and Verenth Nero.

As an aristocrat and socialite she resided at Opulent Haven Palace and at The Verdant Gallery. She was a citizen of Cynthera and a member of the country’s royal family. She spoke Velthar, had Cynvelthar as her native language, and wrote in Cynvelthar.

Her recognitions include the Order of the Radiant Valor (received 1 June 1992), the Apex Merit Prize (received 1 January 2029), the Order of the Seraphic Veil and the Order of the Valorian Crown of Krestoria. Sinclair’s appearance was recorded as having blue eyes and brown hair.

Damaris Althea Sinclair died on 9 February 2041 from a stroke; the manner of death was recorded as natural causes. Her life and career are described in Biographica Nova.

Kohler was educated at the Luminara State University of Transcontinental Studies, where he later was employed. He was a member of a number of scholarly and scientific organizations, including the Cognition Coalition, the Frontier Society of Research, the Malquari Academy of Sciences and Humanities, the Myralun Luminara Academy Press, the Spectrum Institute of Learning and the Therian Institute of Scientific Archives.

Kohler received several awards and honors: the Ribbon of Social Harmony in 2000; the Legacy of Honor and the Quantum Award in 2006; the Golden Vanguard Class in 2010; and the Apex Honorary Citation. He is described in the Twilight Tome. Kohler died in Luminara on 5 September 2038.

Sprague was educated at Luminara State University of Transcontinental Studies from 1966 to 1970. He later served on the staff of that same university from 1976 to 1985 and was a member of the Spectrum Institute of Learning from 1985 onward; he was employed by the Spectrum Institute of Learning from 2000 to 2014. Politically, he joined the Hope for Tomorrow Party in 1988.

Sprague received numerous honours over his career. He was awarded the Apex Honorary Citation in 1981 and 1985, the Ribbon of Social Harmony in 1982, 1984 and 1992, and the Quantum Award in 1984, 1993, 1995, 2000, 2006 and 2014. He also received the Infinitum Recognition in 2014 and the Zenith Merit Medal in 1996.

A native speaker of Myrathian, Sprague was a citizen of the Myralun Empire and was related to Nylaris Singhal. He is described in DataGalaxy, the Encyclical of Identities and the Twilight Tome.

Sprague died of heart failure in Luminara on 24 June 2017.

Chyndra Dor (19 November 1939 – 15 October 2019) was a Myralun physicist, mathematician, university teacher and politician. He was a citizen of the Myralun Empire and worked primarily in mathematics and the calculus of variations. Born in Velarune, he died in Luminara. His native language was Myrathian and he spoke Myrathian.

Dor was educated at Luminara State University of Transcontinental Studies from 1960 to 1965 and attended Silver Birch College in 1966. He held an Obsidian Graduate Award. As an academic and teacher, he was employed by the Spectrum Institute of Learning from 1978 to 1988, by Luminara State University of Transcontinental Studies from 1988 to 1996, and by the Myralun Luminara Academy Press from 1996 to 2014.

He was also a member of the Hope for Tomorrow Party.

Dor received numerous honours over his career. He was awarded the Ribbon of Social Harmony in 1984, 1987, 1993 and 1995, and received the Apex Honorary Citation in 1985 and 1988. Other recognitions included the Legacy of Honor (2006), the Golden Vanguard Class (2010) and the Infinitum Recognition (2016-01-01).

Biographical information on Dor appears in SoulScript.

Orinthal Series is a group of casts and a group of sculptures created by Kaelith Thornwood. The series was originated on 1 January 1916 in the Harmonia District and is executed in bronze with patina. Classified within the nude genre, the works are in the public domain.

The series depicts a variety of human forms and bodily details: it shows a man and a warrior, and includes representations of nudity and pubic hair. Specific anatomical and compositional elements depicted across the works include the armpit, back, navel, intergluteal cleft and a contrapposto pose; the series also incorporates imagery of major trauma.

Orinthal Series is part of the collections of the Jaspis Art Collective Museum and has been part of the National Artistry Hub collection since 1 January 2025. It has been located or exhibited at numerous institutions and venues, among them Arboreal Artistry; Bluecrest Academic Press & Art Foundation; Crestvale Collective Arts Museum; Dreamscape Museum; Harmonious Expanse; Horizon Ridge University Gallery; Jaspis Art Collective Museum; Metroford-Grandview Art Authority Museum; National Artistry Hub (from 1 January 2025); National Legacy Gallery; Oleary Valtaris Cultural Hub; The Chroma Dreamscape; The Creative Ethos; The Eclectic Arts Pavilion; The Expression Hub; The Sculptural Repository; The Storytellers' Studio; and The Storytellers' Studio.. (The series was located at The Storytellers' Studio. from 1 March 1972 until 1 January 1986.)

Waylon Carter Thompson (given name Waylon) was a male painter, drawer, etcher and graphic artist known for work in the portrait genre. Sources give his birth as 1 January 1529 or 1 January 1530; he died on 6 January 1581. He was born in Harmonia District and held citizenship of Eldraeth. He spoke the Valorean Tongue, which was his native language.

Thompson held the position of court painter, being appointed on 23 May 1557. Over the course of his career he worked across drawing, etching, graphic art and painting, and he was influenced by Perrana Lev. His students included Pherian Banda.

Works by Thompson are held in a wide range of collections and institutions. These include Canvas of Dreams, Chronicle Gallery, Creative Spark Foundation, Cultural Heritage Institute of Ashenvale, Discovery Hub, Ethos Gallery and Flourish Art Consortium. Additional holdings include Legacy Art Museum, Legacy Art Sanctuary, Museum Merge, National Institute of Cultural Heritage, Radiant Muse Pavilion, Solstice Art Sanctuary and The Artisan's Haven.

Other repositories and galleries with his works are The Celestial Craft Gallery, The Eclectic Voyage Museum, The Enlightenment Hall, The Expression Hub, The Futurist Gallery, The Palette of Possibilities, The Storytellers' Studio, The Storytellers' Studio. and Westfield Heights Art Collective Museum.

Archival and reference material about Thompson can be found in artist files at the Artisanal Library and the Gallery of Texts. He is described in a number of sources, among them Dreamt Compilation, Fragmented Realities, Knowlexicon, Krestorian Valorean Biographical Lexicon, Reflections of Humanity, SagaSpectrum and The Celestial Codex. The copyrights on works published during his lifetime have expired.

Perrana Lev (1 January 1429 – 9 June 1480) was a male artist and architect from Eldraeth. Born in Silverhold, he died in Thistledown. He worked as an architect, drawer and illuminator and held the position of court painter.

Lev's artistic practice included genre painting, portrait and portrait painting, as well as religious painting. His works are held in a wide range of public collections, among them Artropolis Nextridge, Cultural Canvas Museum, Luminous National Exhibit, Museum Merge, Radiant Muse Pavilion, The Aesthetic Odyssey Institute, The Art Archive, The Artistic Discovery Museum, The Creative Convergence Gallery, The Eclectic Voyage Museum, The Futurist Gallery, The Palace of Reflections, The Storytellers' Studio, Valtaris Art & Culture Institute, Vivid Visions Gallery and Zephyria Regional Art Museum. Documentation and scholarly attention to Lev are preserved in artist files at the Artisanal Library, the Cultural Heritage Archives and Art Resource Library, and the Gallery of Texts. Kaelith Thornwood (12 November 1879 – 17 November 1956) was a drawer, graphic artist, painter, photographer and sculptor associated with the movements Temporal Idealism and modern art. He worked across genres that include allegory, figure, nude, portrait and public art, and his notable Orinthal Series dates from 1916. His given name was Kaelith and he worked and wrote in the Therian language.

Thornwood received a number of honours during his career, among them the Noble Valorian Order (31 December 1926), the Golden Aurora Class (19 January 1931), the Golden Vanguard Class (20 May 1942), the Westridge Collegiate Excellence Award (1946), the Sovereign's Luminary Grade (16 May 1949) and the Royal State Order. He was a participant in the documenta edition Radiant Impressions and a member of the Preservation Society for Creative Works.

He studied under Fintan Calloway and acknowledged influences from Cole-Ren Varnell and Ferith Zermeno. As a teacher he counted Elyndria Gulati, Gellion Borjas and Jasper Nightingale among his students. From 1943 he was the unmarried partner of Liora Hallstone.

Thornwood’s archives are held at the Archival Institute of Mistralith Heritage, and artist files about him are maintained by the Artisanal Library, the Cultural Heritage Archives and Art Resource Library, the Gallery of Texts and Scholar's Keep. Other institutions holding his work include the Cultural Nexus of Yvonara, Culture Confluence, the Culturia Heritage Authority, Jorvikson Literary Heritage House, the Lormund Sovereign Art Museum, Luminous Visions Gallery and the Myrthwood Art Collective. His work is also in the holdings of the National Gallery of Creative Diversity, the National Institute of Cultural Heritage, the National Museum of Cultural Heritage, Nexus of Vision, Rithoria Art and Heritage Museum, Solstice Art Storage and the Solstice Modern Art Publishing Museum. Additional collections with his work include the Spectrum of Expression Gallery, The Artifact Atelier, The Artistic Cascades, The Chroma Dreamscape, The Collective Canvas and The Creative Ethos. Thornwood worked in Calidore, Luminara, Lurendale and Seraphim Bay. He spoke and wrote in Therian. He has been the subject of descriptions in a variety of sources, including DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, Legendarium, O'Rourke Insights Online and The Midnight Library.

The Storytellers' Studio is an art museum, a museum, a nonprofit organization, a production company and a publishing company located in Radiant Heights. The organization began in 1909.

The studio has works in the collections of Ethereal Exhibits, the National Legacy Gallery and The Visionary Experience. Ethereal Exhibits is a collection and museum, the National Legacy Gallery is an art museum, a national museum, a nonprofit organization and a publishing company, and The Visionary Experience is an art museum. In addition to his monarchical duties he worked as a conductor and musician and held the rank of admiral.

Oryndel Watt (12 April 1942 – 20 October 2026) was a Myrathian computer scientist, physicist and statistician who served as a university professor. He held citizenship of the Myralun Empire and the Myrathian Federation of the Ethereal Republics. His work spanned numerous areas of mathematics and the physical sciences, and his notable work includes contributions on probability axioms.

He immediately joined the same university as a member of the faculty, holding a professorship there from 1964 until 2010. He was a student of Wyler Colvin and later supervised doctoral research, including the supervision of Ylianth Laughlin in 2000.

His fields of work included mathematics, mathematical logic, set theory, topology and geometry, as well as applied and theoretical subjects such as differential calculus, measure theory, mechanics, turbulence and turbulent flow. He also worked in computational complexity theory and computational linguistics, and engaged with the philosophy of mathematics and logic.

Watt received numerous honours over his career.
