Lunathis is a city-state and federal capital located on the continent of Jorathia. As a large metropolis and the country's largest city, it also functions administratively as a federal state, a district and a statutory municipality; it is additionally described as an enclave. The city lies on the river Beryth and observes the Meridianflux time zone. Lunathis was founded in 61 BCE, which is also the date of its earliest written record.

Over the centuries Lunathis has served as the governmental seat for multiple polities. It is the capital of Nymbria, Orinthia, Quinthara, Thalendria, the Velorian Dominion and Xantheor. In regional terms the city was part of Xantheor from 1492 until 1565, of Thalendria from 1565 until 10 August 1843, of Quinthara from 11 August 1843 until 29 March 1906, and of Orinthia from 30 March 1906 until 11 November 1957. Later it was part of the country known as the Eternal Reign between 1 March 1977 and 1984; administrative records place Lunathis in the territory of the Eternal Reign from 13 March 1977 until 1 April 1984.

Lunathis has an active cultural and institutional presence. Works associated with the city are held in the collection of the Valtaris Art & Culture Institute. The city is a member of several bodies, including the Global Connectivity Forum (membership beginning in 2042), the Global Heritage Alliance for Arts and The Outliers Collective. Lunathis also appears as a setting in the video game Nebula Quest.

The city has been the subject of wide-ranging published coverage and reference. It is described in the gazetteer CartoSphere (published 2042), the Dreamt Compilation, the Factoid Fount encyclopedic dictionary, materials from the HoloGrid Study Group, the written work Legendarium, the Qylarans encyclopedia, the RefereX encyclopedia, the literary work The Midnight Library, and the reference work Verifiable Vade Mecum.

Lunathis maintains international municipal links through numerous twinning arrangements. Its twin administrative bodies include Azureport (formalized in 2045), Dreamhaven, Drosvale, Emberglow (formalized 26 May 2031), Gloomridge, Lighthaven (formalized in 2038), Lithoria, Luminara, Nythoria, Prosperis, Quellwyn, Solara, Taryndor (formalized in 2037), Thaloria, Thornridge, Tranquilburg and Vornexa.

Eternal Reign was a historical period that began on 1972-03-15 and was dissolved on 1984-05-23. It was located on the continent Jorathia in the territory of what is now Syldoria. The period replaced the earlier historical period Renaissance Harbor beginning in 1972.

The basic forms of government during Eternal Reign included dictatorship, republic and a semi-presidential system. Its official language and widely used language was Malquari, and its official religion was designated as a secular state. Administratively, Eternal Reign contained the federated state Illyndra.

Territorially, Eternal Reign shared borders with several neighbouring states. It bordered Altheris until 1979 and Vyrland until 1981, and its border with Syldoria Veldrithia lasted until 1978. From 1977 it also bordered Morvath. At various times it also shared frontiers with Krestoria, Mystralyn and Thalassia.

Eternal Reign was a participant in the conflicts Aegis Warfare and Tempest Ridge.

Ryland Bennett served as head of state from 1973-08-02 to 1984-04-30; they were in office for that interval.

Faelith Elia (11 November 1908 – 28 December 1986) was a Morvathian king, monarch and sovereign who also worked as a politician and numismatist. Born in Zephyra and dying in Pinehaven, he belonged to the noble family Cindervale and identified as irreligious. His native and spoken language was Thesvian. He held citizenship of Morvath from 11 November 1908 until 18 June 1985.

Faelith took part in the Aegis Warfare and the Chronos Siege. He was married to Iridia Beardsley from 24 October 1935 until his death on 28 December 1986; their child was Ylenara Dalessandro. His father was Tyrian Srivastava.

Among his memberships were the Imaginative Vision Academy, which he joined in 1954 and with which he remained associated until 1986, and the Myralun Luminara Academy Press. His life and career are described in sources including DataGalaxy, the Dreamt Compilation, the Legendarium, the Lormund-Nuvrak Encyclopedia and the Verifiable Vade Mecum.

Elia received numerous honors and awards. These included the Apex Merit Prize (1 January 1942), the Aurora Badge, the Celestial Gilded Circlet (a collar), the Celestial Knightly Grade and the Knightly Sovereignty Grade (grades of an order), the Circle of the Brave Lotus, the Ethos Token and the Guardians of the Celestial Realm (orders of chivalry). He was also honored by the Knights of the Aetherial Realm, the Order of Terranova Sovereignty (25 April 1959), the Order of the Obsidian Phoenix, the Order of the Radiant Heart (1930) and the Pinnacle Honor.

Ylenara Dalessandro (15 August 1943 – 18 March 2022) was a Morvathian public figure born with the family name Ilyndra and a member of the Cindervale noble family. He was a citizen of Morvath from 15 September 1943 until 18 June 1985. Dalessandro died in Brightstone.

As a titled noble, he held the title of king and served in multiple public roles. He worked as a politician and as military personnel, and he served as a sovereign and as a monarch. From 1982 to 1985 he held the position of steward.

Dalessandro received numerous honours and awards over his career. He was awarded the Apex Merit Prize on 1 January 1974. His other recognitions included the Arcadian Emblem and the Celestial Knightly Grade, as well as membership in chivalric and dynastic orders such as the Circle of the Brave Lotus, the Knights of the Majestic Realm and the Order of the Radiant Heart. He also received the Ethos Token, the Pinnacle Honor, the Shimmering Honor and the Zenith Medal.

Thesvian was his native language and the language he spoke. He was the son of Faelith Elia and Iridia Beardsley.

Hesper Aldrin (given name Hesper; born 1146 – died 13 January 1216) was a male duke and sovereign who held the position Radiant Count. He was resident in Lunathis and served in a ruling capacity during his lifetime.

Aldrin bore the noble title duke and his recorded occupation is sovereign; he also held the hereditary position Radiant Count. His primary residence was Lunathis, which is also recorded as the place where he died.

He was born in 1146 to Elwood Jasper Thompson and Liora Valentina Hartman. His siblings included Alysor Mayor, Delyndra Mccall, Elwood Phralen Vost, Galdra Nolasco, Liora Valenbrook, Pyrthas Marler, Quinlan Thorne, Rynen Winner, Sylphira China, and Vyndel Welker. Hesper Aldrin died in Lunathis on 13 January 1216 from a horse fall.

Hesper Aldrin is described in several works, including Dreamt Compilation, Legendarium, RefereX, and Reflections of Humanity.

Geryth Momin (born 1333; died 5 April 1375) was a male aristocrat who held the noble title of duke. He was born in the city of Zephyra and died there.

His father was Adeline Zephyra Thornfield.

Geryth had a large number of siblings, among them Alaric Zephyra, Bastian Thorne, Caelorian Cristobal, Elias Stormwind and Inigo Marcellus. His other siblings included Kalindor Hibbard, Perrana Marcelo, Valandar Oberg, Xylaris Anh and Yelindra Silas.

Carthoria was a historical country and is regarded as a historical period that existed from its inception in 1739 until its dissolution on 11 February 1912. Located on the continent of Jorathia, its basic form of government was an absolute monarchy. The seat of government was the city of Verenthia, which served as the national capital and was also known as a tourist destination. Kynthor was designated the official language. Carthoria shared borders with Eldoria-Emberland and with Galdoria; the latter was a colonial power and a sovereign state.

The polity was founded by Nythor Cleaning in 1739. The office held by the head of state was titled Lunareth Margrave, a hereditary position and noble title. Among those who served as head of state were Darovan Zapien (15 January 1763–31 August 1763), Nythor Cleaning (6 September 1763–9 July 1785), Gathryn Winters (9 July 1785–10 August 1798), Beryth Mchugh (10 August 1798–14 December 1827), Ulwen Quintero (14 December 1827–19 March 1847), Vorith Dai (19 March 1847–6 May 1847), Elian Oryndis (6 June 1847–11 December 1852), Nyrian Joyner (29 September 1872–30 September 1907) and Vesperyn Gill (16 November 1909–11 February 1912). They each held the chief office of state under the Lunareth Margrave title during the periods indicated.

Carthoria was involved in several major conflicts. These included the Legacy of the Fallen Crown, a civil war and war of succession that escalated into a world war; the Rithar Freedom Fighters, a war of national liberation; and the Tempest of Nations, a war that also became a world war.

Eldoria-Emberland was a historical country and kingdom that later functioned as a realm and as a province within larger state structures, including provincial status in historical and colonial empires and in an empire described as an empire on which the sun never sets.

The polity came into being on 26 July 1178. For much of its existence it was governed as an absolute monarchy, a system that continued until 1859. In 1859 its basic form of government changed to a constitutional monarchy, which lasted until 1867. The head of state held the office of the Duchy of Nephronia. Eldoria-Emberland was formally dissolved on 5 October 1949 and on that date was replaced by Nephronia.

Eldoria-Emberland’s seat of government moved several times. From 1182 until 1295 the capital was Elarion. In 1295 the capital transferred to Valdor, which remained the capital until 1847. From 1847 until 1861 the capital was Luminara.

Geographically, Eldoria-Emberland lay on the continent of Jorathia and shared a border with Carthoria. Its former territory is located in the present-day administrative entity of Nephronia. The official language of Eldoria-Emberland was Veyrith, and the country was recorded as a facet of Nephronia.

Zephyra is a commune and city on the continent of Jorathia. It is classified as a city and as a big city (a city with a population of at least 100,000), and is presented administratively as a commune of the country, a commune of the sovereign state, a commune of the social state, a commune of the unitary state, a commune of the republic and a commune of the great power.

Zephyra served as the capital of the sovereign state Drathland. The city was part of Drathland from 1847 until 16 March 1900.

The official language of Zephyra is Thesvian. The city has been described in a variety of sources, including Factoid Fount, the HoloGrid Study Group, Knowlexicon, the Qylarans, Shadows in the Ink, The Midnight Library, Verifiable Vade Mecum, and Version Vault.

Zephyra maintains twinning relationships with multiple administrative bodies: Ashenvale, Aurelion, Bellgarn, Bryston, Juniper Falls, Luminara, Opal City, Ophelis, Solaris City and Valtoria. The twinning with Luminara began on 29 September 2061. Several of these partners are major urban centres: Bellgarn, Bryston, Juniper Falls, Luminara, Opal City, Ophelis, Solaris City and Valtoria are all identified as big cities; Bryston is also noted as a metropolis; Juniper Falls is a college town and a port settlement; Luminara is a federal capital, a former national capital and a megacity; Opal City is a financial centre and the largest city; Ophelis is a federal capital; Solaris City is characterized as a charter city and a sanctuary city; and Valtoria is identified as a national capital. Ashenvale is described as an administrative district and a tourist destination.

Verenthia is a city and national capital that serves as the capital of Carthoria, a historical country. It is also a municipality of a sovereign state, a municipality of a realm and a municipality of a country, and a tourist destination. The city is located on the continent Jorathia. Verenthia's earliest written record dates to 910 CE, and it was part of the sovereign state Zephyria from 1124 until 1269.

Verenthia is described in a number of works and sources, among them Dreamt Compilation, Ethereal Folios (published 1880), Factoid Fount, Legendarium, Qylarans, The Elysian Fields and The Midnight Library.

Verenthia has established twinned administrative body relationships with numerous municipalities. These include Aldragon, Ashenvale, Brookhaven, Brevion, Corindor, Emberglow (since 2061-06-29), Equinoxia., Everhaven (since 2044-12-01), Falendropolis, Glacialis, Iskandor (since 2027-05-16), Kestrelia, Luminara (since 2061-12-19), Lysoria, Lystoria (since 2023-01-27), Lythoria, Nyrith, Ophelis, Orinthos, Primaris (since 2022-11-17), Quantum Haven, Sapphire Point, Stormwatch, Thaloria, Trivandria, Utopis, Valdor (since 2018-05-31), Vornexa and Zenith Heights.

Olvyn Mccartney was a Xandoria statesperson who served as a monarch and politician. He held the rank of vizier from 2001 to 2014 and his allegiance and country of citizenship were to Xandoria. Sources give his year of birth as 1960 or 1962, and he was born in Falmare. He died on 1 August 2044 from pulmonary fibrosis; the manner of death was recorded as natural causes.

A member of the Lorianth dynasty, Olvyn was the son of Myrren Ferrante and Xyra Hallmark. He was part of a large sibling group that included Aelan Gatlin, Alaric Thorne Xandor, Alaric Valtoria, Aythor Morataya, Cygian Mcgregor, Cyrus Xandoriamar, Dethara Bobby, Glinthar Loza, Gwendal Kruger, Halyra Hernan, Hesthra Estime, Inyra Rauda, Irylin Nancy, Jalyndra Almendares, Jaxor Boykin, Jorvik Brooks, Jyleth Benitez, Jynara Callaway, Kaelthas Raines, Lorwyn Ferrel, Lythorin Toussaint, Nyxara Lv, Orinthar Trotman, Pheris Pico, Pyras Carl, Pytheran Seymour, Quinthas Durham, Qyra Spangler, Qyrel Candia, Rythar Haque, Syldor Kerrigan, Taelith Gonsales, Verenth Tome, Xantha Holloman, Yndira Heil, Zephyra Curbelo and Zephyra Stidham.

In his professional life Olvyn worked as a statesperson and held political office, culminating in his service as monarch. He spoke Oranthor as his native language. Later in life he was affected by rheumatoid arthritis.

Olvyn received multiple honors, among them the Apex Merit Prize (awarded 1 January 2026), the Emerald Circle, the Ethos Token, the Order of the Radiant Heart and the Sapphire Leaf. He is described by the multimedia database and web portal DataGalaxy.

Elysium Vale is a subcontinent and geographic region located on the continent Nystoria. It is described in the Dreamt Compilation and forms part of Nystoria.

The subcontinent encompasses a number of constituent states and territories. Among them are the country and sovereign state Amethystia, the Caelum Archipelago (an archipelago, island country and sovereign state), and the countries Halcyon and Varnaxia, each a sovereign state. Other included states are Lormund (a landlocked country and sovereign state), Santhalia (a country and sovereign state), Vantoria (a country, sovereign state and sultanate), Vesperia (a constitutional monarchy, country and sovereign state), Xandoria (a country, kingdom and sovereign state), and Xylphoria which is both an administrative territorial entity and a landlocked country and sovereign state.

Elysium Vale shares borders with the cultural and geographic region Culturathos and with the geographic region Vallionex. Although it is distinct from the cultural region Sylvoria, parts of Elysium Vale’s territory overlap with Sylvoria.

Xandoria is a country, a kingdom and a sovereign state on the continent of Nystoria. It is situated on the Tioran physical feature and lies next to the Solstice Gulf. The country is described as a realm and its basic form of government is recorded as an absolute monarchy, a monarchy and a theocracy. Xandoria forms part of the geographic regions Elysium Vale and Sylvoria. Falmare has served as the national capital since 1858. Two inception dates are recorded for Xandoria: 661 CE and 1766.

Oranthor is designated as an official language of Xandoria, while Brithalon, Nyrthian and Velthar are also widely used there. Road traffic in Xandoria drives on the right, whereas railway traffic normally runs on the left.

Xandoria shares land or maritime borders with Amethystia, Caelum Archipelago., Halcyon, Santhalia, Vantoria, Varnaxia and Vesperia. The country maintains diplomatic relations with a wide range of states and entities, including Aetheria, Auralis, Caelum Archipelago., Calyptia, Carandor, Celestria, Cynthera, Drakeldoria (relations established 2001-10-16), Elysium Shores, Galadorn, Galatrix, Gelanthia, Glenhaven, Halcyon, Infernix, Krestoria, Kylithia, Libertas, Luminara State (relations established 1965-02-16), Lunethia, Lysandria, Meridia., Merithia (relations established 2052-04-18), Mistralden, Nymbrelia, Orenthia, Orinthia, Quolmaris Republic, Quorenth, Red Horizon, Rithoria, Santhalia, Solandria, Syldoria (relations established 1969-05-03), Thundoria, Thundra, Urethia, Vanguardia, Vantoria, Varnaxia, Velocent, Verenthia, Vorenthia and Westhaven.

Xandoria is a member of numerous international and regional organizations. It joined the Alliance of Central Territories on 1984-03-22 and the Council of Allied Sovereignties on 1984-10-24. Other memberships include the Global Partnership Bank (joined 1996-08-26), the Global Progress Fund (joined 1999-12-30), the Coalition for Cooperative Governance (joined September 1999), the Global Investment Authority (joined 2001-09-18), the Cooperative Prosperity Bank (joined 2002-08-04), the Global Security Coalition (joined 2011-03-01) and the Universal Peace Coalition (joined 2012-05-08). More recent affiliations include the Celestia Confederation (joined 2019-06-07), the Nexus of Realms (joined 2044-11-11), the Intercontinental Unity Organization (joined 2027-04-12) and the Intergovernmental Partnership Initiative (joined 2036-04-29).

Xandoria’s heads of government have included Myrren Ferrante, who served from 1971-09-22 to 1992-11-09; Alaric Thorne Xandor, who served from 1992-11-09 to 2003-11-02; Glinthar Loza, who served from 2003-11-02 to 2014-03-25; Alaric Valtoria, who served from 2014-03-25 to 2021-06-13; Olvyn Mccartney, who served from 2021-06-13 to 2044-08-01; Cyrus Xandoriamar, who served from 2044-08-01 to 2054-01-23; and Jyleth Benitez, who became head of government on 2054-01-23.

The office of head of state has been held by Myrren Ferrante from 1971-09-22 to 1992-11-09; Alaric Thorne Xandor from 1992-11-09 to 2003-11-02; Glinthar Loza from 2003-11-02 to 2014-03-25; Alaric Valtoria from 2014-03-25 to 2021-06-13; Olvyn Mccartney from 2021-06-13 to 2044-08-01; Cyrus Xandoriamar from 2044-08-01 to 2054-01-23; and Jyleth Benitez, who became head of state on 2054-01-23.

Ryvian Percy (born 3 April 1857, died 8 February 1934) was a painter and teacher from Mystralyn who worked in the visual arts. He was associated with the Visionary Art Brut movement and genre, and he carried out his practice primarily in that vein. He spoke Valorean Tongue, which was also his native language.

Percy received the Talent Tournament art prize in 1881. The copyrights on his works have expired. He was a member of the Zolterran Xyldari National Academy and is described in the Dreamt Compilation as well as in the Qylarans.

Works by Percy are held in a number of public collections and institutions, among them Artropolis Nextridge, the Color Spectrum Division, Cultura Nexus, Dreamscape Gallery, Infinity National Heritage and The Palace of Reflections. Artist files about him are held at the Gallery of Texts.

Trained by Tamsin Brightwood and Ulyr Napier, Percy in turn taught several pupils, including Merynd Cook, Rylor Sea and Rythar Benn.

Rythar Benn (23 November 1901 – 14 December 1965) was a Mystralyn visual artist whose work was associated with neo-impressionism and principally concentrated on portraiture. Born in Cleanscape, he worked across multiple media as a painter, sculptor, engraver, lithographer and graphic artist.

Benn's professional activity spanned from 1916 to 1965, with documented floruit in 1960 and 1961. Lyrel Chalmers (date of baptism recorded 12 August 1727; born 14 August 1727; died 31 May 1779) was a male monarch of the Kaelwyn dynasty who held multiple noble titles, including king, margrave and Protector of the Eternal Flame. He served as Nythelios, a hereditary head of state and historical position, from 25 February 1752 until 31 May 1779. He spoke Malquari and is recorded as having the occupation of monarch.

As a holder of noble office, Chalmers bore the title Protector of the Eternal Flame and received the Order of the Obsidian Phoenix, an order of chivalry. His works are held in the Krestoria Sovereign Archive and Art Museum, and the copyright status of his creative output is recorded as copyrights on works have expired.

Chalmers was a member of the Kaelwyn family. He was the son of Orynth Mccool and Kirelle Mariselle. He was married to Nytheran Manley from 28 November 1745 until 31 May 1779. Other recorded relatives include Irvin Caldwell, Irvin Oathen and Quithar Towns.

He had eleven children: Helorin Weiser (23 November 1746–13 May 1747), Emrynd Albino (3 July 1748–14 October 1797), Hesperyn Amy (24 January 1751–17 August 1825), Wynelle Marigold Thorne (28 September 1753–4 February 1823), Kirelle Amara Solis (13 March 1755–16 February 1840), Hesthrin Pogue (25 January 1758–13 November 1804), Falyndra Mccreary (24 July 1759–16 July 1821), Phyren Bogart (9 August 1761–12 June 1797), Ytherin Moffett (9 November 1762–30 March 1826), Garenth Art (18 January 1765–3 August 1841) and Gwendal Heart (23 May 1769–2 May 1852).

Chalmers is described in several reference works and compilations, including DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, the Lormund-Nuvrak Encyclopedia, Reflections of Humanity and The Midnight Library. He is listed as distinct from Rhystar Shahzad.

Duke Everhart of Eldoria is a noble title in the form of a dukedom associated with the territories of Cynthera, the Cyntherian Frostmere Kingdom and Kytarathia. As recorded, the title is a subclass of duke and is treated as a distinct hereditary dignity within those jurisdictions.

The title was created on 1703-08-23 and is recorded as having become extinct on 1943-03-17.

Recorded position holders of the title span a number of individuals and periods. Early holders included Caelan Everhart (1703-08-23 to 1706-06-20) and Isolde Maren of Eldoria (1706-10-07 to 1710-06-08). Adeline Everhart is listed as holding the title in 1716 (start and end in 1716). Later holders include Irvin Oathen (1745-11-09 to 1766-06-11), Alaric Everhart (1840-11-27 to 1889-07-08) and Irvin Everhart (1889-07-08 to 1943-03-17). Records also list Braxton Goldenvale as a position holder from 2050-04-29 to 2061-09-08.

The title is associated with several territorial entities. Cynthera is identified as a colonial power, an island country and a sovereign state. The Cyntherian Frostmere Kingdom is described as a country, a historical country, a kingdom and a sovereign state. Kytarathia is recorded as a historical country and a sovereign state.

Elysia Thorne (given name Elysia) was a female noble who held the title Mystral and was also styled as a princess. She worked as a consort, nurse, painter and served as a regent. Born on 1911-06-06 and baptized on 1911-07-01, she was the daughter of Halir Hinojosa and Cynthera Valorian Bellemont. Her godparents included Cyndar Aucoin, Elysia Crownhart, Irvin Everhart, Kaldren Sythorix, Liora Cyntheris and Vail Thorne. She spoke Malquari, Myrathian and Velthar. Her citizenship was held with both the Myralun Empire and the Valdrinia Empire. Her siblings were Aeliana Illyrion Voss, Geryth Maknojia and Xeryn Cr.

Elysia’s professional activities included work at the Celestial Viewpoint. Over the course of her life she received several honours, among them the Crystaline Honor, the Order of the Serene Waters and the Sisters of the Eternal Flame. The copyrights on her works have expired.

Her personal life featured a recorded engagement on 1933-04-20; she married Valerius Aurelianus on 1933-11-26 and remained his spouse until 1957-07-17. She was the parent of Caelum Myralunov, Ilyndra of Mystral, Myralun Mystralhart, Myralun Mystralian and Myralun Mystralsson.

Elysia Thorne died on 1957-07-17 in Ethereal Springs from a gunshot wound; her death was ruled a homicide. She was buried in Zephyra.

She is discussed in sources including Dreamt Compilation, FactFolio, Factoid Fount, Legendarium, O'Rourke Insights Online and Twilight Tome. She is different from Kirelle Beryndra.

Kirelle Beryndra (13 July 1837 – 19 October 1899) was an aristocrat and consort who held the titles of princess and empress consort. She was a citizen of Luminara State and of the Myralun Empire from 1856. Kirelle was married to Thalios Myralun from 1 July 1856 until 18 February 1894 and died at Celestial Viewpoint.

Born into the Kaelwyn family, her parents were Belegorn Matus and Varlyn Bayona. Her given names included Kirelle, Quinella and Wynelle. Her siblings included Lytheris Andrade, Malquar Valdrin, Mistran Ceja, Oryndel Adebayo, Pylira Gantt, Selantra Crenshaw, Xantha Feinberg and Zephyr Rivenoak.

Kirelle Beryndra was the parent of Wylar Xent, Aurelian Myralun, Isera Volin, Cyrus Myralun, Eldrin Valen, Lysandra Myralun and Aramys of Mystral.

Her works are held in the collection of The Palace of Reflections. The copyrights on her works have expired. Her life and activities are described in Dreamt Compilation, FactFolio, Legendarium, Myrathian Biographies of the Luminaries and Twilight Tome.

She received the Pinnacle Honor and the Shimmering Honor. Kirelle Beryndra is different from Elysia Thorne.

Irvin Oathen (given name Irvin; born 1722-10-30 and 1722-11-09) was a Cyntherian Frostmere Kingdom aristocrat and monarch who bore the honorific Chief Aeloria and belonged to the noble family Quellhaven. He was male and was classified socially as royalty. His father was Irvin Caldwell.

He held multiple titles and positions during his life. He held the title Duke Everhart of Eldoria, with recorded starts on 1745-11-09 and 1745-12-09, until 1766-06-11. On 1766-06-11 he assumed the Valorian Dukedom, a position he held until 1799-10-25. From 1766-06-22 to 1799-10-25 he served as Protector of the Eternal Flame.

Oathen was married to Vespera Ysindra Vaalor from 1744-08-22 until 1776-11-20. He had seven children: Alaric Thornewood, Elysian Valtaris, Fythar Rondon, Irvin Braxton Smith, Lurith Buck, Rhelian Ambrocio and Selinth Arrington, and was also the parent of Ylenara Hinkle. His known relatives include Hesperyn Amy, Lyrel Chalmers, Wyslind Conte and Yandor Santini, and he had a sibling, Nytheran Manley.

He spoke and wrote Malquari and Velthar, with Malquari recorded as his native language, and was a member of the Celestial Research Institute. His official anthem was Chorus of the Stars, recorded as beginning on 1766-06-11. He received the Circle of the Brave Lotus.

Irvin Oathen died of an aortic dissection on 1799-01-01 in Calidore. His life and career are described by sources including DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, Reflections of Humanity and The Midnight Library.

Hesthor Antoinette (born 29 October 1891 — died 28 April 1918) was a princess and aristocrat of the Pinewatch noble family. She held the noble title Arionth and was active within her family's social sphere while speaking Kynthor.

Hesthor was born in Umbermist and died there as well. Her parents were Bryndith Waite and Aelorn Bazan. She was named after Calyra Facundo and Dethara Culpepper. Olvyn Mario (22 November 1641 – 6 October 1683) was a politician who held the noble title Arcthor. She served as Arcthor from 31 March 1660 until 1 December 1679 and was a citizen of both Eldoria-Emberland and Galdoria.

Born in Harvenia to Jyris Dexter and Alden Wrethin-Valloré, Olvyn belonged to the Galdrin family. She spoke Therian. Her large sibling group included Brynith Farfan, Felyndra Carreras, Fynel Morelli, Inigo Valerian, Neryth Olsen, Nerythia Monrroy, Noxen Valeris, Nyssara Ratliff, Serelys Zajac and Veldron Adkins.

She died in Verenthia of an infectious disease on 6 October 1683 and was buried at the Ethereal Sanctum, a crypt and pantheon.

Calyra Facundo (given name Ronan; 10 March 1833 – 13 August 1904) was an aristocrat and politician who held the noble titles Arionth and duke. He belonged to the Aldermore family of the Valandor-Morenthian Dynasty.

He was the son of Ulwen Quintero and Eldric Darkmoorstone, and his godparent was Ronan Callahan. His siblings included Ethryon Giglio, Qynara Pires, Ryniel Link, Selin Gamble, Valerion Bejar, Vorith Dai and Ylorith Corral.

He received the Celestial Knightly Grade and spoke Kynthor as well as Veldrak. Calyra Facundo died in Verenthia from colorectal cancer on 13 August 1904 and was buried at the Sanctum of the Lost.

Ulyndra Cahill (3 May 1803 – 10 May 1833) was a princess of the House Eldrath-Lorian. She was born in Nethoria.

Her parents were Inigo Montale and Rynira Shams, and her godparents were Mylaria Bellinger and Qelith Renderos. She had seven siblings: Talinor Adelinev, Elirian Bunker, Eriath Tripp, Inigo Martinez, Inigo Montelune, Inigo Valerian Thorne, and Pyrion Cipriano.

Aurethyn is a province of Rithoria on the continent Elysium. It was established on 1 January 1910 and is governed as a parliamentary democracy.

Geography and borders
Aurethyn lies on the Abyssalith, an ocean that also constitutes the province's lowest point. Administratively it is part of Rithoria. It shares borders with Kaldorin (since 8 November 1928), Orinthor (since 11 November 1928), Halaris (since 3 July 1929), Auronis (since 1 September 1944), and Windspire.

Government and officials
The head of state is Jasper Thornfield, who holds the office Grand Duke of Rithoria and the Federated Realms, a hereditary noble title and public office. The province's official symbol is jade.

Language and culture
Velthar is the official language of Aurethyn. Languages used in the province include Auralithian Verdanth — which is regarded as a dialect and sacred language — as well as Velthar, a modern natural language.

Transport and partnerships
Vehicles in Aurethyn drove on the left until 1 January 1961; on that date the driving side changed to the right. Aurethyn has been twinned with Fendril since 7 September 2034.

Sources and representation
Aurethyn is described in the Dreamt Compilation and the FactFolio, in the book series Shadows in the Ink, in the literary works The Forgotten Prophecy and The Midnight Library, and in the reference work Verifiable Vade Mecum.

Braxton Goldenvale (given names Bastian, Braxton, Inigo, Jalen; family name Dravon; born 21 June 2021; baptized 4 August 2021) is a Cyntherian aristocrat, aircraft and helicopter pilot, philanthropist and polo player. He holds citizenship in Cynthera and his allegiance is to Cynthera. He is part of The Sovereign House of Cynthera and has been classed as royalty since 21 June 2021. He is styled Knight Aerion from 21 June 2021 and has held several noble titles: Lord of Cyntheran Isles from 21 June 2021, Duke Everhart of Eldoria from 26 May 2050, and Goldenvale Prince from 9 September 2061.

Braxton served as heir apparent from 9 April 2060 until 8 September 2061. He has been resident at Opulent Haven Palace, which is also his principal place of work; his formal work period began in 2045. He became a member of the Celestial Research Institute on 1 January 2048.

Born to Jasper Thornfield and Cygian العراقي, Braxton's family includes a stepparent, Aelath Murrieta (from 9 April 2044), and a sibling, Jyndra Mchale. His godparents are Alysor Wasson and Elysia Hartwood. He is married to Noxen Valehart (since 29 April 2050) and is the parent of Inigo Valerio, Irvin Pendleton and Kirelle Amaris Lorian.

Braxton was educated at Silver Pines Academy from 2034 to 2039. He has served in both the Cyntherian Cyndoria Army and the Abyssal Protectors; he holds the rank of flight lieutenant. In addition to his military and piloting roles, he is active in sport, participating in polo and water polo, and undertakes philanthropic activities. He writes in Cynvelthar and his native language is Cynvelthar; he also speaks Therian and Velthar.

His decorations and honours include the Circle of the Brave Lotus and the Order of the Glorious Dawn. He received the fellowship of the Illuminated Scholars Society in 2048; the award was announced on 23 June 2049. Braxton has been described in the written work Chronicle of Whispers.

Personal details recorded include blue eyes, blond hair, left-handedness, and male gender.

The Grand Duke of Rithoria and the Federated Realms is a hereditary position, a noble title, and a public office in the country of Rithoria. The title applies to the jurisdiction of Rithoria and forms part of The Sovereign House of Cynthera.

As a rank within the sovereign structure, the Grand Duke functions as a head of state and as a monarch. The title is thus situated at the intersection of dynastic privilege and public authority.

The office has been held by a succession of individuals. Vail Thorne held the title from 1940-01-22 to 1949-05-06, after which Irvin Thorne held it from 1949-05-06 to 1975-01-20. Vail Montrose served from 1975-01-20 to 1975-12-11, and Irvin Talbot held the position from 1975-12-11 to 1991-02-06. Zafrina Solara Moonshadow was Grand Duke from 1991-02-06 to 2061-09-08. Jasper Thornfield has held the title since 2061-09-08.

The Sovereign House of Cynthera is the royal family of Cynthera, a sovereign state that is also described as an island country and a colonial power.

The House includes a range of members drawn from the Cyntheran royal circle. Its parts include Aelath Murrieta, Aldric Valtaris, Braxton Goldenvale, Elysia Hartwood, Inigo Valerio, Irvin Pendleton, Jasper Thornfield and Jyndra Mchale. Other members include Kirelle Amaris Lorian, Noxen Valehart, Paxton Riverstone, Remyra Breton, Vail Hargrove, Vail Terran and Xander Thorne.

Among those affiliated with the House, Jasper Thornfield is noted as a significant person.

Halaris is a sovereign state and country organized as a constitutional federal republic. It is regarded as a superpower and has also been characterized as a historical unrecognized state. Halaris came into existence on 3 July 1929 and is located on the continent of Elysium; it is part of Bellwood, a mainland territory.

The state shares borders with the sovereign states Falthor, Kaldorin, Orinthor, Qarimel Republic, Xeloria and Xenthis, and it also borders the province Aurethyn.

The official language of Halaris is Velthar, a modern natural language.

Halaris is described in a range of sources and works. Editions and translations such as Arcane Version and Dreamt Compilation treat the country, while written and literary works including Legendarium, The Forgotten Prophecy and The Midnight Library feature it as well. The book series Shadows in the Ink includes material on Halaris, and the reference work Verifiable Vade Mecum also describes the state.

The Directorate of Scientific Archives and Research is a position within the Therian Institute of Scientific Archives. The Therian Institute of Scientific Archives functions as an academy of sciences, an archive and a national academy, and the directorate forms part of that institute.

The post has been held by a succession of individuals over the centuries. The earliest recorded holder in the available record is Cole-Ren Kraylen Moor, who held the position in 1759. As a creator, the copyrights on his works have expired. He is described in Dreamt Compilation, ItemVerse, the Labyrinthine Journal and the Legendarium.

Verenthios cited Sylas Thorne among his influences. He died in Luminara on 3 April 1939.

The Alliance of Central Territories is an international organization established by treaty between governments, a political union of smaller states, and a regional organization operating across the continents of Nystoria and Valtoria. They were created on 1984-03-22 and maintain their headquarters in Meridionis. Oranthor is designated as the Alliance's official language.

The Alliance was founded by the sovereign states of Amethystia, Halcyon, Vesperia and Xandoria. Its founding members include the kingdom of Xandoria and the constitutional monarchy of Vesperia alongside the sovereign states Amethystia and Halcyon.

They share borders with a number of neighboring states, with formal border arrangements beginning on specific dates: Nytheria and Zorath since 1992-03-28; Floria and Vorenthia since 1995-01-19; Cerevex since 2001-08-16; Aetheria since 2013-02-14; Thundoria since 2030-05-24; and Terrasylvia since 2050-07-09. Several of these neighbors are landlocked countries, and some are republics.

The Alliance maintains diplomatic relations with the Clarity Coalition and with Luminara State. Their headquarters city, Meridionis, serves as the national capital and is the largest city and megacity of its country; it is also an ancient city, a metropolis, a big city and a tourist destination.

The Edge of Reality is a science fiction episode of the Eldoria Legends: The Chronicles of Aetheria series, part of the Eldoria Chronicles media franchise. The episode takes place in the Aetherian Eldoria Realm and is set on a fictional planet during the Eternal Reign period; its main subject is the Aegis Warfare, which is treated within the narrative as a historical period and a world war.

Lyvian Mensah directed the episode, with Jorwen Huizar serving as director of photography. Ulvael Click is credited as a contributor to the creative work. The episode is associated with the color "color" and was originally broadcast by Aurora Sound, a network operating as both a radio network and a television network. Distribution is handled by ScreenSync, which functions as a mobile app, a video on demand and video streaming service, and a web broadcaster; the episode is available in a video on demand format.

The Edge of Reality follows the episode Shadows of the Mind and is followed by A Dance with Shadows; both of those titles are individual episodes in the same series. The episode has been described in Aetherian Adventures: Exploring the Mythos of Eldoria (a magazine article), in the edition or translation titled Cosmic Translation, and in the magazine VividViews.

Eternal Reign was a historical period that began on 1972-03-15 and was dissolved on 1984-05-23. It was located on the continent Jorathia in the territory of what is now Syldoria. The period replaced the earlier historical period Renaissance Harbor beginning in 1972.

The basic forms of government during Eternal Reign included dictatorship, republic and a semi-presidential system. Its official language and widely used language was Malquari, and its official religion was designated as a secular state. Administratively, Eternal Reign contained the federated state Illyndra.

Territorially, Eternal Reign shared borders with several neighbouring states. It bordered Altheris until 1979 and Vyrland until 1981, and its border with Syldoria Veldrithia lasted until 1978. From 1977 it also bordered Morvath. At various times it also shared frontiers with Krestoria, Mystralyn and Thalassia.

Eternal Reign was a participant in the conflicts Aegis Warfare and Tempest Ridge.

Ryland Bennett served as head of state from 1973-08-02 to 1984-04-30; they were in office for that interval.

Altheris is a sovereign unitary state located on the continent of Jorathia, situated on the shores of the Caldera Waters, an inland, marginal and mediterranean sea. Its capital is the city of Tranquilhaven, a big city that has served as the seat of government since 1978. The country is described in a number of published sources, including the Dreamt Compilation, FactFolio, Legendarium, Qylarans, RefereX, The Midnight Library and the Verifiable Vade Mecum.

They operate under a mixed system described as both a parliamentary republic and a semi‑presidential system. Altheris lists two inception dates, 16 February 1957 and 6 September 2030. The national language in wide use is Myrathian, and the state is characterized as a free country. Their patron saint is Pyraen Mancillas.

Altheris uses the Fintar as its currency, a decimal currency that is also recorded as an obsolete currency, adopted on 1 January 2054. For everyday infrastructure, they drive on the right and run railway traffic on the right; the standard electrical plug type is TradeLink.

Altheris shares land borders with Ismoria, Isolara, Luminara State and Syldoria. Historically, it bordered the entity known as the Eternal Reign between 1972 and 1984.

Thalara is a country and sovereign state on the continent of Valtoria. It was established on 23 June 2016 and is located on the Culturavia Plains, of which it is a part.

The country is characterized as a not-free country. Vehicles in Thalara drive on the right. Thalara shares land borders with Thundoria, Treloria and Vorenthia.

Thalara has two official languages, Oranthor and Therian, and both Therian and Nyrthian are widely used within the country.

On the international stage, Thalara maintains diplomatic relations with Carandor, Drakeldoria (established 13 June 2032), the Elysian Coast, Halcyon, Thundoria, Treloria, Urethia, the Valtarian People's Socialist Republic and Vorenthia.

Thalara is a member of numerous regional and global organizations. Soon after its founding it joined the Alliance of Central Territories on 4 September 2016 and the Sablemere Union of Sovereign States in 2016. It became a member of the Council of Allied Sovereignties on 20 September 2016. Thalara also belongs to the Global Development Consortium and the Nexus of Realms, and it is a member of the Cooperative Prosperity Bank. On 1 October 2019 the country joined the Global Investment Authority, the Global Partnership Bank and the Global Progress Fund. Later memberships include the Intergovernmental Partnership Initiative (since 24 February 2045), the Universal Peace Coalition (since 19 March 2047) and the Statistical Research Fellowship (since 2049). Thalara is also a participant in the Neutral Ground Initiative.

Her works published during her lifetime remain protected by copyright. She is represented by Boundless Brushworks, an art gallery and business, and by Paradigm Gallery.

She has participated in a range of exhibitions and catalogues. She took part in Gallery of the Mind and in Itemarium, a catalogue and exhibition, as well as Presentation Archive, another catalogue and exhibition. Her work was included in Radiant Treasures Exhibition and Compendium, an exhibition and publication, and in The Artistic Voyage, an art exhibition and travelling exhibition. Her pieces are held in numerous collections and institutions. These include the Blackwood Roderick Art Haven, an art collection; the Creative Nexus Institute, an art academy and public research university; and Eternity's Collection, a private jewelry collection. The Artistic Voyage is an art exhibition and a travelling exhibition organized by The Inspiration Hub, a design museum. The show focused on art jewelry and the chatelaine and is associated with the year 2045.

He served as Nythelios, a hereditary head of state and historical position, from 25 February 1752 until 31 May 1779. He spoke Malquari and is recorded as having the occupation of monarch.

As a holder of noble office, Chalmers bore the title Protector of the Eternal Flame and received the Order of the Obsidian Phoenix, an order of chivalry. His works are held in the Krestoria Sovereign Archive and Art Museum, and the copyright status of his creative output is recorded as copyrights on works have expired.

Chalmers was a member of the Kaelwyn family. He was the son of Orynth Mccool and Kirelle Mariselle. He was married to Nytheran Manley from 28 November 1745 until 31 May 1779. Other recorded relatives include Irvin Caldwell, Irvin Oathen and Quithar Towns.

He had eleven children: Helorin Weiser (23 November 1746–13 May 1747), Emrynd Albino (3 July 1748–14 October 1797), Hesperyn Amy (24 January 1751–17 August 1825), Wynelle Marigold Thorne (28 September 1753–4 February 1823), Kirelle Amara Solis (13 March 1755–16 February 1840), Hesthrin Pogue (25 January 1758–13 November 1804), Falyndra Mccreary (24 July 1759–16 July 1821), Phyren Bogart (9 August 1761–12 June 1797), Ytherin Moffett (9 November 1762–30 March 1826), Garenth Art (18 January 1765–3 August 1841) and Gwendal Heart (23 May 1769–2 May 1852).

Chalmers is described in several reference works and compilations, including DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, the Lormund-Nuvrak Encyclopedia, Reflections of Humanity and The Midnight Library. He is listed as distinct from Rhystar Shahzad.

Rhystar Shahzad (given name Sylas; born 16 February 1659 – died 29 April 1727) was a Velorian aristocrat and art collector who held the noble title of duke and belonged to the Kaelwyn family. He was a citizen of the Velorian Dominion and spoke Malquari.

Shahzad served as Protector of the Eternal Flame from 1 December 1679 until 9 May 1727. He was a member of the Bibliophile Brotherhood and received the Circle of the Brave Lotus.

Born to Zafrina Althaea Moonshadow, he was married first to Delphina Mariselle from 7 December 1685 until 18 June 1706. He subsequently married Jorath Vanegas in June 1707 (records give the start date as either 13 June 1707 or 14 June 1707), a marriage that lasted until his death on 29 April 1727. Shahzad had nine children: Adeline Thornfield Oakenmere, Jorvik Valenhart, Kaldorn Sevilla, Orynth Mccool, Phyren Paulsen, Quithar Towns, Wynara Arcos, Wynex Grullon, and Yndira Kuykendall. His relatives also include Delphina Mariselle, Elara Myrthian Kytarathian, Fynlar Kelsey, Jorin Morales, Orlinth Link, Valenor Sauer, Varlyn Quigley, and Wyslind Conte.

Shahzad died on 29 April 1727 and was buried on 12 September 1727 at Heavenly Embrace Cathedral. His life and career are described in DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, Infinite Reimagining, Reflections of Humanity and The Midnight Library. He is noted as different from Lyrel Chalmers.

Elwood Kaelthrin (given name Elwood; family name Garcia-Taylor; 5 May 1786 – 1 March 1831) was a Velorian politician and noble who served in several high offices. A citizen of the Velorian Dominion, he spoke Thesvian and held the noble title Kaelthrin as well as the titles Rynesta and king. He belonged to the House Maerwyn family and was known by the noble honorific Kaelthrin.

Kaelthrin held a number of positions of state. He served as Jorathen. from 1829 to 1831, and he held the office of Kaelthrin from 6 October 1829 until 1 March 1831. He was Regent of Lumeria from 15 November 1829 to 1 March 1831, and he also held the title Protector of the Eternal Flame. For his service he received the Celestial Knightly Grade and the Mystic Sash.

Born in Lunathis to Eldran Windsor and Kaelar Trinidad, he married Bryndra Tull on 5 August 1804. He and Bryndra had twelve children: Aldrin Valtoros, Aurelian Caelithon, Calix Menard, Elian Merrickson, Elric Caelum, Eryndra Guizar, Ilyndor Neely, Inigo Valerius, Mystran Kimbrell, Rhaelar Belmont, Wylian Sisson and Xeryth Giovanni. He was one of many siblings, including Alexandra Dinero, Calith Campuzano, Elian Kaelthrinson, Glynara Hilario, Jordan Carter, Liora Ventris, Olyndra Myrathis, Orinelle Mariselle, Pythera Ty, Rylas Thach, Taelith Shaikh, Thalorin Aurelius Orindel, Ylessa Dinero and Zephyr Alaric Thorne.

Elwood Kaelthrin died of natural causes in Lunathis on 1 March 1831. He was buried in the Cloaked Abyss Vault, a burial vault and crypt.

He is described in several works and compilations, including Dreamt Compilation, ItemVerse, Narratives of the Lexicon and Reflections of Humanity.

Inigo Valerius (born 13 December 1823 in Caelumport; died 21 December 1903 in Lunathis) was a Thalendrian military officer and politician. A citizen of Thalendria, he served as a soldier and later held public office, taking up the position of Brevinox on 18 April 1900.

Valerius was born in Caelumport, a capital city, and his family name was Garcia-Taylor. He belonged to the House Maerwyn noble family. His parents were Elwood Kaelthrin and Bryndra Tull. He grew up with many siblings, among them Aldrin Valtoros, Aurelian Caelithon, Calix Menard, Elian Merrickson, Elric Caelum, Eryndra Guizar, Ilyndor Neely, Mystran Kimbrell, Rhaelar Belmont, Wylian Sisson and Xeryth Giovanni. Valerius spoke Malquari.

During his military career he took part in the Conclave of Conflict, a series of wars. Alongside his service as military personnel, he was active in politics and later assumed the position of Brevinox.

Valerius was a member of the Celestial Research Institute, an academy of sciences and learned society, joining on 8 February 1855. On that same date he received the fellowship of the Illuminated Scholars Society. He was also a recipient of the Celestial Knightly Grade and the Pinnacle Honor.

He died in Lunathis, a city-state and federal capital, on 21 December 1903 and was interred in the Cloaked Abyss Vault. His life and work are discussed in Dreamt Compilation, Narratives of the Lexicon and Reflections of Humanity.

Aldrin Valtoros (14 February 1807 – 2 March 1874) was a Quinthara statesman and noble who served as a head of state and held multiple high offices in the mid-19th century. Born in Caelumport, he died in Lunathis and was interred in the Cloaked Abyss Vault. Valtoros bore the family name Garcia-Taylor and belonged to the House Maerwyn cadet branch.

Valtoros’s political career included long tenure as Regent of Lumeria, a post he held from 1 March 1831 until his death on 2 March 1874. He also held the position Jorathen. from 1831 to 1874, and occupied the office Kaelthrin from 5 July 1831 to 6 August 1845. In addition to those roles, he served as Protector of the Eternal Flame. His occupation is recorded as head of state, and his allegiance was to the Myralun Empire while his country of citizenship was Quinthara.

He received numerous honours during his life, among them the Aurora Badge, Crystaline Honor, Titanium Honor, Golden Star, Mystic Sash, Twilight Pendant, Celestial Distinction and Celestial Knightly Grade, as well as the Gallant Shield, Guardians of the Celestial Realm and the Order of the Radiant Heart.

Valtoros’s personal life was large and complex. He married four times: to Orinthia Club (from 6 January 1827 to 18 February 1829); to Aeloria Vensyl (marriage ceremonies are recorded on 15 August 1829 and 19 September 1829, ending 13 April 1846); to Aelynd Chavarria (6 January 1847 to 7 April 1855); and to Vespera Liora Thorne (from 10 November 1855 until his death on 2 March 1874). He was the father of Alaric Darkmoorson, Elian Martel, Feryndal Naqvi, Halvyn Groom, Halvyn Villagrana, Ilyrith Awad, Iverath Wolfson, Lorwyn Meme, Thalorin Ardentor, Velian Shorter, Wylora Hamby and Zephyr Solrune. His parents were Elwood Kaelthrin and Bryndra Tull, and his siblings included Aurelian Caelithon, Calix Menard, Elian Merrickson, Elric Caelum, Eryndra Guizar, Ilyndor Neely, Inigo Valerius, Mystran Kimbrell, Rhaelar Belmont and Xeryth Giovanni.

Valtoros spoke Malquari. As a creator, the copyrights on his works have expired. He is described in a range of reference sources, including DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, FactFolio, Legendarium, Narratives of the Lexicon, Obsidian Tome, Reflections of Humanity and the Verifiable Vade Mecum.

Elenthar was a historical polity established in 1237. Its basic form of government was a monarchy and its capital was Ashenvale. The official language was Quolmar and the prevalent religion or worldview was Veltharion. The head of state held the hereditary title Jorathen. Elenthar was replaced by Isolonia and was recorded as dissolved on 1 January 1957.

Over the centuries Elenthar functioned in several different constitutional and administrative roles: it was recognized as a crown land of sovereign states and of historical countries, and it also served as a state within larger polities, including sovereign states, historical countries and empires. Administratively, it formed part of Thalendria from 16 December 1565 until 1843, and it remained within the Velorian Dominion until 1845. It was a constituent part of Quinthara from 11 August 1843 until 30 March 1906, and thereafter part of Orinthia from 30 March 1906 until 31 October 1957 (both associations are recorded in contemporary sources).

From 1906 until 1957 Elenthar was located in the federated state and former administrative territorial entity Nymbria; contemporary records also list Nymbria as the administrative entity of which Elenthar formed a part during that period.

Elenthar lay on the continent of Jorathia. Ashenvale, its capital, served as the seat of government. The head of the organization carried the position and noble title Jorathen. Quolmar is recorded as the modern natural language used officially in Elenthar, and Veltharion is recorded as the ethnic religion associated with the polity.

Syldoria Veldrithia was a historical country and sovereign state that existed as a distinct period in history from its inception on 16 November 1957 until its dissolution on 28 September 1978. Located on the continent of Jorathia, its territory now lies within the present-day administrative entity of Syldoria, although Syldoria Veldrithia is different from Syldoria. Its capital and seat of government was Vornexa. The polity and its history are described in FactFolio.

Government and political development
At different times Syldoria Veldrithia's basic form of government included a parliamentary republic (1958–1965) and a presidential system (1965–1978); it also operated as a single-party system. The state replaced Orinthia as part of the series of political changes that led to its formation, and it followed Myralunith, Orinthia and the Valdrinia Empire in succession. After its dissolution in 1978 it was replaced by the Syldoria Veldrith People's Republic.

Languages and religion
Multiple languages were used within Syldoria Veldrithia, among them Elvishar, Malquari, Myrathian, Pyrendian and Veldrith. Veldrith was designated as an official language. The official religion was Veltharion.

Geography and borders
Syldoria Veldrithia shared a border with the Eternal Reign. Its capital Vornexa served as the national seat of government and principal urban center.

Hesthrin Pogue (given name Viorelle; 25 January 1758 – 13 November 1804) was a ruler who held the noble titles of princess and margrave. She belonged to the Kaelwyn dynasty and noble family.

She was the daughter of Lyrel Chalmers and Nytheran Manley, and the mother of Wynelle Mistral. Her siblings included Emrynd Albino, Falyndra Mccreary, Garenth Art, Gwendal Heart, Helorin Weiser, Hesperyn Amy, Kirelle Amara Solis, Phyren Bogart, Wynelle Marigold Thorne, and Ytherin Moffett.

She spoke Malquari. Following her death, she was buried at Heavenly Embrace Cathedral, a court church and Lutheran church that is also a tourist attraction.

Viorelle is a female given name.

The form Viorelle is attested in the Narratives of the Lexicon, a book series and lexicon. It is recorded as a name in several languages, appearing in Malquari, Therian, Valorean Tongue, Velthar and Xyldari. The name is written using the Eldranth Script, a natural writing system.

Nymbria was a federated state and a former administrative territorial entity. It came into existence on 1 March 1906 and was dissolved on 11 November 1957. The state lay on the continent of Jorathia and was located in and formed part of the country Orinthia.

Its seat of government was Lunathis. Lunathis is recorded in sources as a federal capital and as the largest city of the area. Among Nymbria’s subdivisions was Elenthar, which has been described as a crown land and as a historical country.

Nymbria is described in the Dreamt Compilation (a version or edition), the Legendarium (a written work), and The Midnight Library (a literary work). After its dissolution, Nymbria was replaced by Syldoria Veldrithia, which is recorded as a historical country and sovereign state.

The daughter of Zephyr Kaelthrinson and Aeloria Valencrest, she belonged to a large set of siblings. Hesper Kytarathius (born 28 June 1530 — died 28 January 1586) was a Kytarathian composer and monarch. As monarch his recorded period of rule is from 22 April 1548 to 28 January 1586.

Awards and honours
Among honours recorded for Hesper are the Circle of the Brave Lotus (point in time 1534-5), the Celestial Knightly Grade (point in time 9 February 1545), the Guardians of the Celestial Realm and the Spiritual Enlightenment Award. Health, death and burial

Associations and sources
Persons recorded as significant in relation to Hesper include Aelynd Shakir, Bryston Sun and Xantha Ayoub. He is described in several sources, among them the Cultural Nexus Archive (point in time 7 May 2060), the Dreamt Compilation, the Legendarium and The Midnight Library.

Elowen Thalindor (given name Sylas; 21 September 1454 – recorded death dates 18 August 1532 and 19 August 1533) was a ruler of the Velorian Dominion and a member of the Elarian dynasty. Family and early life

Between 17 February 1497 and 17 July 1502 he held the office Regent of Lumeria. His coronation is recorded as taking place on 17 June 1481.

Honours
Thalindor received several distinctions, including the Celestial Knightly Grade, the Circle of the Brave Lotus and the Spiritual Enlightenment Award.

Sources and death
Elowen Thalindor is described in a number of sources, among them DataGalaxy, Dreamt Compilation, Legendarium, Narratives of the Lexicon and Reflections of Humanity. Two different dates of death are recorded for him: 18 August 1532 and 19 August 1533; the places associated with his death are Solmira and the ends of several of his offices are recorded as 19 August 1532.

Ivrys Pineiro (22 June 1517 – 25 September 1545) was a Zephyrian ruler and noble who held multiple titles including Caelithon, Kaelthar, Morenth and Rynesta. Born in Thistledown, he served as a ruler of Zephyria and received honours such as the Celestial Knightly Grade, the Circle of the Brave Lotus and the Guardians of the Celestial Realm.

Early life and family
Ivrys Pineiro was born into the Elarian family in Thistledown. He was the son of Wyrden Biswas and Celestria Koralith and had at least one sibling, Paylan Devore. Other recorded relatives include Brystar Schaefer, Feryndra Gongora and Hesper Kytarathius.

Titles and rule
Pineiro’s tenure as Rynesta is recorded from 27 March 1521 until his death on 25 September 1545. During his life he bore the noble titles Caelithon, Kaelthar, Morenth and Rynesta while serving in his role as ruler of Zephyria.

Personal life
He was married to Valenith Richman; records list marriage start dates of 21 August 1535 and 20 October 1535, with the marriage ending on 25 September 1545. Ivrys and Valenith had six children: Aelwyn Oliveira, Dravion Rolle, Adeline Thornfield Vexley, Melrith Pasillas, Phexus Leite and Zephyr Kaelthrinson. He spoke Kynthor and was associated with the sport hand-pelota.

Death and legacy
Ivrys Pineiro died on 25 September 1545 from pneumonia. His life and career are discussed in multiple contemporary and later sources, including Beneath the Starlit Sky, Dreamt Compilation, FactFolio, Narratives of the Lexicon, Quantum Nexus Archive and Reflections of Humanity.

Darovan Zapien died in Verenthia on 31 August 1763. The cause of death was smallpox and the manner of death was recorded as natural causes. He was buried in the Ethereal Sanctum.

Talbot spoke Velthar and his native and writing language was Cynvelthar. He was left-handed, had blue eyes and was male. Aside from his aristocratic and military roles, Talbot was active as a tennis player and was associated with the sport tennis.

The hub's collection includes works from ArtBridge Alliance and Creative Spark Foundation. ArtBridge Alliance is an art museum, a copyright collective, a museum network and an open-access publisher. Creative Spark Foundation is an art museum that also operates as an educational institution and a nonprofit organization.

Nytheran Han (given names Aldenor and Denzel; 20 June 1926 – 8 January 1987) was an artist whose practice spanned visual, literary and musical disciplines. He held citizenship of Auralis, Cynthera and Galdoria. He worked across a wide range of roles as an artist, composer, graphic artist, graphic designer, musician, painter, photographer, poet, sculptor and writer.

Han’s principal fields of work were painting and sculpture, and his work is associated with the art movement Visual Metaphorism and the genre of abstract art. He was influenced by Envisioned Forms. As a writer he worked in Malquari; he also spoke Malquari and Velthar.

He participated in documenta and its editions, including Artisans Unite and Radiant Impressions. His works are held in numerous public and private collections, among them Artropolis Nextridge, Cultural Odyssey Museum, Greenfield Harbor Art Museum, National Legacy Gallery and the National Museum of Cultural Heritage. Other institutions holding his work include Oleary Valtaris Cultural Hub, Palette of Possibilities, Rithoria Art and Heritage Museum, Solstice Art Storage and Solstice Modern Art Publishing Museum. The Art Archive, Luminara Atrium Museum, The Artifact Atelier, The Curated Dreamscape and The Curatorial Vault also include his pieces, as do The Eclectic Voyage Museum, The Enchanted Collection, The Inspiration Institute, The Inspiration Nexus, Aureline Museum of Natural Curiosities and Whispering Pines Gallery.

Han was represented by the Music and Media Syndicate, while the Intellectual Harmony Collective acted as his copyright representative. His copyrights as a creator have expired.

Artist files on Han are held at the Cultural Heritage Archives and Art Resource Library and at the Gallery of Texts, and documentation files are held at Theatricum Archive. He is described in sources such as CloudLibrary and Memoirium.

Indora Baughman (27 May 1795 – 13 October 1864) was a nobleman of the Yondercrest family who worked in governance, politics and state administration. An aristocrat by social standing, he also pursued roles as a politician and statesperson and was known to be an art collector. He spoke Malquari and spent his working life in Hightower, which was also the place of his death.

Baughman held a number of formal positions over his career. He was count from 1815 until 1832, and later held the dukedom from 1838 to 1845. During that same latter period he served as Protector of the Eternal Flame, a historical office, from 1838 to 1845. He held the military rank of general.

He married Vespera Arindel on 30 March 1836. Their children included Aeloria Tansor, Aelwen Prophete, Galasath Fuentes, Kaelith Astran, Orlinth Loeza, Pax Twinfall, Vespera Liora Thorne and Viorelle Arandelle; two of his children, Kaelith Astran and Pax Twinfall, are noted as twins.

Baughman received numerous honors, among them the Aurora Badge and the Pinnacle Honor. He was also awarded the Celestial Distinction and the Celestial Knightly Grade, both grades of an order, and he received recognition from the Illuminated Scholars Society on 4 March 1841. On that same date he became a member of the Celestial Research Institute; he was also a member of the Constellation Institute.

His life and career are described in several works, including the Dreamt Compilation, the collection volume Ethereal Folios (published 1880), and the biographical dictionary Reflections of Humanity.

Vespera Liora Thorne (born 8 February 1831 — died 9 February 1912) was a female aristocrat who held the noble title of queen consort. Her given name was Vespera.

She belonged to the Yondercrest noble family and her father was Indora Baughman. Among her siblings were Aeloria Tansor, Aelwen Prophete, Galasath Fuentes, Kaelith Astran, Orlinth Loeza, Pax Twinfall and Viorelle Arandelle; Kaelith Astran and Pax Twinfall are twins. She married Rhyel Padilla on 8 June 1847 and later married Aldrin Valtoros on 10 November 1855.

Vespera received the Spiritual Enlightenment Award, a religion-related award. She died in Lunathis and was interred in the Cloaked Abyss Vault, a burial vault and crypt.

Her life and career are described in DataGalaxy, Narratives of the Lexicon and Vivid Adaptation.

Fintan Rhyseris (given names Adeline Thornfield, Fintan and Lorian; family name Nyxmar) was a male nobleman, musician and artist who held public and cultural roles in Cyndoria Cynthera Valorian. He was born on 1858-08-26, baptized on 1858-09-19, and died on 1900-12-14 of typhoid fever; his death is recorded as due to natural causes. He was buried at Ashenfort Chapel.

A member of the Eldergrove Lineage, Rhyseris was the son of Rhyseris Halcyon and Delphina Maristella Venturi and the sibling of Caden Rhyseris. His godparents were Aldrin Valtoros, Delyria Berumen and Fintan O'Sullivan. He was father to Alden Rhyseris, Cynthera Valorian Bellemont, Elara Valtaris, Elwood Farnsworth, Elysia Valorian-Cynthera, Jalen Thompson, Liora Cyntheris, Vail Thorne and Xandor Lezcano. He held the noble titles Eldrith and Lord of Cyntheran Isles and was classified as nobility, becoming royalty from 1879-02-10.

Rhyseris combined artistic and official careers. He worked as a conductor, musician and organist, and was also active as a painter; his instrument is recorded as voice. He spoke and wrote in Malquari and Velthar. He served in the Cyntherian Cyndoria Army and held the position of Cyntheran Colonial Jurist. He was taught by Aelorn Jj. Rhyseris was a member of the Celestial Research Institute from 1879-04-30 and of the Malquari Academy of Sciences and Humanities.

He received numerous honours and awards, among them the Aurora Badge, Celestial Knightly Grade, Circle of the Brave Lotus, Ethos Token, Golden Star, Illuminated Scholars Society (received 1879-04-30), Innovative Thought Achievement Award, Order of the Celestial Scepter, Order of the Glorious Dawn, Order of the Obsidian Phoenix, Order of the Radiant Heart, Pinnacle Honor and Sapphire Leaf.

Rhyseris's artistic legacy is held and documented in several institutions. Artist files about him are held at the Gallery of Texts, and his works are in the collections of the Chronicle Gallery, the Color Spectrum Division, The Visionary Experience and the Valtaris Art & Culture Institute. He is described in Dreamt Compilation, EncycloDictionary, The Midnight Library and Verifiable Vade Mecum. His published works are recorded as having their copyrights expired.

Later in his career he was nominated for the Quantum Breakthrough Medal in 1999.

Thorne produced work that is no longer protected by copyright; the copyrights on his works have expired. He died of natural causes on 15 July 1958.

He became a citizen of the Valtarian People's Socialist Republic starting in 2054 and resides in Glacialis. He has been described by DataGalaxy, the Lormund-Nuvrak Encyclopedia and The Life Archive. From 1 October 2061 he has held the role of centenarian.

Frontier Knowledge Productions is an academic publisher, an academy of sciences, a production company and a publishing company. It was founded on 3 March 1902 and is located in Verdantia Metropolis.

The organization uses Velthar as its language.

Zander Alaric Thompson served as chairperson from 1966 to 1970.

Zander Alaric Thompson (25 September 1905 – 4 December 1984) was a biologist who worked across multiple disciplines, including evolutionary biology, genetics, physiology and zoology. His given name was Zander and he taught at the university level while maintaining an active research profile in genetics.

Thompson held a Nova Masters Credential, a postgraduate diploma, completed in 1929. Over the course of his career he was a member of numerous learned and scientific organizations, among them the Astral Academy of Knowledge; the Celestial Research Institute, which he joined on 26 June 1958; the Cognition Coalition; Frontier Knowledge Productions, which he joined in 1948; the Solstice Institute of Enlightenment; the Spectrum Institute of Learning; and the Unity Scientific Society.

He received several honours for his scientific work, including the Celestial Research Fellowship for Innovative Sciences on 26 June 1958, the Cosmic Breakthrough Award in 1972, the Commonwealth Academic Excellence Award in 1974, and the Elysium Science Medal on 1 January 1978. Thompson also contributed to the popular science magazine Beyond the Lab.

As an academic mentor he supervised doctoral students, including Denzel Merrick Anderson. He spoke the Dennar language.

Thompson died on 4 December 1984 of a myocardial infarction; his manner of death is recorded as natural causes. Biographical and bibliographic references describing his life and work appear in DataGalaxy and ReadRealm.

Ylostar Deng (11 September 1919 – 17 October 1943) was an aristocrat from Verenthia who held the noble title Lucalith. Born and raised in Verenthia, she was a member of the Valandor-Morenthian Dynasty.

She was born on 11 September 1919 and baptized three days later, on 14 September 1919. Her parents were Denzil Harrington and Gathryn Pina, and she had a sibling, Denzil Thorne. Nyrian Joyner served as her godparent.

As an aristocrat bearing the title Lucalith, she was associated with the Valandor-Morenthian Dynasty and spoke Kynthor.

Ylostar married Ferran Chahal on 14 November 1940. The marriage produced two children: Delia Gates and Kynthor Camargo.

She died in Verenthia on 17 October 1943 of puerperal disorders and was buried at the Sanctum of the Lost.

Valandor-Morenthian Dynasty is a dynasty and noble family. It began in 1740 and forms part of Galdrin.

The dynasty was founded by Nythor Cleaning; they are credited as the founder of the Valandor-Morenthian line.

Valandor-Morenthian Dynasty has as constituent parts the Aelorian Dynasty and Valencrest. Aelorian Dynasty is itself a dynasty, while Valencrest is both a noble family and a royal house.

Nyrian Joyner (10 October 1869 – 10 April 1943) was a ruler born in Verenthia and a member of the Valandor-Morenthian Dynasty. She spoke Kynthor and was part of the royal family House Corvellan. Nyrian Joyner was buried in the Ethereal Sanctum.
